To address the bias, our key idea is to exploit {\it confidence}, i.e., the probability that an instance is positive, associated with the small number of labeled positive data. We derive an estimator of the AUC risk using biased PU data with confidence, enabling AUC maximization under such bias. We further show that the rewritten AUC risk induces a Bayes-optimal AUC ranking even when the available confidence is any strictly increasing transformation of the true posterior probability. We experimentally show the effectiveness of our method on eight real-world datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在SAR设置下从有偏PU数据中进行AUC最大化的方法，通过利用标注正例的置信度（正例概率）来纠正选择偏差，无需对数据分布或标注机制做强假设，并证明了即使置信度是真实后验概率的任意严格递增变换，仍可恢复贝叶斯最优AUC排序。
AI.motivation: 现有PU学习中的AUC最大化方法假设标注正例数据是从真实正类分布中无偏采样（SCAR设置），但实际应用中这一理想假设常被违反（如安全领域的恶意数据、医疗诊断等），导致有偏标注。先前针对SAR设置的方法需要数据分布可分或选择概率服从特定形式等强限制性假设，假设不满足时性能急剧下降，且这些方法并非为AUC最大化设计。
AI.method: 在SAR设置下，利用带置信度（即每个标注正例属于正类的概率）的偏PU数据，推导AUC风险的估计器。其核心思想是用权重 p(y=1|x)/p(o=1|x) 修正标注正例的偏差；先通过关系 p^ℓ(x) = e(x)/c · p^p(x) 和 e(x) = p(o=1|x)/p(y=1|x) 将风险用标注密度 p^ℓ 和边际密度 p 表示，再用 NTC 估计 p(o=1|x)，将置信度代入得到经验AUC风险估计器。理论上证明即便置信度是真实后验概率的任意严格递增变换，最小化该风险仍产生贝叶斯最优AUC排序；并给出标签概率估计误差敏感性分析和有限样本泛化误差界。该方法是模型无关的，可配合线性、核或神经网络分类器。
AI.result: 在8个真实数据集（Mnist, Fmnist, Svhn, Cifar10, Diabetes, Blood, Cifar10-H, Fmnist-H）上的实验表明，所提出方法在所有数据集上均达到最优或统计上可比较的性能；在变换 h(r)=r^k 下性能稳定，而Pconf等基线对k较敏感；在人为标注置信度（Cifar10-H, Fmnist-H）下同样有效，且常优于w/oConf变体，验证了置信度的有效性；在不同标注率c、类别先验π及类别距离型偏差、置信度依赖偏差设置下均稳定。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的方法首次实现了SAR设置下基于正例置信度的AUC最大化，无需强分布假设即可纠正偏PU数据中的选择偏差，并具有对置信度标定鲁棒、模型无关的优势，在多个数据集上优于现有PU学习基线方法，适用于网络安全、医疗、产品检验和欺诈检测等实际场景。

title: Evaluating Scaffolding-Oriented Multi-Agent Large Language Model System for Clinical Interview Training
summary: Clinical education must prepare medical students to conduct safe and coherent patient interviews under conditions of uncertainty. Traditional standardized patient (SP) training is resource-intensive and difficult to scale. We developed a scaffolding-oriented multi-agent Large Language Model (LLM) AI Standardized Patient (AI-SP) training platform1. The system includes a patient agent for simulated dialog, a tutor agent providing Socratic prompts without disclosing diagnostic information, and a turn-level evaluator agent that monitors clinical progress without revealing summative scores. In a randomized controlled study (N = 100 medical students), participants were assigned to either a multi-agent (MA) scaffolding condition or a control condition. All students completed two learning sessions under their assigned condition followed by an examination conducted in a patient only environment. Performance was assessed using a standardized Objective Structured Clinical Examination (OSCE) based rubric. While no significant difference was observed in final diagnostic accuracy between groups, the multi-agent AI standardized patient system improved final examination scores compared to the control group utilizing structured progressive information disclosure; the most substantial and consistent improvements were observed in communication, the expression of empathy, and specific history-taking behaviors. These findings suggest that specialized LLM agents enhance the process quality of simulated clinical interviews without artificially inflating examination outcomes. To support future research, we release a multi-expert annotated dataset comprising transcripts, checklist annotations, turn-level evaluations, and OSCE-aligned scoring outcomes. This resource aims to facilitate the development of pedagogically grounded AI-SP systems and advance research on AI-supported clinical reasoning training.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个基于脚手架理论的多智能体LLM标准化病人(AI-SP)训练平台MeduAI-SP，通过随机对照试验(N=100)证明其相比结构化非LLM对照组能显著提高医学生的OSCE考试成绩，尤其是在沟通、共情表达和结构化病史采集方面，同时不人为抬高诊断准确性。此外，团队还发布了一个多专家标注的对话语料库支持未来研究。
AI.motivation: 传统标准化病人(SP)训练资源密集、难以规模化。现有LLM模拟病人研究多关注对话保真度，而非教学有效性。同时，医学生临床能力培养需要兼顾认知与沟通行为，但AI辅助工具存在"过度依赖"和"never-skilling"风险。因此需要探索如何将LLM智能体组织为脚手架式教学系统以支持（而非替代）学生的临床推理过程。
AI.method: 1. 系统设计：基于Scaffolding理论和ZPD，采用多智能体架构（qwen-max），包括患者agent（按病例脚本进行渐进式信息披露的对话）、导师agent（提供苏格拉底式提示，不泄露诊断）、回合级评估agent（监控关键病史与沟通项）和最终评估agent。2. 随机对照试验：100名广州医科大学临床医学三年级学生随机分为多智能体组(MA, n=47)与结构化渐进披露对照组(CT, n=48)，完成两次学习+一次考试，考试阶段统一为仅患者模式。3. OSCE对齐评估框架：包含总体分数、四个领域评分（病史采集、临床思维、沟通共情、诊断准确性）、清单行为覆盖度与诊断准确性。4. 构建并发布多专家标注语料库（207次会话、4815条消息），采用四维标注方案（患者保真度、学生对话意图、支架需求、OSCE评分），由3名临床专家独立标注。
AI.result: 1. 主要结局：MA组期末考试得分显著高于CT组（71.8% vs 55.6%，P=5.51×10⁻⁵，Hedges' g=-0.81；线性模型β=16.4, P=3.30×10⁻⁴）。2. 沟通领域提升最大：OSCE沟通评分3.53 vs 2.64（P=4.14×10⁻⁴，g=-0.79）。3. 条目级分析：共情表达差异最大（+31个百分点，Holm校正后P=8.30×10⁻⁴），药物过敏史、病程、总结确认信息显著改善。4. 诊断准确性无显著差异（86% vs 84%，P=1.000），提示实验控制得当，益处源于问诊过程而非诊断知识。5. 探索性UMAP+K-means聚类识别5种表现表型，两组分布不同（χ²=16.15, P=0.040）。6. AI-SP保真度高：仅0.68%存在保真问题，渐进信息披露合理率99.3%。7. 标注一致性：对话意图Fleiss' κ=0.84（近完美），OSCE领域ICC(2,k)=0.80-0.85，支架需求κ=0.56（中等）。8. 问卷可靠性：SUS α=0.86，UES α=0.96。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体AI标准化病人系统能通过脚手架式教学设计显著提升模拟问诊的过程质量，尤其在沟通、共情表达和结构化病史采集方面，且不人为抬高诊断终点。结果支持"功能互补"模型——AI适合重复练习、清单监控与初步形成性反馈，而人类教师与标准化病人在情感解读、个性化补救与能力判断上仍不可或缺。局限性包括：对照为非LLM结构化条件而非人类SP或教师反馈；案例集中于急腹症；缺乏延迟随访与真实临床迁移评估。未来需对比人类SP+教师反馈、混合模式，并测试保留独立推理能力的"渐隐式脚手架"。所发布的多专家标注语料库为后续AI-SP保真度、自动化评估与脚手架时机研究提供了基础。

title: Robust Multimodal Sentiment Analysis with Incomplete Modalities via Semantic-aware Completeness based Reconstruction
comment: Accepted to the Findings of EMNLP 2026
summary: Recent multimodal sentiment analysis studies increasingly adopt text-centric fusion approaches to exploit the rich sentiment information inherent in the textual modality. However, these approaches often suffer from performance degradation during inference due to partially missing or noisy data in real-world scenarios, especially when sentiment-related cues are missing. To address this issue, we introduce a new completeness estimation approach that quantifies the degree of sentiment-relevant information preserved in incomplete data to guide the reconstruction of missing semantics. Furthermore, we propose a training strategy that stabilizes multi-task learning while jointly optimizing sentiment prediction and completeness estimation. Extensive experiments and in-depth analyses on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed approach enables more accurate semantic reconstruction, leading to more precise sentiment prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TCMR框架，通过语义感知完整性估计来重建不完整模态下的多模态情感分析缺失语义，解决了文本中心融合方法在推理时面对数据缺失或噪声性能下降的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于文本中心融合的多模态情感分析方法在面对数据不完整或噪声时性能下降明显，尤其当情感线索缺失时。已有的基于缺失率估计完整性的方法无法准确捕捉语义信息损失，低缺失率可能掩盖关键情感线索的丢失，高缺失率也可能保留完整的情感意义，导致重建不可靠。
AI.method: 提出Text Completeness-based Missing Reconstruction (TCMR)框架，包含三大核心组件：(1) 语义完整性估计器(CompNet)，基于BERT的[CLS]嵌入预测文本完整性权重；(2) 基于目标概率的语义完整性(TPSC)伪标签生成策略，利用预训练情感极性分类器在完整和不完整文本上的真实类概率(TCP)差异生成监督信号；(3) 重要性感知代理特征生成器(IPFG)，通过门控网络自适应平衡音频和视觉模态的贡献。重建文本表示由完整性权重加权的原始文本特征与代理特征组合而成。此外提出交替优化策略(AOS)，将优化分为两个阶段以缓解完整性估计与情感预测之间的梯度冲突。
AI.result: 在MOSI、MOSEI和SIMS三个基准数据集上的实验表明，TCMR-TPSC在大多数评估指标上优于12个竞争基线方法。在MOSI数据集上，Acc-5比LNLN提升6.68%，MAE降低6.37%。消融实验验证了AOS、IPFG和TPSC伪标签各自的有效性。完整性标记的定性比较表明TPSC在识别关键情感线索方面优于基于缺失率的(MRSC)和基于词典的(LDSC)方法。情感令牌敏感性分析进一步验证了TCP能有效反映情感信息的保留程度。
AI.conclusion: 本文重新定义了不完整数据中语义信息损失的衡量方式——通过完整与不完整数据之间目标类概率的变化来量化。提出的TPSC伪标签策略能更准确地估计文本语义完整性，指导代理特征的自适应融合，实现更精确的语义重建。AOS策略有效缓解了多任务学习中的梯度冲突问题。TCMR在多个基准数据集和不同缺失率下均表现稳定。该完整性估计方法有望推广至信心感知决策和低质量数据检测/恢复等更广泛的领域。

title: What a Random Draw from the MCP Registry Contains, and What Tool-Use Benchmarks Contain Instead
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures. Seeded, re-runnable pipeline and per-server outcomes: this https URL ; archived at doi: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21347997
summary: Studies of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server ecosystem draw their samples in ways that quietly select for servers that work: reference sets, popularity lists, hand-curated frames, or pipelines that repair a server until it starts. We report what an unrepaired probability sample actually contains. From a 24,135-server registry census we draw 400 npm/stdio servers with a published seed and probe each one over the wire. Only 48.8% complete an initialize handshake, against 66.7% for a hand-curated frame measured with the same instrument, and the dominant failure is not missing credentials (13.3%) but servers that never start at all (37.5%). Among the 195 that do run, hard conformance is total: zero fatal JSON Schema violations across 2,766 advertised tools. Optional safety annotations are the real variance, and the tool-level omission rate on a random draw is 58.8% against 41.5% on the curated frame, so curation flatters this figure too. We then compare the tool descriptions these servers advertise against two tool-use benchmark corpora using one method held constant. Real MCP tools show 2.8% near-duplication at cosine 0.70, and all of it lies within single servers: cross-author near-duplication is 0.0% at every threshold tested. BFCL v4 shows 16.7%, of which 16.4 points lie between independently presented tasks. UltraTool shows 0.3%, cleaner than real tools, so this is a property of BFCL and not of synthetic corpora as a class. Separately, 68.8% of raw BFCL rows and 85.6% of raw UltraTool rows are exact name-plus-description repeats, against 0.4% for real MCP, so any statistic computed over these releases without global deduplication measures repetition rather than tools. All figures regenerate from released scripts and a published seed.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过未修复的随机抽样,实证揭示了MCP服务器生态系统中约一半服务器无法启动,并指出常用工具使用基准(如BFCL v4)存在严重的任务间重复问题,而真实部署的MCP工具则没有跨作者重复。
AI.motivation: 现有MCP生态研究均通过参考集、流行度列表、策展框架或修复管道(让服务器运行起来)进行采样,这会系统性筛掉"无法启动"的服务器,导致对生态健康度的估计偏离真实情况。同时,已有工作关注工具使用基准的"评估器"问题,但缺乏对"语料本身"与真实部署工具之间相似性的比较。
AI.method: 1. 通过cursor分页扫描官方MCP注册表(两次完整快照:2026-07-14与2026-08-22,共24,135台服务器),不执行第三方代码。2. 在npm/stdio子集(7,258候选)上用种子化mulberry32(种子20260819)做无替换概率抽样,得到400台服务器。3. 对每台服务器通过stdio启动,npx发起一次initialize握手,枚举工具,校验JSON Schema,不提供凭据、不重试、不修复。4. 工具冗余度量:以"名称+完整描述"做全局去重后,分别对每个语料独立拟合TF-IDF(词单元+二元语法,亚线性词频),用余弦相似度,在统一阈值下报告冗余率并按"同作者单元内/跨单元"分解。比较对象为真实MCP的2,766个工具、BFCL v4的8,726条记录、UltraTool EN的14,084条记录。
AI.result: RQ1(随机抽样内容):400台中仅48.8%完成initialize握手,而同一仪器在24台策展框架上为66.7%,策展带来17.9个百分点的选择偏差。失败模式以"无法启动"为主(37.5%),是"需要凭据"(13.3%)的近三倍;另有0.5%包不可用。RQ2(可运行服务器):195台共发布2,766个工具,致命JSON Schema违规为0;但58.8%的工具缺少安全annotations(readOnlyHint/destructiveHint/idempotentHint/openWorldHint),而策展框架仅41.5%;194台服务器呈"全有或全无"双峰分布。协议版本以2025-06-18为主(192/195),但也出现更新版本。RQ3(基准语料对比):原始BFCL v4的68.8%行、UltraTool EN的85.6%行为名称+描述完全重复,真实MCP仅0.4%。全局去重后,在余弦0.70阈值上,真实MCP冗余2.8%(全部为同服务器内对,跨服务器为0.0%);BFCL v4冗余16.7%(其中16.4点跨独立任务);UltraTool EN冗余0.3%,比真实工具更干净,表明这是BFCL特有而非合成语料通病。生态背景:39天内服务器从16,548增至24,135;远程托管首次超过本地包,npm/stdio占比从35.1%降至30.7%。
AI.conclusion: 结论有三:(1)策展会同时在两个方向美化数据——既抬高出启动率(48.8%→66.7%),又压低annotation缺失率(58.8%→41.5%),事后无法校正;(2)真实MCP工具的接口层在跨作者维度上不存在冗余(0.0%),代码级克隆与接口级克隆之间的差距本身值得报告;(3)BFCL v4的冗余主要发生在独立任务之间,未经全局去重的统计衡量的是"重复次数"而非"工具数量",UltraTool则比真实工具更干净。所有数字均可从发布脚本与公开种子重新生成。

title: EGGROLL, Unrolled: Understanding and Improving Low-Rank Evolution Strategies at Scale
summary: EGGROLL makes evolution strategies (ES) practical for LLMs by replacing dense Gaussian weight perturbations with low-rank Gaussian products, often of rank one. This choice is computationally attractive but geometrically severe: each rank-one perturbation lies in a zero-volume subset of the ambient matrix space, despite having identity covariance. We characterize the mean EGGROLL update field at finite rank and nonzero perturbation radii, then analyze the error of its finite-population estimator. The population field is obtained by applying an explicit resolvent to the gradient of the objective smoothed by the perturbations. We show that the resolvent can introduce a nonconservative component and can reverse the local stability of an optimum. EGGROLL is nevertheless exact on every quadratic objective at every rank and radius. For smooth objectives, its first local finite-rank correction is $O(\sigma^2/r)$, and nonasymptotic bounds control the resulting field error under smoothness assumptions. Under a local affine model, rank-one perturbations increase the variance of the gradient estimator by only $\frac{2(m+n+1)}{mn+1}$ relative to dense Gaussian ES, or $0.098\%$ for a $4096\times4096$ matrix. We then introduce LOO-ROLL, a leave-one-out estimator that preserves the finite-rank population field while replacing EGGROLL's two antithetic evaluations per direction by one. At equal evaluation cost, LOO-ROLL halves estimator MSE in transformer blocks. At matched wall time across ten post-training settings and models up to 8B parameters, LOO-ROLL improves seven outcomes in individual paired tests, with no significant loss. On the GSM8K test set, accuracy increases from $38.1\%$ to $63.0\%$ at 0.6B and from $65.9\%$ to $80.0\%$ at 8B. Transformer measurements recover the predicted finite-rank variance, while the rank comparisons show no reproducible reward-based advantage for rank eight.

AI.tldr: 本文对EGGROLL（一种用低秩高斯乘积扰动实现的大模型进化策略）进行了系统性的理论分析和改进：刻画了有限秩下EGGROLL平均更新场的解析结构（解算子形式），分析了有限种群估计误差，并提出了LOO-ROLL留一估计器，在等评估成本下将估计器MSE降低一半，在等墙钟时间下在十项LLM后训练设置中七项显著提升。
AI.motivation: EGGROLL虽因低秩扰动实现高吞吐量，但rank-one扰动位于零测度子集且得分函数不匹配，其为何有效及有限秩、有限半径、有限种群下的理论行为尚不清晰。
AI.method: 通过傅里叶分析推导特征函数Φ_r(T)=det(I+TT^⊤/r)^(-r/2)，证明EGGROLL均场为平滑目标梯度的预解算子J_{r,σ}=(I+σ²ℒ/r)^(-1)，并以全局守恒性定理将其与球对称性等价；在仿射局部模型下精确计算有限种群协方差；提出基于留一基线的LOO-ROLL；通过Transformer模块审计和十组LLM后训练实验验证理论。
AI.result: 理论上：EGGROLL在二次目标上精确，有限秩修正首项为O(σ²/r)，保守性需球对称扰动；rank-one相对dense高斯ES的方差增量对4096×4096矩阵仅0.098%。实践上：等评估成本下LOO-ROLL将Transformer块MSE减半；等墙钟时间下十项LLM设置中七项在配对检验中显著优于对偶EGGROLL，Holm校正后五项仍显著；GSM8K全测试集上0.6B从38.1%→63.0%，8B从65.9%→80.0%。
AI.conclusion: EGGROLL的有限秩理论揭示其均场和方差代价均可被精确刻画；rank-eight在测试设置中未产生可复现的奖励优势；LOO-ROLL通过消除对偶评估在保持EGGROLL低秩计算优势的同时大幅提升LLM后训练性能，为该方向提供了理论指导与实用算法改进。

title: Importance Weighting for Unlabeled-unlabeled Learning under Distribution Shift
summary: Unlabeled-unlabeled (UU) learning allows us to learn a binary classifier from two sets of unlabeled data with different class-priors. It is a general framework because it includes a wide variety of supervised learning such as positive-unlabeled (PU) learning, noisy label learning, and similarity-based learning. Existing UU learning assumes that the test and training distributions have the same class-conditional densities. However, this assumption rarely holds in practice due to distribution shifts. This paper proposes a distribution shift adaptation method for UU learning that uses UU data in the training distribution and a few UU data in the test distribution. The proposed method is based on the importance weighting, which minimizes the test risk by using training data with estimated importance weights. Although existing importance weighting methods cannot handle UU data, we show that it can be done in a principled manner. Thanks to the generality of UU learning, our method can handle various learning problems such as PU and noisy label learning under distribution shift within a single framework while existing methods are usually tailored to a specific problem. Moreover, it does not require any assumption of the shift types such as covariate shift. We experimentally demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method with real-world datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于重要性加权的UU学习分布偏移自适应方法，通过原则性地从UU数据中估计重要性权重，可在单一框架内统一处理PU学习、噪声标签学习等多种弱监督学习场景下的分布偏移问题，且无需假设偏移类型。
AI.motivation: 现有UU学习方法假设训练和测试分布的类条件密度相同，但实际中分布偏移普遍存在（如网络安全中攻击类型随时间演变），导致现有方法性能急剧下降。现有分布偏移自适应方法通常针对特定学习问题（如PN或PU）定制，且常需假设偏移类型（如协变量偏移），而偏移类型从无标签数据中难以辨识。
AI.method: 1. 问题设置：给定训练分布和测试分布各两组具有不同类先验的UU数据（测试分布UU数据量少）。2. 重要性加权UU风险推导：通过类先验将测试风险改写为用UU训练数据表达的重要性加权风险，并采用绝对值校正防止过拟合。3. 基于相对密度比的重要性权重估计：从UU数据中以原则性方式估计相对密度比（重要性权重），通过最小化与UU数据的期望平方误差实现，采用校正函数处理下界问题。4. 分类器损失：测试分布的UU经验风险与训练分布的重要性加权UU经验风险的加权和。6. 训练采用动态方法，交替进行重要性权重估计和分类器学习，共享特征提取器。
AI.result: 在MNIST、FMNIST、CIFAR10和DIABETES四个真实数据集上，针对支持偏移和输入-输出关系偏移两种类型的实验表明，所提方法在几乎所有情况下（7个中有6个）达到最佳或具有竞争力的性能，优于teUU、trUU、mtsUU、mtUU和daUU等基线方法。在训练和测试阶段监督类型不同时（噪声标签+少量PN数据）也表现出色。消融实验验证了重要性权重的有效性，对超参数β和α具有较好的鲁棒性，在带噪声类先验情况下性能稳定。大规模数据集上的实验进一步验证了方法的实用性和可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的重要性加权UU学习方法成功地将重要性加权框架扩展到UU学习场景，能够在统一框架下处理多种弱监督学习问题（PN、PU、噪声标签、相似性学习等）下的分布偏移，且无需假设偏移类型。实验验证了该方法在多种数据集和偏移类型下的有效性与实用性，是首个可原则性地从UU数据中进行重要性加权的工作。

title: Topological Necessities: Mechanism-Invariant Strategic Subgoals for Cross-Embodiment Goal-Conditioned Control
comment: 60 pages total (9-page main text + appendices), 16 figures. Code and data: this https URL
summary: Long-horizon goal-conditioned reinforcement learning delegates control to a high-level module that proposes subgoals, but existing subgoals are implicit byproducts of value functions or latent actions, tied to the executor that produced them. We study a different object: a route-conditioned order of unavoidable stages that every successful executor must traverse, recoverable from offline trajectories and belonging to none of them. Its defining properties are topological: an unskippable stage is a separating set that every admissible path must cross, and a loop in free space forces a route choice. We read the two by homology in dimensions 0 and 1 over a transport-weighted carrier built from successful trajectories, yielding an enumerable gate set with shell-level certificates; the certified gates are what we call topological necessities. Certified gates enter the decision loop as a recursive topological gate hierarchy. Under a fixed, isomorphic free space, the object survives executor replacement: gates frozen on PointMaze data transfer without retraining to Ant and Humanoid, attaining the highest Humanoid aggregate under a unified interface (96.1), with +36.0 over a map-privileged reference on the multi-route task (p=1.4e-5); the planner saturates PointMaze (100+/-0) and matches or exceeds the strongest baselines on AntMaze (giant +22.9) and Kitchen (+15.8/+12.6).

AI.tldr: 提出"拓扑必要性"概念，从离线轨迹中以拓扑方式恢复跨执行器、跨本体共享的必经瓶颈与路由结构，用同调理论（H0 读瓶颈阶、H1 读路由分叉）给出可证证书，并构建递归拓扑门层次结构，在 PointMaze/AntMaze/Kitchen/Humanoid 等基准上实现门集零重训冻结迁移与最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有离线 GCRL 的子目标由值函数或潜在动作隐式生成，与产生它的执行器耦合，导致跨执行器/跨本体迁移时需重新学习。论文希望回答：是否存在与具体执行器无关、可直接从他人成功轨迹中恢复的任务级结构，并使其具备可证伪的证书。
AI.method: 方法核心是"数据诱导载体 + 目标相对几何 + 持续同调读出 + 递归门层次"。(1) 在成功轨迹上构建 kNN 流形图，边权采用"直线性"加权以抑制无任务信号维度（如步态周期），并用密度与三探针双过滤器删去穿墙弦边。(2) 由多源 Dijkstra 得到目标相对径向坐标 r；用等径+等距损失训练整流嵌入 ψ_θ 以稳定地测量壳层横截面。(3) 对 r 的壳层横截面测度作一维亚水平过滤，由 kneedle 肘部规则选出存活谷——H0 读出瓶颈阶，给出可分离证书（T3）；H1 多尺度立方体持续同度则检测承载路由分叉的有界洞。(4) 同一读出递归地作用于相邻门段，得到递归拓扑门层次。(5) 部署侧沿认证轨迹流加密为同分布航点，运行时以门段监控+全局重新锚定。(6) 形式化 T1–T6：图度量与 Eikonal 三元组、传输加权图测地一致性、瓶颈证书、Jacobian 谱隙/有效维数 δ-预测闭合、分布匹配的子目标界面 Wasserstein 界、级联收敛与成功率分解。
AI.result: 在 OGBench（PointMaze 中/大/巨、AntMaze 中/大/巨）与 D4RL FrankaKitchen（partial/mixed）上：PointMaze 三尺寸均饱和 100±0（最强对照 +14～+32）；AntMaze 中/大/巨 96.5/94.4/90.9（巨型 +22.9 over CFHRL，+2.9 over AQM）；Kitchen 80.8/80.3（+15.8/+12.6 over HIQL）。关键跨本体迁移：在 PointMaze 数据上发现的冻结门集零重训迁移至 Humanoid 统一接口得到 96.1 总体，多路由任务 t4 +36.0 于"直接使用地图"对照（p=1.4×10⁻⁵）；Ant 数据上发现并冻结的门集在 Humanoid 上同样可执行（91.0 总体）。持久性分析：四机制网格中瓶颈位置在 6.1–8.5×肘部一致出现；布局扰动显示门集为数据的纯函数（N：18/18 位相同；A/B 移除相应骨架；B 扰动下冻结链崩溃 7.3，重识别恢复 92.0）。监督消除：零标签 PH 颈在接口层匹配监督上界（96.5 vs 94.3）。理论-实验闭合：δ_pred=0.0511 与 δ_emp=0.0483 相差 1.06×，远优于对称高斯（3.6×）、偏斜混合（1.4×）、kNN 边先验（1.14×）等竞争模型；20/20 门均通过保护引理，T5 复发概率在 1.06×因子内匹配测量值。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出并系统化"拓扑必要性"——任务级、与执行器无关、可从离线数据恢复的必经阶段序：通过数据诱导载体、H0/H1 同调读出与递归门层次，给出可证证书（T1–T6）并证伪式预测跨执行器/跨本体稳定性。证据链集中在长时域、多路由任务：冻结门集在 PointMaze→Ant/Humanoid 上零重训迁移均达最高成绩。论断为"任务条件可迁移性"而非"无限制不变性"——瓶颈结构在自由空间固定的范围内对本体保持稳定。未来方向：完全在线递归、与技能/选项发现的集成、更丰富的高阶同调读出。

title: T1: Terminal Agent Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Tasks
summary: Agent usage is shifting toward long-horizon tasks such as coding and scientific discovery, among which terminal tasks are especially important. We introduce T1, a Mixture-of-Experts model of 122B total trained with reinforcement learning, operating a real shell in a cloud sandbox for up to 300+ tool-call turns per task, rewarded by executing each task's own verifier. We provide a comprehensive recipe: First, an aggressively warm-started to stabilize actor-critic training, with a dense process reward scoring trajectories by the absolute number of passing verifiers. Second, stable optimization through TITO construction, training on the exact sampled token identifiers with drift repair at turn boundaries, and rollout routing replay, recording the sampler's per-token expert choices at every MoE layer and replaying them during training. Third, fully out-of-distribution training corpus: isolated seeds and synthesized tasks disjoint from Terminal-Bench 2.1 ensures gains reflect genuine capability transfer over benchmark overfitting. Together, TITO and R3 cut the training-to-inference log-probability difference from 0.021 to 0.013, with exactly aligned zero token drift in the loss region. On Terminal-Bench 2.1, our post-train pipeline raises initial base model from 43.8% to T1 with 64.0% resolved. On Long-Horizon Terminal Bench, T1 reaches 27.9% and surpasses GPT-5.4 and GLM-5.1.

AI.tldr: 本文提出T1，一个122B总参数（10B激活）的MoE终端智能体，通过强化学习在云沙箱中执行真实shell操作，最长支持300+工具调用轮次。核心贡献包括：1）TITO（Token-In-Token-Out）机制保证训练-推理的token一致性；2）R³（Rollout Routing Replay）机制保证MoE专家路由一致性；3）基于每条断言通过数计数的稠密过程奖励设计；4）完全脱离Terminal-Bench 2.1的训练语料。在Terminal-Bench 2.1上从基座43.8%提升至64.0%，在Long-Horizon Terminal Bench上达到27.9%，超越GPT-5.4和GLM-5.1。
AI.motivation: 长horizon智能体任务（如编码、科学发现）对LLM提出新挑战：模型需在有状态环境中执行可被验证的操作，而非仅生成符合偏好的文本。终端任务是这一前沿最严苛的测试场。核心难题有两个：1）稀疏MoE模型训练-推理不一致——专家权重占116B/121.4B参数，离散路由器使微小的数值差异就能翻转专家选择，导致梯度作用于与生成行为不同的子网络；2）二值奖励信号过于稀疏——单次rollout耗费数百沙箱小时，但二值结果只提供1 bit信息，使首次二值奖励实验未能超越监督基线。
AI.method: 1）**TITO（Token-In-Token-Out）**：确保训练器精确消费采样器发出的token标识符，在turn边界进行四种层级修复（strict/normalized/retokenized/split），使loss区域的token drift为0.0000%。2）**R³（Rollout Routing Replay）**：记录推理时每层每个token的专家选择（48×8=1536 B/token，约48 MiB/轨迹），训练时复用该路由掩码但保留对当前路由器梯度的传播。3）**稠密验证奖励**：r=P/S，S=20为全局固定归一化，使用绝对通过断言数而非比例，使不同难度任务的信号可比。4）**Critic Warm-Up**：在TMax-15k上预训练critic一个epoch，critic学习率30倍于actor，使explained variance从-33.6跃升至0.71-0.86区间。5）**三层数据集**：TMax-15k（二值奖励）、RST-38k（38k合成任务）、T1-15k（经8维审计筛选的高质量子集）。6）**内存容量建模**：导出per-device footprint闭式公式，证明专家优化器状态与分片方案无关，仅可通过扩大G减小。7）**上下文并行**：原生序列分片循环算子，使84k/128k上下文墙可行。8）**批量560过采样至512**：截断长尾，减少超时失败。
AI.result: 在Terminal-Bench 2.1（89任务）：基座43.8%→SFT 49.4%→**T1 64.0%**（RL贡献14.6pp，占总增益72.3%）。在Long-Horizon Terminal Bench：18.9→23.6→**27.9**，超越GPT-5.4（27.2）、GLM-5.1（26.7），与Gemini-3.1-Pro持平。在Terminal-Bench Hard：38.0%，超越DeepSeek-V4-Pro（36.0%）。同harness下超越GLM-5.1、Hy3-Preview、DeepSeek-V4-Flash、Kimi-K2.5、Minimax M2.7、GPT-5.4和Claude Sonnet 4.6，仅10B激活参数。TITO+R³将训练-推理log-prob差异从0.021降至0.013，loss区域token drift精确为0。领域细分：调试100.0%、系统管理88.9%、数据处理和ML 100%（但任务数少）。
AI.conclusion: T1证明：通过TITO（token一致性）和R³（路由一致性）双机制解决MoE模型训练-推理失配问题，配合基于执行结果的稠密奖励和完整的critic warm-up调度，可在大规模稀疏模型上稳定训练长horizon智能体。三个关键洞察：1）训练-推理不一致有两个正交轴（token与expert），必须分别解决；2）稠密执行奖励（每条断言绝对计数）优于二值奖励，使部分进展可学；3）专家优化器状态在分片下不变，唯一调节手段是扩大设备预算。RL贡献占总增益72.3%，且在更长horizon任务（LHTB、TBH）上持续有效，证明能力可迁移而非benchmark过拟合。主要遗留问题：GRPO因group baseline在长horizon下退化而被弃用；长尾任务被过采样策略系统性丢弃；2.6%的re-tokenized token存在残余不一致。

title: A Fragility Spectrum for Recursive Language-Model Training
summary: Model-generated text is finding its way back into training corpora, and there is plenty of evidence that training on such data over and over collapses output diversity. Prior work has studied the phenomenon itself: which protocols and which data mixtures cause collapse. But different models behave very differently under the same process. We fix one recursive contamination protocol and let 13 publicly released checkpoints form an ecosystem that shares a common corpus for five generations. The unique 4-gram outcome after five generations ranges from 0.187 to 0.940 across checkpoints, a roughly five-fold spread: some models are barely touched, others degenerate into repetitive fragments. Changing the composition of the shared pool or mixing in human text keeps the Spearman correlation of the ordering at 0.91--0.97, and changing the random seed keeps it at 0.93--0.98. Whether a model collapses easily under recursive training is, then, a property of the checkpoint itself, and one that has gone largely unexamined. Parameter scale alone does not explain it, since a three-size ladder within one family is not monotonic in size, and none of the static indicators we tested predicts it either. What does work is cheap: let a model iterate on its own output for two or three generations, and its fragility in the larger ecosystem can be inferred from that alone. Collapse speed also responds to intervention. Tightening top-p, which cuts the low-probability tail at generation time, nearly stops collapse within three generations and stabilizes six checkpoints spanning the whole spectrum together, while data-side filtering slows collapse without stopping it.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了语言模型在递归自训练（即用前代模型生成的文本训练下一代）中表现出的"脆弱性光谱"现象。通过对比13个公开的1-4B基础模型检查点，发现相同污染协议会导致五倍的多样性差异，挑战了以往研究中将模型视为可互换的隐含假设。
AI.motivation: 随着合成文本在训练数据中的占比不断攀升（2025年中期估计达30-40%），模型坍缩（model collapse）现象日益受到关注。已有研究主要关注协议和数据配比对坍缩的影响，但默认不同模型在相同过程中的行为是可互换的。本文质疑这一假设，检验不同检查点是否在递归训练中以系统性的不同方式坍缩。
AI.method: 构建13个1-4B参数的开源基础模型生态系统，每个模型贡献文本到同一共享池，然后基于该池进行全参数微调，每代都从干净的预训练权重重新初始化，共运行五代。控制变量仅为起始检查点。还设计了自循环链（仅基于自身输出训练）和采样干预实验（top-p、温度调节）以及数据侧过滤（去重、困惑度门控）。主要衡量指标为生成文本的唯一4-gram比例（u4）。
AI.result: 1. **稳定的脆弱性光谱**：13个检查点在五代后的u4值从0.187到0.940不等（约5倍跨度），排序在更换主导成员、混合人类文本、改变随机种子时保持稳定（Spearman相关0.91-0.98）；2. **参数规模不具预测性**：Qwen3 0.6B/1.7B/4B的同族规模阶梯呈现非单调结果，1.7B最稳健；3. **递归前指标均失败**：静态校准误差、初始输出统计、一次普通微调引起的偏移等指标与最终结果的相关性均低于0.4；4. **自循环可低成本筛选**：2-3代自循环即可获得生态系统排序的近似（0.599-0.676）；5. **采样尾端控制可显著减缓坍缩**：收紧top-p至0.8使三代内几乎停止坍缩，而开放尾端加速坍缩；数据侧过滤仅减缓而非阻止。延迟启动者（late starters）的坍缩模式表现为静止期后的雪崩式崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 坍缩脆弱性是检查点的一个稳定但先前未被充分关注的属性。在相同的递归环境中，不同检查点的最终结果差异显著。参数规模本身无法解释该属性，且在递归开始前几乎不可见。单模型自循环可在2-3代内以低成本识别脆弱性，而通过控制在生成时截断低概率尾端（采样侧干预）可有效调控坍缩速度。该研究主张坍缩实验应明确披露起始检查点的版本信息。

title: (Whose defaults?) Is artificial intelligence reorienting archaeological methods?
summary: Generative AI and the practice of "vibe coding" are changing how archaeologists carry out computational research, but their effects on the discipline's range of methods is still understudied. In this paper, we evaluate whether large language models (LLMs) are narrowing the variety of methods archaeologists use. We first analysed approximately 119,000 archaeology abstracts from Scopus, covering publications from 2010 to 2025. Using a locally run LLM, we identified the computational methods reported in each abstract and organised them into 25 broad categories (L2) and 241 finer clusters (L3). A Bayesian Dirichlet-multinomial model of method composition within sub-disciplines found a small but credible shift in method use after 2023. However, this shift was smaller than the variation already present across the full study period. No individual technique showed a significant change, and overall methodological diversity increased rather than declined. We then ran a controlled experiment to see whether LLMs recommend a narrower set of methods than archaeologists have used in practice. Two different open-weight models were asked to suggest methods for 28 archaeological research problems, with prompts providing three levels of methodological guidance: novice, intermediate, and expert. Recommendation diversity was much lower than in the published literature, particularly without methodological guidance. The models also tended to favour methods that were widely used before 2023, and their recommendations more closely resembled the post-2023 literature. Taken together, these results are consistent with LLMs pushing methodological choice towards convergence, although our study cannot establish a causal effect. They raise a broader question: how can archaeology retain methodological diversity as LLMs become more involved in research?

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析约11.9万篇Scopus考古学摘要(2010–2025)并结合控制实验,测试LLM是否正在收窄考古学的计算方法多样性。文献计量结果显示2023年后方法多样性实际增加,但LLM实验显示其推荐的方法范围显著窄于文献,且倾向推荐2023年前已有的常用方法。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI与"vibe coding"正在改变考古学计算研究实践,但其对该学科方法范围的影响尚未得到系统研究。作者旨在检验"均值坍缩"假设——即LLM是否会通过推荐训练数据中最常见的"默认"方法,导致考古学方法选择趋于同质化。
AI.method: 采用双重证据路径:(1)文献计量流——对约11.9万篇Scopus考古学摘要,用本地运行的Qwen3.5-9B提取计算方法,构建三层分类法(L1=7个主题域,L2=25个操作类别,L3=241个数据驱动簇),用贝叶斯分层Dirichlet-Multinomial回归模型检测2023年后方法构成的偏移;(2)LLM实验流——以Qwen3.5-9B和Gemma 4 E4B两个开源模型,针对28个标准化考古学问题,在新手/中级/专家三种提示条件下推荐方法,通过逆Simpson指数衡量集中度,并用贝叶斯负二项回归检验推荐频次与文献流行度的关系。
AI.result: 文献方面:Dirichlet-Multinomial模型显示2023年后方法构成的偏移σγ可信地大于零,但仅为基线长期异质性σβ的约1/2.35;无单一L3方法发生可信变化;有效方法数从87.6增至111.2,多样性实际上升。LLM实验方面:两个模型推荐的有效方法数约为文献的三分之一,新手提示下仅约21种(约为文献的四分之一);负二项回归显示方法被推荐的频次与其2023年前的文献流行度强正相关(尤以新手提示最强,Qwen β=1.039),而与2023年后趋势无关;分布相似性测试显示LLM推荐更接近2023年后的文献分布。
AI.conclusion: 结果与"LLM推动方法选择趋同"的假设一致,但趋同效应目前仍属"潜在"状态,尚未在已发表文献中显现。研究无法建立因果关系。论文提出"外化"与"绕过"知识的区分作为核心理论贡献,主张LLM应作为推理过程中的基础设施工具而非替代研究者的认知责任,呼吁加强对AI辅助编码的学术治理与批判性使用。

title: Solving Few-Shot Multiobjective Multitask Optimization via Iterative Sequential Transfer
summary: Applying knowledge transfer across multiple optimization tasks, multitask optimization (MTO) emerges as a promising approach to solving synergistic optimization tasks simultaneously. However, the development of effective knowledge transfer mechanisms in MTO fundamentally relies on aligning elite solution distributions across tasks. This dependency creates a critical bottleneck in few-shot optimization regimes, as restricted evaluation budgets impede the identification of elite solution distributions required for beneficial transfer. This challenge is exacerbated in multiobjective multitask problems, where each optimizer must approximate a continuous Pareto manifold rather than a single optimal point. This paper introduces Iterative Sequential Transfer (IST) to circumvent this bottleneck. We model MTO as a sequence of sequential transfer optimization problems, concentrating evaluations on a single target per iteration. We propose a likelihood-informed task prioritization mechanism to maximize transfer utility by identifying the task most likely ready for knowledge integration. Empirical results on benchmark and real-world problems verify the effectiveness of the proposed method under tight budgets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种迭代序列迁移（IST）框架，将多任务优化（MTO）建模为一系列序列迁移优化（STrO）问题，通过基于似然的任务优先级机制在每次迭代中集中评估单个目标任务，以解决少样本多目标多任务优化中由于评估预算有限而难以对齐精英解分布所导致的负迁移瓶颈问题。
AI.motivation: 传统多任务优化（MTO）的知识迁移效果依赖于跨任务精英解分布的对齐，但在少样本（few-shot）优化场景下，严格的评估预算被分散到所有任务，导致难以识别高质量解分布，从而引发停滞搜索或负迁移。这一问题在多目标场景中更为突出，因为优化器需近似连续Pareto流形而非单一点。
AI.method: 提出迭代序列迁移（IST）框架，将MTO转化为序列STrO问题序列：1）初始化时各任务进行少量评估；2）每次迭代通过基于MTGP任务核参数的似然驱动任务优先级函数φ(t)=min_{i≠t}κ_T(i,t)选择最有可能从知识整合中受益的目标任务；3）使用Softmax松弛的随机优先级策略避免任务冻结；4）基于F-invTrEMO（前向-逆向MTGP迁移优化器）执行序列迁移优化，采用分解Tchebycheff标量化与因子化MTGP避免源任务偏差。
AI.result: 在9个MOMTO基准问题（CILS和PILS除外）上，F-invTrEMO-IST在14个任务中的12个上优于F-invTrEMO；在真实世界多任务超参数优化问题（HPO-1、HPO-2）上全面优于基线；将IST集成至AMTEA后生成AMTEA-IST，在11/14任务上优于AMTEA，验证了框架的通用性。
AI.conclusion: IST框架通过将MTO建模为序列STrO问题，有效缓解了少样本多目标多任务优化中负迁移和资源分散问题，为传统MTO与序列迁移优化算法之间搭建了桥梁，在严格预算下展现出有效性与通用性。

title: E-CONAN (Entailment, CONtradition And Neutral) Benchmarks: Arabic Textual Entailment and Natural Inference Datasets
summary: Natural Language Inference processes pairs of sentences to extract their semantic relations. NLI has been a hot research topic, integrated as a main component in other NLP applications. Despite significant advancements in textual inference across various languages all around the world, Arabic language still suffers from limited resources in this domain. To address this gap, this paper introduces E-CONAN benchmarks that are composed of sentences pairs from various sources: (1) automatically-translated pairs, (2) human-validated machine-translated pairs, (3) hand-crafted pairs from teaching Arabic as foreign language books, and (4) headlines pairs from different news channels containing rumors. E-CONAN contains two benchmark datasets, E-CONAN-2, a 2-way dataset (RTE) and E-CONAN-3, a 3-way dataset (NLI). Additionally, we have used E-CONAN benchmarks to evaluate 9 state-of-the-art multilingual pretrained models using zero-shot classification. Models were evaluated across the ArNLI, XNLI, and E-CONAN datasets. Results show that E-CONAN is a potentially valuable resource for evaluating model generalization and even for fine-tuning pre-trained models. Its diverse composition, derived from a combination of sources, offers a broader and more robust assessment compared to XNLI and ArNLI. In addition, we have evaluated 5 LLMs on E-CONAN-3 dataset. Moreover, we incorporated MARBERT as a representative Arabic-specific baseline and conducted performance evaluation comparison to demonstrate how Arabic-specific models scale against cross-lingual and LLM-based approaches on the E-CONAN benchmarks. Furthermore, we conducted detailed qualitative and quantitative error analysis to analyze frequent error patterns. E-CONAN benchmarks will be publicly available, we hope that it will enrich research community in Arabic textual entailment and natural language inference.

AI.tldr: 本文针对阿拉伯语自然语言推理（NLI）资源匮乏的问题，提出了E-CONAN基准数据集，包含机器翻译、人工校验、教科书手工编写及新闻谣言标题等多种来源的句子对，并划分为二分类（RTE）和三分类（NLI）两个版本。通过对9个多语言预训练模型的零样本评估及与阿拉伯语专用模型、大语言模型的对比分析，验证了E-CONAN在评估模型泛化能力方面的价值。
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯语在自然语言推理领域缺乏高质量、多样化的基准资源，现有数据集（如ArNLI、XNLI）规模和多样性不足，限制了阿拉伯语NLI研究的进展和模型泛化能力的评估。
AI.method: 构建E-CONAN基准数据集，包含四个来源：(1)自动翻译句子对；(2)人工校验的机器翻译对；(3)阿拉伯语教材中手工编写的句子对；(4)不同新闻渠道的谣言标题对。数据集分为E-CONAN-2（二分类RTE）和E-CONAN-3（三分类NLI）。采用零样本分类方法评估9个多语言预训练模型，并与ArNLI、XNLI进行对比；同时引入MARBERT作为阿拉伯语专用基线，并在E-CONAN-3上评估5个大语言模型（LLM），进行定性和定量错误分析。
AI.result: E-CONAN数据集公开可用，包含多样化的句子对来源。在零样本评估中，多语言预训练模型表现各异，E-CONAN相比XNLI和ArNLI提供了更广泛和更稳健的评估。阿拉伯语专用模型MARBERT与跨语言及LLM方法的性能对比显示其在该基准上的表现特征。详细错误分析揭示了常见的错误模式。
AI.conclusion: E-CONAN基准是阿拉伯语文本蕴含和自然语言推理研究的有价值资源，其多样化来源有助于更全面地评估模型泛化能力和微调预训练模型，有望推动阿拉伯语NLI研究社区的发展。

title: On the Impact of Anonymization on the Performance of Large Language Models
summary: As large language models are increasingly deployed in sensitive domains, anonymizing input data to protect personally identifiable information has become a critical practice. However, the impact of this anonymization on model utility is not well understood. This paper presents a systematic empirical study of the trade-off between privacy and performance. We evaluate five prominent language models across eleven diverse benchmarks, comparing their performance on original versus pseudonymized inputs. Our results reveal that while anonymization generally degrades performance, the effect is highly nuanced. We find that more capable models, such as Qwen2.5-72B and GPT-4o mini, suffer the largest performance drops, suggesting a stronger reliance on specific entity information. The impact is also task-dependent: performance on TruthfulQA improves with anonymization, while retrieval-focused tasks like RGB experience a catastrophic decline. Further experiments show that reversible anonymization techniques that preserve entity uniqueness significantly outperform irreversible ones like redaction, and that explicitly prompting models about anonymization offers no discernible benefit. We conclude that anonymization is not a one-size-fits-all solution and must be co-designed with the model and task in mind to balance privacy and utility effectively. Our findings provide a crucial baseline for developing more robust, privacy-aware AI systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统性地研究了大语言模型（LLM）在输入数据匿名化前后的性能变化，评估了5个模型在11个基准测试上的表现，揭示了隐私保护与模型效用之间的复杂权衡关系。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM在医疗、法律、金融等敏感领域的广泛应用，输入数据的匿名化（保护个人可识别信息PII）成为关键实践。然而，匿名化对模型性能的影响尚未得到系统理解，隐私与效用之间的权衡缺乏实证依据。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个模块化实验流水线，包括数据准备、匿名化、模型推理、反匿名化（评估时将占位符映射回原始PII）、评估和结果聚合六个阶段。实验对比了5个LLM（GPT-4o mini、Teuken-7B、Llama-3.1-8B、Gemma-2-27B、Qwen2.5-72B）在11个基准测试（ARC、BIG-Bench Hard、EQ-Bench、HellaSwag、IFEval、MedQA、MMLU-PRO、MUSR、RGB、TruthfulQA、WMT 2014）上的表现。主要采用伪匿名化策略（保留实体唯一性，如"London"→"<LOC>-1"），并对比了泛化、掩码、随机化、编辑四种替代技术。此外，还测试了在提示中显式告知模型输入已匿名化的效果。温度参数设为0以确保确定性。
AI.result: 1）模型能力与匿名化鲁棒性呈负相关：更强的模型（Qwen2.5-72B和GPT-4o mini）基线性能最高，但匿名化后性能下降最大（平均下降6.9个百分点），表明其更依赖具体实体信息。2）任务敏感性差异巨大：TruthfulQA上所有模型性能均提升（减少幻觉），而RGB（检索增强生成）性能灾难性下降（GPT-4o mini从0.80降至0.32，约降48个百分点）。3）技术差异显著：保留实体唯一性的可逆技术（伪匿名化、随机化、掩码）显著优于不可逆技术（编辑、泛化）。4）显式提示模型输入已匿名化未带来明显性能提升。5）性能下降与实体数量、输入长度无显著统计相关性，说明影响是任务特异性的。
AI.conclusion: 匿名化并非"一刀切"的解决方案，必须与模型和任务协同设计。需要在隐私保护与模型效用之间寻求平衡。未来研究方向包括：更细粒度的匿名化控制（根据任务需求选择性针对实体类型）、开发对PII移除天然鲁棒的模型、或通过微调使模型理解匿名化表示。本研究为开发更稳健的隐私感知AI系统提供了重要基线。

title: Reification as a Transferable Vocabulary: Zero-Shot Link Prediction with Vanilla GNNs
summary: Knowledge graph foundation models such as ULTRA achieve zero-shot link prediction on unseen graphs through dedicated architectures that hard-code a transfer mechanism. In this work we move that mechanism out of the architecture and into the representation, by \emph{reifying} the input graph: every fact becomes a node, connected to its subject, object, and relation type through a fixed vocabulary of six meta-relations, with relation types as anonymous shared nodes rather than model parameters. On this representation, five textbook GNNs (GAT, GINE with sum and with mean+max aggregation, GraphSAGE, R-GCN), each trained on a single knowledge graph of 4,245 triples for 30 minutes on one NVIDIA A100, transfer zero-shot to 40 inductive link-prediction benchmarks. The best of them, an off-the-shelf GAT, matches ULTRA, a dedicated foundation model pretrained on three graphs, across ULTRA's own evaluation suite. The same fixed vocabulary extends to relational databases, a row becoming an entity and a foreign-key column a relation type; a preliminary probe on two unseen databases, with no cell values, schema text or in-context labels, shows a model of this family pretrained on three knowledge graphs ranking foreign-key targets far above random-initialization and degree controls. We release the code, the checkpoints, and the evaluation pipeline for all 40 benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将知识图谱物化（reification）作为跨数据集共享的结构化词汇表，使通用GNN无需专用架构即可实现零样本链接预测。开源GAT在40个基准上匹配专用基础模型ULTRA。
AI.motivation: 现有知识图谱基础模型（KGFMs）如ULTRA通过专用架构硬编码迁移机制，无法同时覆盖KG和关系数据库；本文旨在将迁移机制从架构层下沉到表征层，寻找一种跨数据集、跨数据模型的统一词汇表。
AI.method: 物化每个事实为节点，通过6个固定元关系连接主语/宾语/关系类型；关系类型变为匿名共享节点。五种通用GNN（GAT、GINE-sum、GINE-mean+max、GraphSAGE、R-GCN）采用查询条件初始化（标记技巧），在单一4245三元组KG上训练30分钟后零样本迁移。
AI.result: 最佳模型GAT在40个基准上平均MRR 0.3565，与ULTRA（0.3732）接近；在双方均未见过的13个家族上几乎持平（0.3600 vs 0.3617）。同一词汇表可读取关系数据库，3-KG预训练模型在两个未见数据库的外键预测上显著优于随机初始化和度启发式。
AI.conclusion: 零样本归纳链接预测不依赖专用架构，而依赖统一词汇表；物化提供了这一词汇表。该方法在单一小KG上训练的通用GNN即可与专用KGFM竞争，并初步展现跨数据模型迁移能力。多图预训练混合与KG+数据库联合训练是未来方向。

title: Characterizing Bluesky Content Moderation Service: From Automation of Service to Landscape of Harms
comment: 18 pages, 7 figures, 12 tables. Accepted for publication at ICWSM 2027
summary: Empirical research on content moderation is fundamentally constrained by the opaque deployment of moderation systems on major social media platforms. To this end, the recent emergence of decentralized platforms with transparent, public moderation logs presents an unprecedented opportunity for independent audits. In this work, we leverage this architectural transparency to conduct the first large-scale audit of the default moderation system on Bluesky, the Bluesky Moderation Service (BMS). Analyzing its 10.6M moderation labels from 2025, we investigate three foundational aspects: (i) its mechanism (the degree of automation versus human oversight), (ii) its efficacy (accuracy in detecting harms), and (iii) its purpose (the landscape of harms it identifies). Our findings reveal a human-AI collaborative system where labels for sexual and graphic content are applied automatically in seconds, while nuanced and high stakes labels require more human oversight, taking hours or days. Through a manual annotation study, we find the BMS operates with high precision (0.837), but struggles with low recall (0.222), with our annotators identifying 4.5$\times$ more harmful content than the moderation system in a random sample. Finally, unsupervised clustering of the most frequently applied labeled posts uncovers detected harms ranging from hostility in discourse toward protected groups to the spread of sexually explicit and other graphic content. Our work offers a look into the operational realities of a deployed moderation system, providing a concrete data-driven foundation for designing more effective and transparent moderation systems.

AI.tldr: 本文对Bluesky平台的默认内容审核服务（BMS）进行了首次大规模审计，分析了2025年共10.6M条审核标签数据，从自动化程度、检测效能和危害类别三个维度对部署的内容审核系统进行系统性表征。
AI.motivation: 主流社交媒体平台的内容审核系统因不透明部署而难以独立审计，尽管欧盟《数字服务法》（DSA）等法规要求提高透明度，但平台报告仍存在不充分问题。去中心化平台Bluesky基于AT协议提供公开的审核日志，为独立审计带来新契机。
AI.method: 利用Bluesky AT协议的公开标签流（com.atproto.label.subscribeLabels）采集2025年全年BMS标签数据（共10,681,824条可获取的帖子标签）。以"标注延迟"作为自动化vs人工审核的经验代理指标；通过1000条标注样本和1000条随机样本的人工标注评估精确率与召回率；复现Automod+Hive AI管道分析自动化审核盲区；使用Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B生成多模态嵌入，经UMAP降维+HDBSCAN聚类，并基于Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct的map-reduce摘要管道生成聚类描述与名称。
AI.result: 1）机制层面：BMS呈现人机协作双管道，porn/sexual/graphic-media等标签以秒级自动应用（porn中位数延迟5.5s），而intolerant/rude/threat等需人工审核（rude中位数8.4天）；2）效能层面：整体精确率高（0.837，自动化标签0.903，人工标签0.755），但召回率低（0.222），人工标注员在随机样本中发现的内容是BMS的4.5倍，自动化管道漏检的近阈值与规则集外内容是主要盲区；3）危害层面：聚类揭示涵盖针对受保护群体的敌意、性别与宗教歧视言论、对政治人物的暴力死亡威胁、色情与性化内容、自我伤害内容等，与DSA第34条系统性风险类别对应。
AI.conclusion: 研究展示了一种基于架构透明性对实际部署的内容审核系统进行系统性审计的方法，揭示了基于规则的人工智能审核系统的脆弱性（硬编码阈值与固定头部导致漏检），为未来更有效、更透明的内容审核系统设计提供了数据驱动基础，并倡导跨平台的审核分析协作机制。

title: Agent-Integrated Software: Interaction Contracts and Continuous Assurance
summary: Embedding an intelligent agent in an existing application creates a persistent coordination problem: users can revise goals and manipulate shared objects while delegated execution continues. We argue that dependable integration requires an explicit correspondence between task-level interaction and application behavior. We introduce Agent-Integrated Software (AIS) as a software pattern combining a conventional core, direct interaction, and a built-in agent, and Intent-Level Interaction Abstraction (IIA) as the task semantics through which users inspect and control delegated work. An open transition-system model relates AIS execution to IIA states and events. Interaction contracts constrain this relation through task bindings, role-specific authority, control transitions, and outcome evidence; continuous assurance maintains scoped claims as their dependencies change. A compact disclosure contract and conditional propositions illustrate why local component validity is insufficient and how selected admission invariants can be separated from planning. Contrasting software domains expose the framework's assumptions and limits. This perspective develops a research agenda spanning application abstraction, development support, controlled execution, quality assessment, and human supervision, with the aim of making agent integration a maintainable software engineering discipline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"代理集成软件(AIS)"模式与"意图级交互抽象(IIA)",通过交互契约与持续保障机制,显式地建立用户委托任务与应用程序行为之间的对应关系,使智能体集成成为可维护的软件工程学科。
AI.motivation: 将语言模型智能体嵌入现有应用后,用户可在智能体执行委托任务的同时继续编辑共享对象,产生持久的协调难题。传统组件级正确性(API调用合法、权限认证通过)不足以保证委托工作与用户意图的对应关系,亟需一种将任务级交互与应用行为显式关联的工程化方法。
AI.method: 1. **AIS执行模型**:开放标签迁移系统 M = ⟨X, X₀, Σ, ⟶⟩,区分GUI操作(G)、意图级命令(I)、智能体步骤(A)与环境事件(E)四类标签,状态分解为(s, t, c, j, w)。2. **IIA规范**:抽象迁移系统 I = ⟨Y, Y₀, Λ, ⟹, V⟩,通过抽象函数π:X→Y和α:Σ→Λ∪{ε}与AIS关联,核心关系为π(X₀)⊆Y₀且每步满足任务级解释。3. **交互契约** K = ⟨Pre, Step, Inv, Post, Dep⟩约束任务绑定、角色权限、控制迁移与结果证据。4. **持续保障**:将声明记录为 A = ⟨q, Ω, D, E, R, S⟩,通过依赖变更驱动的选择性重新评估维护Q1-Q5五类范围化声明。5. **域探针**:在协作、电子表格、IDE、服务控制台四个领域实例化契约。
AI.result: 1. 命题2.3证明局部组件有效性不足以建立交互一致性(GUI修订后旧批准仍可能通过API)。2. 命题4.1证明"计划器无关的接纳安全性":可信门控原子执行接纳谓词可独立保证K1-K3成立,与计划器选择无关。3. 范例Contract 1形式化"会议材料审查披露"场景,分解为K1端点绑定、K2当前权限、K3受控接纳、K4结果保真四条不变式。4. 导出八条工程含义(C1-C8)、四条设计原则(P1-P4)、六项研究方向(R1-R6),通过Table 5与26个非加权连接形成系统化研究议程。
AI.conclusion: 可信赖的智能体集成需要在可修订的任务意图与应用行为之间维持持续的对应关系。AIS/IIA框架、交互契约与持续保障构成一种使代理集成成为可维护软件工程学科的概念基础。其核心贡献在于将交互-效果义务(绑定、权限、控制、证据)显式化为跨组件边界的可规范、可验证对象,但实际工程价值仍需通过比较性工程与人因研究加以验证。

title: Buyer Artificial Intelligence-Enabled Environmental Governance and Supplier Environmental Controversies: An Organizational Information Processing and Signaling
summary: Environmental controversies in global supply chains pose significant risks for global buyers. This study examines whether overseas suppliers' exposure to buyers' artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled environmental governance reduces supplier environmental controversies. Drawing on organizational information processing theory and signaling theory, we investigate how suppliers' exposure to AI-enabled governance influences their environmental controversies and the institutional contingencies under which this effect varies. Using text analysis to measure buyer AI-enabled environmental governance, we analyze panel data on 2,505 suppliers of U.S.-listed firms across 41 countries from 2020 to 2024 with multidimensional fixed-effects models. We find that suppliers' exposure to buyer AI-enabled environmental governance is negatively associated with supplier environmental controversies in the following year. This negative relationship is stronger in supplier countries with higher AI readiness and regulatory quality. The study contributes to research on AI-enabled sustainability governance and sustainable supply chain risk management.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨全球买方的AI环境治理对海外供应商环境争议的影响及其制度条件。研究发现，供应商接触买方AI环境治理显著降低了其后续年度的环境争议，且在AI准备度和监管质量更高的国家效果更强。
AI.motivation: 全球供应链中的环境争议给买方带来重大风险。现有研究对买方如何利用AI技术进行可持续性治理以减少供应链环境风险理解不足，亟需探究AI赋能的环境治理对供应商环境行为的影响机制及边界条件。
AI.method: 基于组织信息处理理论和信号理论，采用文本分析方法测量买方AI环境治理程度，利用2020-2024年41个国家2,505家美国上市公司供应商的面板数据，运用多维固定效应模型进行实证检验。
AI.result: 供应商接触买方AI环境治理与其下一年度环境争议呈显著负相关；该负向关系在供应商所在国AI准备度和监管质量更高时更强。
AI.conclusion: 本研究丰富了AI赋能可持续性治理与可持续供应链风险管理的研究，为全球买方利用AI技术降低供应链环境风险提供了理论依据和实践启示，强调了制度环境对AI治理效果的调节作用。

title: SWRouter: Similarity-Contractive Window Routing for Multi-Turn Large Language Model Conversations
summary: Large language models exhibit complementary strengths, motivating routing methods that dispatch each query to the most suitable model. Although existing routers are effective in single-turn settings, they do not directly transfer to multi-turn dialogue, where routing performance critically depends on how historical context is segmented, retained, and incorporated into the current prompt. This introduces two fundamental challenges: preventing information loss and information confusion during context construction, and evaluating routing quality without conflating model selection with prompt construction quality. In this paper, we propose SWRouter, a Similarity-Contractive Window Router for multi-turn large language model routing. SWRouter combines a similarity-based context segmentation mechanism for prompt construction with a dual-metric evaluation framework that decouples construction accuracy from router performance. Experiments on multi-turn dialogue benchmarks demonstrate that SWRouter consistently surpasses strong baselines, achieving a 16.26% improvement in evaluation accuracy over the best individual large language model and an additional 8.22% gain over the Conv-ID Context baseline. Our results highlight that multi-turn large language model routing requires a joint design of context construction and evaluation, rather than a direct extension of single-turn routing methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SWRouter，一种面向多轮对话场景的大语言模型路由框架。其核心思想是：多轮路由的性能不仅取决于模型选择，还取决于如何从对话历史中构建有效的提示。因此，SWRRouter包含两个关键设计：(1)基于语义相似度的窗口划分机制，通过计算相邻用户轮次之间的余弦相似度，动态地将对话历史分割成语义连贯的窗口，从而避免信息丢失和信息混淆；(2)解耦的评估框架，包含三个互补指标——评估准确率（路由响应质量）、构建准确率（所有候选模型的平均得分）和路由性能（评估准确率与构建准确率之比），将提示构建质量与模型选择能力分开衡量。在ShareGPT和MTBench上的实验表明，SWRouter相比最强单LLM提升16.26%，相比Conv-ID Context基线提升8.22%，在分布外任务上也具有更好的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM路由方法（如RouterDC、ZOOTER、C2MAB-V等）在单轮场景中表现良好，但直接迁移到多轮对话时面临两个根本性挑战：(1)缺乏上下文分割机制——不当处理对话历史会导致信息丢失（关键历史被丢弃）和信息混淆（过时上下文被错误带入）；(2)评估中的归因偏差——最终响应质量由提示构建和模型选择共同决定，仅观察路由结果无法区分增益来源，导致对路由性能的评估不忠实。因此，多轮LLM路由需要联合设计上下文构建与评估机制。
AI.method: 方法包括三个阶段：(1)相似度窗口划分：使用mDeBERTaV3-base编码器计算相邻用户轮次的余弦相似度，通过阈值τ=0.91动态决定合并或新建语义窗口，仅保留与当前查询语义相关的历史轮次；(2)路由训练：采用可插拔路由器骨架，将上下文增强提示编码后与可学习候选模型嵌入计算余弦相似度得到路由分布，使用sample-LLM对比损失（区分高低分模型）和sample-sample对比损失（对齐语义相关提示）联合优化；(3)解耦评估：报告评估准确率（路由选中模型的真实得分）、构建准确率（所有候选模型在构建提示下的平均得分）和路由性能（前者与后者之比），将提示质量与路由选择能力分离衡量。候选模型池包含7个7B/8B开源LLM，训练数据来自ShareGPT和MTBench。
AI.result: 在ShareGPT和MTBench上的主要结果：SWRouter平均评估准确率达40.89%，相比最强单LLM（dolphin-2.9-llama3-8b，24.63%）提升16.26%，相比Conv-ID Context基线提升8.22%。在分布外任务（PreAlgebra、MBPP、C-EVAL）上，SWRouter平均优于Conv-ID Context 2.68%，其中PreAlgebra提升10.10%、MBPP提升4.28%。消融实验表明相似度窗口是最关键组件（MTBench上移除后性能下降46.57%），两个对比损失均提供稳定增益。敏感性分析确认τ=0.91为最佳阈值。计算开销方面，相似度计算仅占总推理时间的约0.22%，token成本仅为Conv-ID Context的1.23倍。解耦分析表明性能增益主要来自构建准确率的提升，同时路由性能始终大于1验证了模型选择的有效性。
AI.conclusion: SWRouter证明多轮LLM路由不能简单视为单轮路由的直接扩展，而需要联合设计上下文构建与评估机制。相似度窗口划分机制有效缓解了信息丢失和信息混淆问题，解耦的评估框架使研究者能够准确区分提示构建质量与路由选择能力对最终性能的贡献。实验在多个数据集和分布外场景中验证了该框架的有效性和泛化性。未来工作可扩展至更大规模或闭源LLM的异构模型池。

title: Prevalence Determines Precision:Silent Contamination in Detector-Defined Datasets
summary: Many ML datasets are constructed by running a detector, heuristic, or model over candidate pools; accepted items become labels. Dataset precision is then governed by true-positive prevalence in each pool via Bayes, not solely by detector quality. Using one instrument and period, we hold a detector-defined event dataset plus an independent official index labeling every detected item as real or phantom. One detector, three pools yield phantom rates 81.7%, 9.0%, and 0.0%. Transferring precision from the two high-rate pools to the low-rate pool predicts 0.955 versus measured 0.183, a +422% error; the Bayes expression predicts all three within 3.3%. The detected response curve is an exact convex combination of a true-event and a phantom component (residual 1.1e-16), with phantoms outnumbering true events 473 to 308, so contamination is a second signal with detector-inherited shape, not additive noise. Contamination direction depends on the estimator: on identical windows one statistic is diluted and another inflated because its denominator is also contaminated. A common normalization turns the estimator into a mean of ratios whose expectation need not exist; on the same 335 events it returns 0.40 where the well-defined estimator returns 0.10.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究检测器定义数据集中的"幻象污染"问题，即机器学习数据集通过检测器从候选池中接受项目来构造时，其精度由真实正例的流行率π通过贝叶斯公式决定，而非仅由检测器质量决定。通过E-mini标普500期货的真实案例（一个检测器在三个不同候选池上部署），论文证明：（1）流行率变化导致精度从1.000暴跌至0.183；（2）污染曲线可精确分解为真实事件和幻象成分的凸组合；（3）污染方向取决于估计器选择（稀释或膨胀）；（4）按项归一化估计器期望不存在，导致0.40与0.10的差异。
AI.motivation: 检测器定义的数据集（弱监督、远程监督、伪标签、事件检测等）普遍存在，但检测器输出的精度通常被错误地视为检测器本身的属性而非部署池的属性。论文指出：在高流行率π≈1的池中验证检测器几乎无法提供关于低流行率部署时的FPR信息；这是结构性的，因为数据集内部的假阳性无法被识别。论文需要一个能同时获取检测器输出和独立官方标签的设置来端到端测量这一机制。
AI.method: 论文使用E-mini标普500期货（2010-2026，1秒分辨率）作为测试平台。设置两组独立索引：（1）由幅度阈值检测器在三个不同候选池（FOMC日历、首周五、每月6-16日工作日）上产生的检测索引；（2）独立官方索引（CPI、非农就业、FOMC声明，555个事件），每个检测项可被分类为真实或幻象。提出五个报告量：π、TPR、FPR、幻象质量分数c、幻象-真实强度比ρ。推导混合恒等式D^det(τ)=(1-c)D_E(τ)+cρD_P(τ)/((1-c)+cρ)，证明估计器D̃（每项用r_i(τ_ref)归一化）的期望不存在。通过预注册协议进行自我验证，并诚实记录六个管道事故（包括未缩放z-score、FOMC时间错误、位置索引bug等）。
AI.result: 核心测量：同一检测器在FOMC池π=1.000（幻象率0.0%）、NFP池π=0.82（幻象率9.0%）、CPI池π=0.105（幻象率81.7%）上产生三个定性不同的数据集。从高流行率池到低流行率池天真地传递精度预测0.955 vs 测量0.183（误差+422%）；贝叶斯公式预测0.177（误差-3.3%）。混合分解验证至机器精度（残差1.1×10^-16），n_E=308, n_P=473, c=0.606, ρ=0.59。终端归一化统计下污染膨胀（S(τ)下则稀释）。无界估计器D̃(5s)=0.3997 vs D(5s)=0.1020。预注册后测得D(5s)=0.068，未达到快速价格发现效应声明阈值（≥0.30），因此放弃该声明。
AI.conclusion: 检测器定义的数据集精度不是检测器属性，而是部署池的属性。天真地在高流行率池验证后部署到低流行率池会产生灾难性的精度传递误差（+422%），而贝叶斯公式能在3.3%内正确预测。污染不是加性噪声，而是与真实信号具有相似形状的第二信号，继承了检测器接受规则的形状。污染效应的方向取决于估计器（稀释还是膨胀），使"污染会衰减效应"的常见辩护站不住脚。某些常用的归一化估计器（如每项用r(τ_ref)归一化）数学上无有限期望，导致沉默但严重的偏差。论文提出七条报告协议规则，强调在部署池中验证、报告五个关键量、提供分析零假设。

title: Cross-Lingual Clinical Annotation Projection as Constrained Text Generation: A Six-Language Study
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables, submitted to journal
summary: Background: To determine whether cross-lingual clinical annotation projection can be formulated as a text-preserving, document-level generative task that produces verifiable character-level annotations for multilingual clinical corpus construction, and to characterize its robustness and computational trade-offs relative to candidate-based projection pipelines. Methods: We developed a constrained LLM projection workflow that inserts entity tags directly into immutable target-language text, followed by deterministic validation and character-offset reconstruction. We evaluated it alongside supervised candidate-span projection and hybrid ML-LLM refinement for transferring Spanish Disease, Symptom, and Procedure annotations into six languages. Evaluation used MultiClinAI gold standard with strict span matching and character-overlap F1 Results: Direct LLM projection achieved the strongest and most consistent performance. GLM 5.2 obtained a mean Strict F1 of 0.9201 across 18 language-entity combinations, while locally deployable Gemma4:31B achieved 0.9133. The best LLM configuration improved Strict F1 over the previous state of the art in all 18 settings, by 0.0564-0.1512, yielding 55,416 grounded mentions with reconstructed offsets. Conclusions: Direct LLM-based projection enables high-quality multilingual clinical annotation transfer and provides a practical approach for extending clinical NLP resources to languages with fewer annotated datasets and language-specific tools. Combined with local inference and deterministic validation, it can substantially reduce expert time and cost for multilingual clinical corpus construction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将跨语言临床标注投影重新表述为受约束的文档级文本生成任务,通过LLM直接在不可变的目标语言文本中插入实体标签,并结合确定性验证和字符偏移重建,在六种语言上实现了优于现有最佳方法的临床命名实体投影性能。
AI.motivation: 临床命名实体识别(NER)依赖专家标注的多语言语料库,但这些资源在不同语言间分布极不均衡。传统标注投影方法(基于词对齐、候选跨度排序、混合ML-LLM)依赖显式对齐或候选生成,在处理临床文本中的释义、重排序、扩展/收缩以及边界精确定位方面存在困难,且需要任务特定训练。需要一种能跨语言高效转移专家标注、保持精确字符级边界、并避免外部依赖的方法。
AI.method: 三种策略对比评估:(1) 基于窗口的监督ML方法——将投影视为目标文档中候选跨度的二分类问题,使用7种分类器(Random Forest、Extra Trees、XGBoost等)和20个特征(词/字符n-gram重叠、TF-IDF余弦相似度、Levenshtein距离、BLEU、METEOR等);(2) 混合ML-LLM精炼方法——用LLM评估ML投影的匹配程度(exact/mid/no match),仅对不确定投影进行修正;(3) 直接LLM实体投影——核心创新,将标注转移视为受约束生成任务,LLM接收带标签的西班牙语源文档和未标注的目标文档,直接在目标文本中插入<DISEASE/SYMPTOM/PROCEDURE>XML标签,保持原文不变,通过确定性验证(平衡标签、实体计数匹配、文本保持)后解析为字符偏移。评估模型包括gemma4:31b、qwen3.6:35b(本地部署)和glm-5.2(云端),使用MultiClinAI官方评估服务器的严格跨度匹配和字符重叠F1指标。
AI.result: 直接LLM投影在所有18种语言-实体组合上均达到最优:GLM 5.2平均严格F1为0.9201,Gemma4:31B为0.9133,Qwen3.6:35B为0.8300。最佳LLM配置在所有18种设置上超越先前最佳方法CA26AM+MCAI,提升幅度为+0.0564至+0.1512(意大利语Procedure提升最大),平均严格F1从0.8348提升至0.9214(+0.0866)。共生成55,416条带字符偏移的临床实体提及。混合ML-LLM精炼使ML基线平均严格F1提升0.2462,但受限于上游候选生成质量。计算成本方面,GLM 5.2平均6.54秒/文档,Gemma4:31B为27.01秒/文档,而ClinicalAligner约0.1秒/文档(但需2-4小时训练)。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言临床标注投影可有效重新表述为受约束的文档级文本生成任务,前提是结合确定性文本保持验证与字符级锚定。直接LLM投影在六种目标语言和三种实体类型上一致优于候选监督、混合及先前SOTA投影方法,无需显式对齐、候选生成或任务特定训练。可本地部署的模型(如Gemma4:31B)使完整投影流程可在机构基础设施内运行,适合临床NLP的数据治理和隐私要求。该方法为标注资源匮乏的语言提供了实用机制,但存在生成文本篡改、标签遗漏/重复等新失效模式,需确定性验证作为不可分割的组成部分。直接LLM投影以更高推理成本换取显著更高的精确跨度准确性和更简洁的工作流,与基于对齐的方法形成明确的权衡关系。

title: Structural priors for data-efficient language learning
summary: Efficient language learning requires methods to reduce the reliance on large data and computational resources. We investigate structural transfer: First training models on non-language data to induce useful priors for natural language. This approach is a form of weight initialization for multilingual language modeling. We evaluate transfer via next-token-prediction loss, weight shifts in the model, and downstream linguistic benchmarks. Several symbolic data types - notably music, probabilistic grammars, and cellular automata - yield lower language-modeling loss than random initialization. These gains coincide with smaller weight shifts during subsequent language training, suggesting that structural transfer positions models in a more favorable region of the parameter space. However, a lower loss does not translate consistently into better downstream linguistic performance, and transfer from non-language data is less efficient than additional language data. We conclude that non-language data can serve as a partial substitute for language data for the training objective of next-token prediction but does not reliably support broader linguistic generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"结构迁移"——先在非语言数据上预训练GPT-2风格模型，再进行多语言自然语言训练——是否能带来数据高效的语言学习。实验使用四种符号数据（概率上下文无关文法PCFG、细胞自动机CA、钢琴音乐、蛋白质序列）和随机基线，在BabyLM多语言语料（英、荷、中）上继续训练。结果显示：音乐、PCFG和CA_16显著降低下一-token预测损失，并伴随更小的权重漂移，表明模型被置于参数空间中更有利的区域。但损失降低并未一致地转化为下游语言基准的改善，且非语言数据的效率低于额外的语言数据。结论：非语言数据可作为下一-token预测目标的部分替代，但不能可靠支持更广泛的语言泛化。
AI.motivation: 语言模型性能强烈依赖数据和算力，但两者本质上受限，尤其在低资源语言建模和认知合理的建模场景中，数据效率既是工程问题也是科学挑战。受人类语言习得启发，研究者探索能否引入结构先验来促进更数据高效的语言学习。BabyLM挑战赛明确在低数据条件下评估系统，鼓励认知启发方法。此前工作表明"预预训练"（在非语言数据上训练后再进行语言训练）可改善特定领域的收敛性和下游表现，但预预训练所引发的参数变化与目标任务表现之间的关系尚未被充分探索。此外，多语言环境带来跨语言干扰等额外挑战，是检验迁移效果是否具有语言特异性的天然试验场。
AI.method: 两阶段训练设置：阶段一从零开始在一种结构数据上训练GPT-2-small架构模型，阶段二切换到BabyLM多语言语料（英、荷、中各1/3）继续训练。结构数据类型包括：(1)由Penn Treebank派生的概率上下文无关Grammars，分Zipf分布和均匀分布两种词例化；(2)通过神经网络参数化生成的细胞自动机，分16态(CA_16)和256态(CA_256)两种复杂度；(3)Aria-MIDI钢琴音乐数据集编码为整数；(5)Swiss-Prot蛋白质序列；以及随机数序列作为对照。第二基线在阶段一训练英文维基百科。评估沿三个轴：(a)下一-token预测交叉熵损失，使用损失比ρ和token效率τ度量；(b)模型内部权重漂移，用Frobenius范数相对变化量度量自注意力矩阵；(c)BabyLM框架下的零样本与微调语言基准（覆盖BLiMP、阅读理解、知识探查等任务）。还拟合贝叶斯层次模型估计各条件的后验效应。共5个种子，总计约250 GPU小时（A100 80GB）。
AI.result: 下一-token预测：所有结构条件均匹配或优于无结构基线，最显著收益来自音乐、两种PCFG和CA_16。CA_256早期有优势但最终回归基线。蛋白质和随机收益较小。英文维基百科基线以仅额外训练一种语言便大幅超越所有符号数据。权重分析显示PCFG和CA_16在阶段二权重漂移最小（约δ̄=0.34），表明结构迁移将模型置于更有利的参数区域。损失比与阶段二权重漂移强相关（Pearson r=0.96, p<0.01）。最佳条件达到约60%的token效率。下游语言基准：损失降低并未一致转化为基准改善。CA_16有小但正向的效应（约0.4-0.7 pp），维基百科基线有稳健正向效应（+1.2至+1.3 pp）。所有结构数据效应均接近零，最高密度区间包含零。混合三种最佳结构数据（音乐、CA_16、PCFG_Zipf）训练挑战提交模型后，结果与各模型单独评估时相当。作者未发现结构数据对特定语言或句法任务类型有显著针对性增益。
AI.conclusion: 结构迁移可以改善下一-token预测的学习效率，且权重漂移分析支持这一解释——受益于结构迁移的模型在多语言语言训练期间需要更小的参数变化，表明先前的结构经历将模型置于参数空间中更有利的区域。然而下游收益有限：语言建模目标的改善并不可靠地转化为更强的下游语言基准表现；当额外自然语言数据可用时，其效率仍高于结构数据，即便训练于类型学部分不同的语言混合（如英、荷、中）。结构迁移可能在数据受限场景（如低资源语言）有用，但并非相关语言输入的直接替代。两种PCFG表现相同表明Zipf分布本身不显著影响迁移。蛋白质序列的复杂结构似乎不能被简单tokenization下的transformer轻易获取。随机数略优于无任何结构训练的随机初始化表明即便非常简单的权重初始化调整也可改善训练结果。工作的更广泛意义在于：结构数据为重新审视语言模型中的初始化策略提供了方向。在有限算力和模型容量场景下，训练前精心塑造模型权重可提供有用的领先起点。

title: LoaDiff: Conditional Generation of Electricity Consumption Time Series for Energy Analytics
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures. This paper appeared in IEEE ICDM 2026
summary: The energy transition is reshaping residential electricity consumption through the increasing adoption of distributed generation, electrified appliances, and demand-response programs. Understanding these evolving behaviors requires access to granular smart-meter data for applications such as load forecasting, appliance detection, and demand-side flexibility analysis. However, such data are subject to strict access restrictions and data-protection regulations. Thus, realistic synthetic alternatives are necessary. In this paper, we introduce LoaDiff, a diffusion-based generative model for year-long, sub-hourly smart-meter load curves. LoaDiff supports flexible conditioning on static household attributes, such as appliance ownership, and dynamic contextual variables, including calendar information and outdoor temperature. We evaluate the model against multiple generative baselines on three residential electricity-consumption datasets. Our experiments assess four complementary dimensions: fidelity and diversity, training-record memorization risk, downstream utility for load forecasting and appliance detection, and conditional controllability under alternative temperature conditions. The results show that LoaDiff generates realistic and diverse load profiles, achieves a favorable trade-off between generation quality and limited evidence of memorization, preserves information useful for downstream energy applications, and responds coherently to changes in conditioning variables.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了LoaDiff，一种基于扩散模型的条件生成模型，用于生成年度、亚小时级智能电表负荷曲线，支持对静态家庭属性（如家电拥有情况）和动态上下文变量（如日历信息和室外温度）进行灵活条件控制。在三个真实电力消耗数据集上的综合评估表明，LoaDiff在保真度、多样性、隐私风险、下游任务实用性以及条件可控性方面均表现出色。
AI.motivation: 随着能源转型和分布式发电、电气化家电及需求响应计划的普及，理解住宅电力消费行为变得愈发重要。然而，智能电表数据受GDPR等严格的数据保护法规限制，访问受限，使得外部研究人员和创新者难以利用这些数据进行高级分析。因此，迫切需要生成能够替代真实数据的合成负荷曲线，以支持负荷预测、家电检测和需求侧灵活性分析等能源应用。
AI.method: LoaDiff采用条件去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）框架，使用受Diffusion Transformers（DiT）启发的Transformer架构作为去噪网络。为处理超长序列，将年度负荷曲线重塑为(H, W)二维张量（365天×48个半小时），并采用非重叠的日级patch进行分块标记化。条件注入包括：通过自适应层归一化（AdaLN）注入静态家庭属性（如家电拥有情况）；在patch层面拼接动态协变量（如温度、日历信息）；并采用无分类器引导（CFG）方案增强可控性。时间位置编码基于日历特征的周期性表示。
AI.result: 在CER（爱尔兰）、EDF1和EDF2（EDF提供的模拟器生成数据）三个数据集上，LoaDiff在所有数据集上均获得最佳或第二佳的FID和ACD分数。在CER和EDF2上具有最低的NNDR（训练记录记忆风险指标）。在下游任务中，LoaDiff在18种分类器-家电组合中有16种取得最佳结果，平均平衡准确率达0.710/0.766（ROCKET/TransApp），排名第一。负荷预测性能匹配或超过真实数据训练基线。条件可控性实验中，冬季温度-5°C和+5°C的偏移分别导致电采暖负荷变化+10.6%和-49.1%，呈现合理的非线性响应。消融实验验证了日级patch、温度条件、AdaLN机制和CFG的关键作用。
AI.conclusion: LoaDiff作为一种条件扩散模型，在隐私约束下生成逼真的智能电表负荷曲线方面表现出色，在保真度、隐私保护、下游任务实用性和条件可控性方面均达到领先水平，可作为真实智能电表数据的实用、隐私保护替代方案。然而，其性能在不同数据集和指标上存在差异，没有单一方法在所有维度上占优，这强调了多维度综合评估的重要性。局限性包括：两个数据集为EDF专有无法公开；隐私评估基于距离启发式而非形式化保证；温度敏感性分析仅覆盖两个反事实偏移。

title: Ecdysis: Efficient and Effective Training of Runtime Harnesses for LLM Agents
summary: Self-evolving runtime harnesses can substantially improve the capabilities of large language model (LLM) agents and provide a promising paradigm for optimizing agent execution. Existing harness evolution methods typically rely on iterative search, repeatedly evaluating and revising candidate harnesses based on execution feedback from task instances. While this paradigm enables continuous harness optimization, it incurs substantial time overhead due to repeated agent executions and code modifications, and may overfit to observed tasks and specific failure patterns, resulting in degraded generalization to unseen tasks. We identify the lack of principled failure diagnosis as a key bottleneck in harness evolution: an observed failure can reflect either model-specific deficiencies or systematic harness deficiencies, and directly optimizing against individual failures can lead to unnecessary model-specific accommodation. We therefore propose Ecdysis, an efficient and effective framework that distinguishes model-specific accommodation from harness-level repair and biases adaptation toward systematic harness deficiencies by identifying recurring cross-task failure patterns. Ecdysis adopts a batch-level cross-instance failure aggregation paradigm to jointly analyze failure evidence from multiple task instances and further introduces Failure-Driven Collaborative Refinement to diagnose failure causes and iteratively refine harness modification specifications. By combining cross-instance failure analysis with multi-role diagnosis, Ecdysis enables more effective harness evolution with lower training time. Experiments show that Ecdysis achieves up to a 1.84x speedup in harness training compared with existing harness evolution methods, while improving the reasoning accuracy of the resulting harnesses by 18.56%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Ecdysis框架，通过跨任务实例的批量级失败聚合与失败驱动的协作精化（FDCR），在LLM Agent运行时harness自进化中区分模型特定适应与harness系统性修复，从而提升进化效率与泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有harness自进化方法基于单次失败迭代修改harness，存在两大问题：(1) 重复的智能体执行与代码修改带来巨大时间开销；(2) 难以区分失败源于模型缺陷还是harness系统性不足，导致过度拟合训练任务和当前模型，泛化能力下降。缺乏原则性的失败归因是关键瓶颈。
AI.method: Ecdysis包含两个核心组件：(1) 批量级跨实例失败聚合（Batch-Level Failure Aggregation）——将一轮训练中多个任务实例的失败轨迹聚合为结构化失败证据，按跨任务重复模式分组，优先处理覆盖至少两个不同任务的失败组，每轮仅调用一次coding agent生成候选harness；(2) 失败驱动协作精化（FDCR）——由Analyst、Critic、Engineer三个角色通过共享记录迭代精化失败诊断与修改提案，再由Moderator综合生成结构化修改规范，最后由coding agent执行修改。算法通过训练集分数严格比较保留候选harness。理论上，harness更新可分解为ΔH = t·ΔH_model + (1-t)·ΔH_harness，Ecdysis旨在降低模型适应比例t。
AI.result: 在5个LLM（Qwen3-8B/14B/32B、MiniMax-M2.7、Llama-3.1-8B）和AgentBench、τ²-Bench（Airline/Retail）上的实验表明：Ecdysis (w/ FDCR) 平均准确率达59.33%，相比Self-Evolution提升18.56%；训练时间最高加速1.84×（τ²-Airline上SE的8120.6秒降至4403.0秒），τ²-Retail加速1.30×；API成本降低32%-66%；且在未见模型（如Qwen3-32B）上展现出强跨模型泛化能力，推理token消耗降低约12%。消融实验验证了批量聚合与FDCR各自贡献。模型适应比例t从SE的60.0%降至Ecdysis的45.5%。仅用1/4训练数据即可达到全数据相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: Ecdysis通过将失败驱动进化从单实例转向跨任务重复模式，为harness的系统性修复提供更强证据，有效减少了模型特定过度适应。实验证明可靠失败诊断可同时提升harness进化的效率与泛化性，harness进化不仅需要修正失败，更需要判断哪些失败能构成可泛化的可靠修改证据。

title: ORCH: Organizational Principles Enable Collective Intelligence in Embodied AI
summary: Collective intelligence depends not only on the capabilities of individual members, but also on how those members are organized. Yet artificial multi-agent systems are typically assembled using fixed organizational structures, even when the physical tasks they perform impose fundamentally different coordination requirements. Here we show that principles from human organization theory can be operationalized to organize large, heterogeneous collectives of embodied artificial agents. We introduce ORCH (Organizing Roles and Coordination Hierarchies), which constructs task-specific hierarchical organizations by combining pooled interdependence for work that can proceed concurrently with sequential interdependence for work governed by prerequisite relationships. Across 25 wildfire-response missions spanning reconnaissance, rescue, transportation, resource management, containment and suppression, we evaluated teams of up to 50 heterogeneous agents using eight large language models. Organizations constructed using these principles consistently outperformed four representative embodied multi-agent approaches across mission outcome, execution efficiency, exploration and computational resource use. Human-designed ORCH organizations improved final score by 63.97% and execution efficiency by 74.29% on average relative to the four prior frameworks. Organizations generated automatically by language models improved these measures by 43.63% and 52.53%, respectively. These advantages persisted across missions and underlying language models. Notably, collective performance was not monotonically determined by model scale. Analysis of long-horizon missions showed that hierarchical organization enabled teams to preserve concurrent activity within specialized groups while coordinating ordered transitions between mission phases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ORCH框架，将人类组织理论中的"集合互依"与"顺序互依"原则操作化，用于构建任务自适应的具身多智能体层级组织。在25个 wildfire 任务、8 种 LLM、对比 4 种基线的实验中显著优于现有方法，且集体表现与模型规模无单调关系。
AI.motivation: 现有具身多智能体系统通常采用固定的组织结构（扁平化或单一管理者），无法适应不同任务在规模、异构性和时序依赖上的差异。个体能力强并不等于集体能力强，组织结构本身应作为决定集体智能的关键维度。
AI.method: ORCH 通过两种管理器递归组合：(1) 水平管理器协调"集合互依"，将可并行执行的子任务分配给下属并整合进度；(2) 垂直管理器协调"顺序互依"，将任务分解为有序阶段，仅激活当前阶段并在前置条件满足后推进。二者可混合嵌套形成"团队中的团队"。层级可由人类专家设计或由 LLM 自动生成（带 critic 监督），执行时通过自底向上汇报-自顶向下规划的闭环协议进行协调。
AI.result: 在 25 个 wildfire 任务（最多 50 个异构智能体）中，ORCH 人类设计组织最终得分提升 63.97%、执行效率提升 74.29%；LLM 自动生成组织分别提升 43.63% 和 52.53%，在 6 项指标（最终得分、效率、探索、API 调用、输入/输出 token）上均优于或媲美 CAMON、COELA、HMAS-2、Embodied 四个基线。优势在任务与 LLM 间一致（ANOVA 显示算法×模型交互不显著），且集体表现与模型规模无单调关系，中等模型表现最佳。ORCH 成功率 35.2%-53.1%，远高于基线的 6.9%-13.5%。
AI.conclusion: 组织设计是人工集体智能的核心维度而非附属管理层面；人类组织理论中的互依原则可有效转化为可执行的协调机制。"团队中的团队"层级结构能同时保持组内并发与跨阶段有序转换，是可扩展具身 AI 的关键。该工作确立了"人工组织学"作为新兴计算科学方向。

title: LOCUS: Task-Aware Low-Rank Post-Training for Token-Efficient Language Generation
summary: Large language model serving costs scale directly with output sequence length, yet standard preference alignment often inflates response verbosity without improving utility. We study whether the parameterization of post-training updates affects generation length: low-rank subspaces alter sequence length without modifying the alignment loss. We present LOCUS, a method that selects a task-aware low-rank adaptation subspace to minimize output-token cost subject to a utility constraint. Within this subspace, post-training retains the native preference objective with a frozen backbone. Across Anthropic HH-RLHF dialogue preferences, we evaluate two $\sim$3B decoder backbones, Pythia-2.8B and Qwen2.5-3B, against protocol-matched full-parameter DPO and DrDPO branches and the released SamPO checkpoint. LOCUS reduces continuation length by up to 39.84\% on Pythia-2.8B and by 14.87--17.58\% on Qwen2.5-3B while updating only 0.24--0.28\% of model parameters, with no material change in the internal preference diagnostic.

AI.tldr: LOCUS提出了一种任务感知的低秩后训练方法，通过选择低秩适配子空间来减少大语言模型生成文本的冗长度，同时保持偏好对齐效果不变。该方法在仅更新不到0.3%参数的情况下，实现了最高39.84%的输出长度削减。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型服务成本与输出序列长度直接相关。标准偏好对齐方法（如DPO、DrDPO）虽然能提升回答质量，但常常导致模型生成过度冗长的回复（即"长度偏差"），造成不必要的计算开销和部署成本。现有的缩短输出长度的方法（如长度惩罚、提示工程）往往修改了原始目标函数或推理接口，存在副作用。因此，研究者希望探索是否可以通过改变后训练更新的参数化方式来影响生成长度，同时保持原始对齐目标不变。
AI.method: LOCUS的核心方法是在不修改原始偏好损失函数的前提下，通过选择低秩适配（LoRA）子空间来影响输出长度。具体包括三个阶段：（1）在冻结预训练主干上附加低秩适配器；（2）在开发数据上训练多组候选适配器（不同的秩、目标模块、层范围、训练步数），筛选满足效用约束的最短候选；（3）将选中的适配器合并到主干或保留为独立分支用于推理。形式化定义为一个约束优化问题：在效用不低于基线−ε的条件下，最小化续生长度。论文还给出了关于可训练参数数量和推理时合并等价性的两个形式化命题及证明。
AI.result: 在Anthropic HH-RLHF对话偏好数据集上，对两个约3B参数的解码器主干（Pythia-2.8B和Qwen2.5-3B）进行评估，与协议匹配的全参数DPO、DrDPO分支及发布的SamPO检查点对比。结果显示：LOCUS在Pythia-2.8B上使续生长度最多减少39.84%（SamPO协议下），在Qwen2.5-3B上减少14.87-17.58%，同时仅更新0.24-0.28%的模型参数，内部偏好诊断指标几乎无变化。跨任务评估还显示在安全拒绝（Harmless，减少25.29%）和指令跟随（Orca DPO，减少79.97%）任务上同样有效。额外的消融实验研究了秩敏感性和目标模块选择对效果的影响。
AI.conclusion: LOCUS证明了在不修改原始偏好目标函数、仅通过约束参数更新到低秩子空间的方式，可以显著降低LLM输出的冗长度，同时保持任务效用。该方法提供了一种与目标函数无关、纯粹通过参数化方式实现token效率的新思路，为降低LLM服务成本提供了实用方案。论文承认其局限性在于评估范围有限（仅约3B模型、贪心解码），候选池的粒度有限（四个离散秩），且跨任务结果不可直接外推到未见任务。

title: Recognizing Is Not Reversing: A Controlled Inversion Test of Fact-Preserving News Framing
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to analyze and rewrite news, yet current framing studies mainly evaluate generation, detection, or whether rewritten text appears more neutral. They do not directly show whether a model can undo a known framing transformation while keeping the facts fixed. We introduce a controlled inversion test over three established textual realizations of framing: evaluative lexis, agency realization, and information salience. Across 60 news articles and three intervention strengths, this yields 540 paired variants with preserved atomic facts and recorded edits. Across Qwen, DeepSeek, and Kimi, factual preservation remains near 0.84, whereas intervention reversal is 0.044--0.068. Even when both framing type and direction are recognized correctly, pooled reversal reaches 0.071. These results reveal a clear separation between factual fidelity, framing recognition, and framing inversion: recognizing how an article is framed does not imply that the framing can be undone.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种"受控反转测试"，用于检验大语言模型（LLM）在保持事实不变的前提下能否逆转已知的新闻框架转换。实验覆盖60篇新闻文章、3种文本框架实现方式和3种干预强度，共生成540个配对变体，并在Qwen、DeepSeek和Kimi三个模型上进行测试。结果显示事实保真度约为0.84，而框架反转率仅0.044–0.068，表明模型虽能识别框架，却无法有效撤销框架。
AI.motivation: 现有框架研究主要关注生成、检测或改写后的中立性评估，但缺乏直接检验模型能否在固定事实的前提下逆转已知框架转换。该研究旨在填补这一空白，揭示事实保真、框架识别与框架反转之间的分离。
AI.method: 采用受控反转测试方法，基于三种已确立的文本框架实现方式（评价性词汇、施事实现和信息显著性），在60篇新闻文章上施加三种强度的干预，生成540个保留原子事实并记录编辑的配对变体。使用Qwen、DeepSeek和Kimi三个大语言模型进行框架反转测试，测量事实保留率和反转成功率。
AI.result: 三个模型的事实保留率均接近0.84，但框架反转率仅介于0.044至0.068之间。即便模型同时正确识别了框架类型和方向，合并后的反转率也仅达0.071。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了事实保真度、框架识别与框架反转之间存在明确分离：识别文章如何被框架化，并不意味着模型能够撤销该框架。这表明当前大语言模型在框架反转任务上能力有限，框架识别能力无法直接等同于框架操纵能力。

title: Beyond Word Error Rate: A Switch Aware Evaluation of ASR and Audio Language Models on English Yoruba Code-Switched Speech
comment: Accepted to IEEE Speech Language Tecnology
summary: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems and audio language models (audio LMs) now report low error rates on monolingual benchmarks, but their behavior on code switched speech in low resource, diacritic rich languages remains poorly characterized. We present a switch aware evaluation of eleven modern systems (six ASR models and five audio LMs) on English Yoruba code-switched speech, using a deterministic 2000 utterance evaluation set and a shared scoring pipeline. Beyond word error rate (WER), we report switch localized diagnostics: a switch entry token error rate (SETER), windowed switch point error rates, language specific error rates, and a diacritic insensitive WER. Our central finding is that aggregate WER hides code switching behavior. The best system by WER (an ASR model) is statistically indistinguishable from a leading audio LM on WER, yet the audio LM is significantly better on every switch localized metric. Across faithful systems, Yoruba token recognition collapses (error 0.97 for almost all systems) while English tokens are recognized far better, and errors concentrate sharply at switches into Yoruba. Several generative audio LMs fail as exact transcribers, producing translation, verbosity, and prompt leakage that are strongly prompt dependent. We release manifests, metric implementations, and evaluation scripts to support reproducible, switch aware benchmarking for African code switched speech.

AI.tldr: 本文针对英语-约鲁巴语代码转换语音，对11个现代ASR与音频语言模型（6个ASR + 5个音频LM）进行"转换敏感"评估，提出切换本地化诊断指标，揭示聚合WER掩盖了边界处的真实失败模式。
AI.motivation: 现有ASR与音频LM在单语基准上已报告低错误率，但在低资源、富变音符号语言的代码转换语音上表现缺乏刻画；标准聚合WER会被矩阵语言（英语）主导，稀释嵌入式语言（约鲁巴语）及切换点的错误，使模型在真正体现代码转换能力的地方的失败被隐藏。
AI.method: 在AfriCodeSwitch验证集上构建确定性2000句评估清单（cap2000），对11个系统采用统一归一化与最小编辑距离对齐。除了标准WER/CER外，提出遮蔽错误率框架，并实例化：(1) 语言特定错误率EN-ER/YO-ER；(2) 切换入口令牌错误率SETER；(3) 窗口化切换点错误率SPER@k（k=0..3）；(4) 变音符号不敏感WER。采用配对自举检验（1000次重采样）进行统计推断，并以S/D/I分解与生成缺陷标志（空输出、截断、重复、长度膨胀、提示泄露）建立自动错误分类法。
AI.result: Parakeet-TDT在WER上最优（66.1%），与Kimi-Audio在统计上无差异（Δ=+0.13, p=0.76），但Kimi在所有切换本地化指标上显著更优（p<0.001）。WER与YO-ER的Spearman相关近零（ρ=-0.10），与SETER仅中等相关（ρ=0.67, 不显著）。约鲁巴语令牌错误率在所有忠实系统中≥97%，英语约33–46%；切换进入约鲁巴语时错误率0.95–1.00，切换回英语时0.40–0.53；约鲁巴语主导话语错误率显著更高。变音符号剥离几乎不改变WER（±0.3点内），表明瓶颈是约鲁巴语覆盖而非正字法。三个生成式音频LM（Audio Flamingo 2、Qwen2-Audio、Qwen2.5-Omni）WER>100%，表现为翻译、冗余与提示泄露，且高度依赖提示词；Qwen2-Audio改用"直接"指令后泄露率从33.7%降至0.2%。
AI.conclusion: 聚合WER在结构上无法反映代码转换保真度，强烈建议在低资源代码转换基准中同时报告语言特定与切换本地化指标；当前瓶颈是约鲁巴语声学/词汇覆盖而非变音符号；解码受高资源矩阵语言先验主导，导致进入约鲁巴语时系统性失败；音频LM是改进嵌入式语言识别的有前景路径，但必须以逐字转录方式约束并控制提示词；WER单一排行榜会掩盖对嵌入式语言使用者的排斥。

title: Thinking with Looped Flows
summary: Humans and machines often solve harder problems by spending more time on computation. In deep learning, looped models implement this idea during inference by recurrently updating a hidden state. In practice, however, their training backpropagates through only one or a few updates, making it hard to train early updates to support future ones. We propose looped flows, an approach that sidesteps this issue by training the recurrence with local denoising objectives. By imposing temporal association across denoising objectives through progressively decreasing noise levels and shared noise, the model is incentivized to learn recurrent states that transfer useful computation over time, even when gradients cover only a few updates. We then formulate inference as integrating the velocity of a probability flow parameterized by the learned denoiser, coupled with recurrent states. This allows solving harder problems by spending more computation through a finer temporal grid and enables multiple valid predictions from different initial noise samples. Across six reasoning benchmarks including two multi-solution benchmarks, looped flows outperform prior state-of-the-art looped models overall, achieving 58.8% test accuracy on ARC-AGI-1 and 12.2% on ARC-AGI-2.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"循环流"（Looped Flows），将循环模型与流模型的局部去噪目标相结合，通过沿时间递减噪声级别和共享噪声来时间关联去噪任务，从而训练出稳定的循环状态。推理时将学习到的去噪器参数化的概率流速度场与循环状态耦合进行积分，实现推理时计算扩展并支持多样化解。在六个推理基准测试中超越现有最优循环模型。
AI.motivation: 循环模型在推理时通过循环更新隐藏状态来增加计算量，但实际训练中仅反向传播一个或几个更新，使得难以训练早期更新以支持未来计算，导致学习到不稳定的循环，在简单问题上失败。需要一种方法来缓解循环模型的训练困难，同时保持其推理时可扩展性。
AI.method: 核心方法是在多个噪声级别上训练有状态的去噪器，使其同时进行去噪和循环状态更新。训练时：(1) 对有序时间步 t_0 < t_1 < ... < t_k 采样，使噪声级别 (1-t_i) 随时间递减；(2) 跨时间步共享噪声 x_0 和目标 x_1；(3) 在每个步骤施加局部交叉熵损失，使用停止梯度；(4) 使用自适应计算时间（ACT）机制跳过已饱和的步骤。推理时：将学习到的去噪器参数化的概率流速度场与循环状态耦合，在时间网格上积分，支持确定性ODE和随机SDE积分方案，并通过更细的时间网格或最佳Q集成扩展推理时计算。
AI.result: 在六个推理基准测试上的结果：(1) Sudoku-Extreme达97.9%（±0.4），集成后99.3%；(2) Maze-Hard达86.7%（±1.1），集成后86.9%；(3) ARC-AGI-1达58.8%（±1.8），集成后59.5%，相比TRM（44.6%）提升显著；(4) ARC-AGI-2达12.2%（±1.9），相比TRM（7.8%）提升；(5) 在N-Queens和Graph Coloring多解任务上，准确率和覆盖率均达到最优。此外，循环流恢复了TRM 90.9%的失败案例（包括89.9%的非收敛情况和98.0%的伪吸引子情况），推理时可通过更细的时间网格持续提升性能。消融实验证实了时间条件、插值、递减噪声、共享噪声和随机积分各自对性能均有贡献。
AI.conclusion: 循环流是一种简单而有效的框架，通过利用流模型的局部去噪目标来训练循环模型的隐藏状态，成功解决了循环模型的训练困难。它在多个推理基准上超越现有最优循环模型，学习到稳定的循环（避免伪吸引子和非收敛失败），支持多样化解的恢复（通过概率传输），并实现有效的推理时计算扩展。未来的研究方向包括开发保留循环流优势的免模拟训练算法。

title: Model-Aware Schedules Improve Generation via Fiberwise Optimal Transport
comment: 11 pages, 2 figures. Keywords: Diffusion models; flow matching; schedule optimization; fiberwise optimal transport; time reparameterization; empirical universality
summary: Diffusion and flow-matching schedules control the signal and noise coefficients that mix data and noise along affine probability paths. Minimizing a kinetic action defined on coefficient paths, motivated by optimal transport, helps explain strong baselines but remains model-agnostic and ignores prediction error. Here we introduce a model-aware schedule construction based on fiberwise optimal transport. At a fixed time and state on the probability path, compatible signal/noise decompositions form an affine fiber. We define a fiberwise prediction risk by averaging optimal-transport costs between the true and predictor-induced decompositions within these fibers. On a fixed coefficient curve, combining this risk with coefficient-path kinetic action yields a closed-form optimal time allocation. This construction extends to general linear prediction targets, and the risk profile can be estimated from an early baseline checkpoint. We evaluate DDPMs and flow matching across prediction targets, training configurations, risk-estimation checkpoints, datasets, and architectures. Our model-aware schedules consistently outperform strong baselines, including a 38.6% relative FID reduction for flow matching on CIFAR-10 at 16 function evaluations. Each model-agnostic kinetic baseline determines its own kinetic reference coordinate. In these coordinates, fiberwise-risk profiles from independently trained models in different settings align closely after normalization to unit area. The resulting schedule deformations used in training also align, suggesting empirical universality across the evaluated models and settings. Pretrained-checkpoint diagnostics extend this normalized-risk agreement to larger conditional latent diffusion and 2-RF models. A frozen analytic allocation template retains most of the model-aware improvement without further risk estimation or model-specific fitting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于纤维最优传输（fiberwise optimal transport）的模型感知调度构造方法，通过将纤维预测风险与系数路径动力学结合，得到闭式最优时间分配，显著提升扩散模型和流匹配模型的生成质量，并在不同模型和设置中表现出经验普适性。
AI.motivation: 现有的扩散模型和流匹配调度主要基于系数路径动力学最小化（与最优传输相关），但这种方法与模型无关，忽略了预测误差。需要一种考虑模型特定预测风险的调度构造方法来提升生成质量。
AI.method: 1. 在固定时间t和状态x下，定义仿射纤维F_x上的兼容信号/噪声分解；2. 通过基保持最优传输定义纤维预测风险R(t) = s_t²·E[‖ε_θ(x_t,t) - ε‖²]，并推广到一般线性预测目标；3. 在固定系数曲线上，最小化系数路径动力学并约束R(t)的时间积分预算，得到闭式最优分配密度w*(τ) = L'(τ)/√(η + λR(τ))；4. 使用运动学参考坐标和单位面积归一化进行跨模型比较；5. 风险轮廓可从早期基线检查点估计，构造冻结解析分配模板。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10上：DDPM最高16.4%相对FID改进（DPM++3M, 16 NFE），流匹配最高38.6%相对FID改进（midpoint, 16 NFE）。在ImageNet-64上：DDPM改进2.3%-7.0%，流匹配改进9.4%-29.8%。归一化风险轮廓在不同模型、目标、架构、数据集上高度一致，冻结解析模板保留了大部分模型感知改进（DDPM达98-110%，流匹配达75.8-76.2%）。经验贝叶斯分解显示93.74%-96.32%的风险来自预测器依赖的贝叶斯超额成分。
AI.conclusion: 结合系数路径动力学与纤维预测风险的调度设计可在多种模型、训练设置和采样设置中一致提升生成质量。共享的归一化风险形状和分配形变暗示经验普适性，冻结解析分配模板可直接使用而无需进一步风险估计或模型特定拟合。该工作为理解扩散和流匹配的调度结构提供了新视角，但理论解释和超越固定系数曲线的推广仍需未来工作。

title: The Last AI Built by Humans: Toward Genuine Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) enables AI systems to turn experience and feedback into persistent changes that improve both their capabilities and the process of future improvement. We first use the Headroom-Closed Index (HCI) to reveal the problems of existing LLMs, then introduce the RSI concept and its development roadmap: from improvement-execution autonomy, improvement-strategy autonomy, experience-acquisition autonomy, and environment-adaptation autonomy, to recursive meta-improvement. Next we examine RSI across scenarios (e.g., scientific discovery, embodied intelligence, software engineering), highlighting their distinct requirements and development speeds. Drawing on diverse industry practices and preliminary empirical evidence, we connect RSI research with practical systems and identify key challenges to achieving genuine RSI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出递归自我改进（RSI）的系统性综述：使用天花板闭合指数（HCI）揭示现有LLM在交互式能力上的显著差距，提出以"自主性"为核心的改进循环五级分类框架（L1执行→L2策略→L3经验获取→L4环境适应→L5递归元改进），并跨科学发现、具身智能、软件工程、医疗四大场景分析了RSI的差异化进展，结合工业实践案例识别实现真正RSI的关键挑战。
AI.motivation: 当前AI模型开发面临资源密集、反馈扩展困难、部署后持续适配三大瓶颈，传统的外协调式开发流程成为规模化障碍；不同能力领域（交互式任务vs.静态知识任务）进展极度不均衡，表明需要AI系统自身承担部分改进协调责任，从而引出递归自我改进的研究动机。
AI.method: 1)提出HCI（Headroom-Closed Index）将393个模型-基准观测标准化为可比较的能力轨迹，揭示交互能力存在最大改进空间；2)以"改进循环"为基本分析单元，定义改进循环的解剖结构（AI系统、系统状态、经验、目标、改进器、策略、验证器、继承者等九要素）；3)按AI对改进决策的接管程度建立五级自主性分类（B0→L5），区分执行自主性、策略自主性、经验获取自主性、环境适应自主性和递归元改进；4)跨科学、具身智能、软件工程、医疗四种反馈机制差异显著的场景审视RSI；5)结合Theseus、Lark、Humanlaya、ModelBest、Tencent Hunyuan、Agent-Native Research Lab等工业实践案例进行实证验证。
