3) **训练子系统**：SGD/Adam(W) 参考默认语义、参数分组、融合多张量更新、保持标称批语义的梯度累积；全局范数单次融合的梯度裁剪；AMP 参考 autocast（卷积/矩阵乘 F16，BN/损失/主权重 F32）；DDP 主机分片 all-reduce + 共享内存 + futex，位级确定。
4) **SDK**：三层结构（Core 预构建库 + C ABI libnumbat 1,400+ 入口点 + Zig/C/Python/Rust/Go/TypeScript 薄绑定），严格加性版本化 ABI（仅 opaque handle、运行时 dtype 标签、状态码跨边界）；跨绑定通过共享已知答案测试与轨迹级别测试保证数值一致。
5) **领域平面（requirements as executable gates）**：每个设计需求由可执行验收门（含判定与退出码）执行；诊断注册表提供稳定编号代码与类型化修复计划；从源代码处的 ledger 测量覆盖度；接口直接拒绝违反领域规则的操作；发布产物本身经过运行时询问检验。
6) **五级复现协议**：L1 算子数值梯度检查 + CPU/GPU 等价；L2 模块已知答案测试；L3 步骤动力学（单步/多步损失下降、1-rank 与 N-rank 梯度等价、AMP 与 F32 逐步一致）；L4 轨迹（同机参考 30 epoch，自动化轨迹门每 10 分钟轮询，20% 容差带外的运行会被暂停/终止）；L5 结果（官方 COCO 协议，由参考栈自身验证器对导出的 safetensors 权重评分）。
7) **接受性测试**：在 COCO 2017 上以 3×200 W 上限的 RTX 3090 训练 YOLO-NB-M（YOLOv8m 架构类，25.9M 参数）500 epoch，从随机初始化（seed 0），不引入任何预训练权重。
AI.result:
1) **准确性**：最终 epoch-500 EMA 权重在 COCO val2017 官方协议下（由参考栈 Ultralytics 8.3.75 + PyTorch 2.12.1 + pycocotools 评分）得分 0.4956 mAP50-95（0.6610 mAP50），公布的端点为 0.502，相对差距 1.3%；训练中最佳 0.4970（epoch 469）。30 epoch 同机参考轨迹窗口内，numbat 曲线不低至参考值的 97.9%（在最早 epoch 高至参考的 1.24×），经内部评估器已知 -0.011 至 -0.014 偏差修正后处于或高于参考。
2) **静默分歧目录**：协议暴露了十处配方分歧（权重衰减已含批次缩放、AMP 自动转换中 BN 用 F16、卷积使用 Kaiming-normal 而非参考的 Kaiming-uniform、DDP 下损失缩放器崩塌、mosaic 标签未裁剪、优化器参数分组中归一化增益位置错误、缺失全局范数裁剪、EMA 在损失缩放器拒绝步被跳过、评估 BN 使用 train-mode 与 EMA 模型不匹配、所有 rank 抽取相同增强流），其中初始化 → 自动转换 → 损失缩放器崩塌形成可"自愈"掩盖的复合故障链。
3) **吞吐量**：单 GPU RTX 3090 上前向 50.8 vs 58.2 ms、优化器 2.6 vs 5.5 ms、反向 113.0 vs 110.6 ms、损失 12.3 vs 13.4 ms；异步端到端步时 185.9 vs 192.8 ms（不限功耗），200 W 上限下 245.5 vs 256.9 ms（numbat 仍含实时指标流）。三 GPU DDP：参考 15.6 min/epoch（154 img/s），numbat 优化前 27.8 min/epoch（87 img/s）；经五项优化（固定暂存、分片归约、futex 屏障、融合梯度范数内核、损失缩放器溢出位并入梯度负载）后达 ≈108 img/s；重叠反向归约与 NCCL 路径在小核主机上因数据饥饿 60–155 ms/step 而默认禁用。
4) **内存**：增量释放保存的激活后，峰值训练内存 13.5 GiB/GPU（相对 18.5 降低 26.8%）；仍约为参考（≈7 GiB）的 1.9×，归因于 AMP 影子参数与分配器高水位，列为待解决项。
5) **能耗与可靠性**：3×200 W 上限下 500 epoch 用时 9.6 天（含冷却暂停），GPU 能耗 ≤1.4×10² kWh；轨迹门 1,403 次轮询零违规、零人工干预；约 30 次自动 checkpoint-resume 段全程保持状态连续。
6) **复现发布**：发布权重（safetensors 导出）、每 epoch 训练/验证指标、官方协议分数趋势、训练曲线导出、含环境与所有超参数的完整运行清单。声称所有报告分数均可仅凭发布的 safetensors、参考栈验证器与 pycocotools 重新生成。
AI.conclusion: 独立栈在训练结果级别与主流生态系统达到 parity 是可实现的：在消费级硬件上、自包含栈内、遵循参考默认值语义并以五级复现协议与可执行领域需求门作为纪律。本文同时给出了两份可迁移成果——十项静默配方分歧目录与五级复现协议本身，以及一项存在性证明（YOLO-NB-M 500 epoch 从零训练，最终 mAP50-95 与公布端点相对差 1.3%，单 GPU 步时持平）。未来工作包括将协议扩展到 LLM/语音栈、关闭多 GPU 重叠与内存差距，并将验收门方法推广到仍在构建中的领域平面。

title: Governed Human-AI Prioritization Under Uncertainty: Adaptive Estimation and Dependency-Constrained Portfolio Selection
summary: AI-native software engineering increasingly combines human judgment, historical analogy, parametric estimation, and AI-generated forecasts inside the same prioritization decision. The resulting problem is not merely how to rank candidate work, but how to govern heterogeneous estimates, uncertainty, strategic parameters, dependencies, and limited capacity in a way that remains inspectable and recalibratable. We study five quantitative operators used in the D-POAF decision practice: Business Value Score (BVS), Effort and Risk Score (ERS), Prioritization Value Score (PVS), Collective Calibration Score (CCS), and Optimal Development Path (ODP). Controlled synthetic experiments characterize their behavior under known latent variables and explicit error processes. Moderate BVS-weight perturbations preserved global rankings (median Spearman 0.986), while broader strategic changes reduced top-10% overlap to 0.788. Reliability-weighted effort aggregation achieved MAE 0.616, a 42.6% reduction relative to the best individual estimator (MAE 1.073), and outperformed a simple mean (MAE 0.638). Under estimator drift, adaptive reliability weighting reduced average RMSE by 4.5% relative to equal weighting. Model-collective divergence detected the highest-error priority estimates with ROC-AUC 0.906. In 800 dependency-constrained portfolio instances, value-to-effort achieved mean objective ratio 0.962 and ODP distance 0.953 against the exact optimum; bootstrap intervals confirm a small but systematic advantage for value-to-effort under the declared objective. These results establish a quantitative basis for evidence-weighted human-AI prioritization and define the optimization boundary between shortest-path ODP formulations and general release-portfolio selection.

AI.tldr: 本文研究AI原生软件工程中的人机协同优先级排序问题,基于D-POAF决策实践的五个量化算子(BVS、ERS、PVS、CCS、ODP),通过受控合成实验定量评估其行为特性,提出以证据加权的权威分配替代固定角色赋权的治理原则。
AI.motivation: AI原生软件工程中,人类判断、历史类比、参数化估计与AI预测同时影响同一优先级决策。如何治理异构估计、不确定性、战略参数、依赖关系与有限容量,同时保持可审查与可重新校准,成为核心挑战。既有研究多聚焦单一方法或框架描述,缺乏机制级的定量证据支撑。
AI.method: (1)形式化分离期望价值、可行性、校准与交付后价值四个维度,定义五个算子(BVS=业务价值评分,ERS=努力与风险评分,PVS=优先级价值评分,CCS=集体校准评分,ODP=最优开发路径);(2)采用受控合成数据(固定随机种子20260827)与显式误差过程,包含5000块排序敏感度、12500任务工作量估计、20波漂移适应、6000提案CCS诊断、800个依赖约束组合投资实例;(3)评估指标涵盖Spearman相关、top-10%重叠、MAE/RMSE/SA、ROC-AUC、目标比率与精确最优率,组合投资部分采用非参数自助法95%置信区间。
AI.result: (1)BVS权重在小扰动下保持全局排序稳定(中位Spearman 0.986),但战略级变化使top-10%重叠降至0.788;PVS指数α从1增至2时top-10%重叠仅0.764;(2)逆MSE加权集成将MAE从最佳单估计器1.073降至0.616(降幅42.6%),优于简单均值0.638;(3)漂移场景下自适应加权平均RMSE降低4.5%,AI权重由0.25升至0.388;(4)模型-集体分歧检测最高误差估计的ROC-AUC达0.906,top-20%标记的精度提升至基准的3.44倍;(5)800实例基准中价值/努力启发式达到0.962目标比率(精确最优率48.6%),ODP距离为0.953,显著优于随机基线0.760。
AI.conclusion: 本文将D-POAF决策逻辑从描述性实践提升为可测试的定量模型,确立"证据加权权威"的核心工程原则:参数、估计器影响力、校准信号与优化目标须足够显式以被度量、质疑、版本化与改进。ODP应被视为目标匹配型优化接口——路径问题用最短路径,预算与依赖约束的发布组合则需整数规划、动态规划或进化算法等。该研究为机制级定量证据,工业部署的外部效度有待后续验证。

title: LLMVul: A Vulnerability-Labeled Dataset of LLM-Generated C/C++ Functions from Real Production Repositories
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate and assist with software development, yet existing vulnerability datasets largely focus on human-written code or controlled prompting environments. This limits the ability to study security weaknesses in LLM-generated code as it appears in real-world software projects. We present LLMVul, a vulnerability-labeled dataset of LLM-generated C/C++ functions mined from real production repositories. We mine AI-assisted development activity from GitHub over a 4 year period, from November 13, 2022 to September 3, 2026, using provenance signals such as commit metadata and AI-related authorship evidence. After filtering and deduplication, LLMVul contains 21,430 unique C/C++ functions from 226 repositories, together with repository, commit, function, provenance, and AI-tool metadata. We establish vulnerability labels using an ensemble of complementary static-analysis and pattern-based techniques and assign Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) categories to confirmed vulnerable functions. To assess labeling reliability, we additionally conduct independent manual annotation and measure inter-rater agreement using Cohen's kappa ($k=0.79$). LLMVul contains 1,540 ensemble-vulnerable functions spanning 17 unique CWE categories, providing substantially more real-world LLM-generated vulnerable C/C++ functions than existing vulnerability-oriented LLM code benchmarks. By preserving both code-level vulnerability labels and generation/provenance metadata, LLMVul enables reproducible research on vulnerability detection, security evaluation of LLM-generated code, and analysis of vulnerability patterns in AI-assisted software development. The LLMVul dataset is publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: LLMVul 是一个从真实 GitHub 生产仓库中挖掘的、带有漏洞标签的 LLM 生成 C/C++ 函数数据集，包含 21,430 个唯一函数（1,540 个被标记为漏洞），覆盖 17 个 CWE 类别，旨在弥补现有 LLM 代码安全基准依赖受控提示而缺乏真实场景数据的空白。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 代码漏洞基准（如 SecurityEval、CyberSecEval 2、CWEval）主要依赖受控、研究者主导的提示，无法反映开发者在生产环境中使用 AI 助手时偶然引入的安全漏洞；此外，基于人类编写代码训练的漏洞检测模型可能无法泛化到 LLM 生成的代码。因此需要一个来源于真实生产仓库、带有函数级漏洞标签和 AI 工具溯源元数据的数据集。
AI.method: 三阶段构建流程：(1) 通过 GitHub REST API 扫描 1,200 个 C/C++ 仓库（≥200 stars）的 321k 提交，使用 47 条正则模式匹配 9 种 AI 编码助手（Copilot、ChatGPT、Claude Code 等）的归属信号（强信号：Co-authored-by 标签；中信号：开发者自述），识别出 7,018 个 LLM 归属提交；(2) 使用 tree-sitter 解析器从 git diff 的新增/修改行中提取函数体（5–150 LoC），按 SHA-256 去重后保留 21,430 个唯一函数；(3) 采用三工具静态分析集成（Semgrep + Flawfinder + 54 条基于 NIST SARD/ITS4 的正则模式）进行多数投票标记（至少两票标记为漏洞，单票标记为不确定），按 Semgrep > Flawfinder > 模式匹配优先级分配 CWE，并由两位作者对 100 个样本进行独立人工标注，计算 Cohen's κ = 0.79。
AI.result: 数据集最终包含 21,430 个唯一 C/C++ 函数（C++ 58.5%, C 41.5%），来自 226 个仓库、1,684 个唯一提交，时间跨度 2022/11–2026/09；其中 1,540 个（7.2%）被标记为漏洞，17,211 个（80.3%）安全，2,679 个（12.5%）不确定；漏洞覆盖 17 个 CWE 类别，主要为 CWE-120（Buffer Copy, 494 个）、CWE-787（Out-of-Bounds Write, 478 个）、CWE-676（Dangerous Function Use, 411 个）、CWE-22（Path Traversal, 75 个）等；Claude Code 贡献最多函数（14,221 个），其次为 GitHub Copilot（4,952 个）；89.2% 来自强信号，10.8% 来自中信号；人工标注 Cohen's κ = 0.79（substantial agreement）。
AI.conclusion: LLMVul 是首个从真实生产仓库挖掘的、带有函数级漏洞标签和 AI 工具溯源的 C/C++ 数据集，公开于 Zenodo（DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.22668216），支持检测器泛化研究、CWE 分布特征分析、跨 AI 工具比较和时间演化研究等任务；未来将扩展至 Python、Java、Rust 等语言，并构建支持编译上下文分析的自动化基础设施。

title: Engineering Reliable Commit Gates for Agentic AI: Cost-Aware Verification Portfolios under Common-Mode Data Failures
summary: Agentic systems commit state-changing actions, but additional verifiers can inherit the same upstream fault. We present VP-CONTROL, a runtime-assurance design and deterministic benchmark for cost-aware commit gates. Its 48 task templates yield 2,880 scenarios across six fault regimes. A fixed-call 2 x 2 experiment separates verifier-model diversity from evidence-source diversity. On frozen proposals from two local actor families, a cross-model vote over shared evidence approves 62.9% of unsafe proposals, versus 22.9% with an independent source. The source effect is 40.9 percentage points, compared with 11.3 for model diversity. A portfolio controller selects verification plans using only deployment-observable metadata. Approximate cluster-adjusted calibration at a nominal 5% per-task target yields 1.9% unsafe execution and 38.2% automated safe coverage on the locked test. Matched-budget portfolios also improve on fixed verification policies. Transfer remains conditional: unseen fault families yield 16-26% risk, and a FinQA check fails to reproduce the source effect with the tested small verifiers. A preregistered live HTTP/SQLite study tests concurrent writes and lost responses. After-check races defeat verifier-only gates; transactional partial guards prevent only covered failures, while a full atomic guard records no unsafe effects across 216 episodes. Idempotent request identifiers prevent duplicate effects after lost responses. The results motivate explicit evidence lineage, cost-aware selection, and commit-time enforcement, while exposing the limits of approximate calibration and local-tool generalization.

AI.tldr: VP-Control 提出了一种针对智能体AI提交门（commit gate）的运行时保障框架和确定性基准。研究通过48个任务模板、2880个场景、六种故障机制，定量分离了验证模型多样性与证据源多样性在抵御共模数据失效中的作用。在锁定测试中，校准后的组合策略在5%风险目标下实现1.9%不安全执行率和38.2%自动化安全覆盖，并提出在真实工具集成中必须采用原子化防护与幂等请求标识符。
AI.motivation: 智能体AI可执行重启作业、变更权限、删除制品等状态变更操作，而传统"增加一个验证器"的思路存在隐患：若多个验证器共享同一上游数据源，则可能因共模故障而集体批准不安全操作。此外，验证通过后到执行写入之间的状态竞态也无法通过事前检查消除。论文旨在系统量化证据源多样性与模型多样性对提交门可靠性的不同贡献，并探索成本感知的选择策略与工程边界。
AI.method: 系统模型定义了三种证据视图（A、A'同源、B独立复制）和五种机制族（同模型/跨模型重检、B读取、事务性精确防护、人工延后）。在48×10×6=2880场景基准上，采用固定调用次数的2×2因子实验分离模型/源效应；策略选择器基于部署可观测元数据构建六级回退上下文，通过平滑风险率与成本权衡进行校准，借鉴LTT（Learn-Then-Test）固定序列组织并使用Kish设计效应调整的Wilson上界。在活体工具集成层，通过HTTP/SQLite服务、单独写入进程与六个注入条件（含强制after-check竞态）测试边界情况。模型全部采用本地Ollama量化检查点（Qwen3.5-9B、Gemma4-8B为执行者；Qwen3-4B、Phi-4-mini为验证者），并通过冻结提案与缓存裁定实现反事实重放。
AI.result: RQ1：在不安全提案上，同模型同源投票错误批准率为74.2%，仅改变模型降至62.9%，仅改变源降至33.3%，二者皆改变降至22.9%。源效应为-40.9个百分点，模型效应仅-11.3个百分点，差中差为0.008（p=0.9056，无交互作用）。RQ2：5%校准的组合策略在锁定测试上达到1.9%不安全执行率与38.2%自动化覆盖；在跨模型投票预算下将不安全从27.8%降至12.7%，独立源预算下从16.5%降至5.7%（三组预设对比经Holm校正均p=0.0006显著）。RQ3：域外迁移表现不均，IAM与流水线域需完全延后；未见故障族（ambiguous_commit/partial_update）实测风险达16–26%，违反5%目标；FinQA外部检查因验证器不具能力而未能复现源效应。RQ4：在活体工具测试中（共216回合），强制after-check竞态下纯验证策略均失败；完全原子化防护实现0%不安全执行率（95%上界1.4%）与81.0%安全完成率；幂等请求标识符成功阻止96次重试造成的重复效果。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的智能体提交门需同时具备证据选择与执行强制两项能力。证据源多样性在抵御共模数据失效上比模型多样性贡献更大，成本感知组合策略优于固定检查策略，但其收益取决于部署群体的可交换性：未见故障族、弱验证器均会破坏迁移性，且向执行者返回更好的证据并不能替代执行强制。活体集成揭示了独立边界：预检证据无法约束竞态，原子化防护仅能覆盖其声明的子句；当完整谓词可被数据库事务内检查时，全原子化防护是首选机制。部署契约应明确：记录证据谱系、在提交时强制可检查子句、为依赖不完整证据的决策进行校准或延后。

title: RCL: A Retrieval-Confidence Layer for Detecting Insufficient Context in Enterprise Retrieval-Augmented Code Generation
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for code generation has been studied extensively on public repositories, where a model's parametric knowledge often compensates for imperfect retrieval. This breaks down in enterprise codebases, where private APIs, internal frameworks, and undocumented team conventions fall entirely outside any model's pretraining distribution. Recent work on private-library code generation shows that even oracle (perfect) retrieval does not eliminate errors, but locates failures downstream in API usage; separately, confidence-gated retrieval has been studied for open-domain question answering using model-internal confidence. Neither addresses whether retrieval itself was structurally sufficient for a private-code query before generation begins. We introduce RCL (Retrieval-Confidence Layer), a lightweight module inserted between retrieval and generation that combines a call-graph-derived structural coverage score with a novelty score estimating a query's dependence on knowledge outside the model's prior, to detect insufficient retrieval before generation occurs. When confidence falls below a calibrated threshold, RCL triggers a targeted follow-up retrieval or labels the output for human review, rather than generating silently against incomplete context. We describe RCL's architecture, formalize its scoring functions, and propose an evaluation methodology using a private-code benchmark built by injecting synthetic internal APIs into open-source Java repositories, simulating the enterprise condition without proprietary code. We report results (Section 7) comparing RCL against similarity-only retrieval on generation correctness. Our position is that retrieval sufficiency, assessed structurally rather than from model-internal confidence, is a distinct and currently underaddressed signal for building safer code-generation systems in private, enterprise settings.

AI.tldr: 本文针对企业私有代码库中RAG（检索增强生成）代码生成的可靠性问题，提出RCL（Retrieval-Confidence Layer）模块。该模块通过结合调用图结构覆盖度评分和查询新颖性评分，在生成阶段前检测检索充分性，避免因检索不足而导致静默错误生成。
AI.motivation: 在企业私有代码库场景下，私有API、内部框架和未文档化的团队约定完全不在任何模型的预训练分布内。现有RAG方法依赖模型参数知识补偿不完美检索，但这种方式在私有代码库中失效。现有研究要么关注完美检索后仍存在的API使用错误，要么使用模型内部置信度进行开放式QA的置信门控检索，均未解决"在生成开始前，检索本身是否对该私有代码查询结构上充分"这一问题。
AI.method: 提出RCL（Retrieval-Confidence Layer），一个轻量级模块，插入在检索与生成之间。其核心包含两个评分函数：(1) 基于调用图的结构覆盖度评分（call-graph-derived structural coverage score），评估检索结果对查询所涉及代码结构的覆盖程度；(2) 新颖性评分（novelty score），估计查询对模型先验知识之外知识的依赖程度。当综合置信度低于校准阈值时，RCL触发有针对性的后续检索，或将输出标记为需人工审核，而非在上下文不完整的情况下静默生成。论文还提出了一种评估方法：通过将合成的内部API注入开源Java代码库来构建私有代码基准测试，模拟企业环境而不使用专有代码。
AI.result: 论文在第7节报告了RCL与仅基于相似度的检索方法在生成正确性方面的对比结果（具体数值需参阅第7节）。整体定位是：检索充分性作为独立信号应被结构性地评估，而非仅依赖模型内部置信度，这是构建私有企业场景下更安全代码生成系统目前被低估的关键信号。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心结论是：在私有代码库场景下，检索充分性（retrieval sufficiency）应作为一个独立且有别于模型内部置信度的信号进行结构性评估。RCL通过提前检测检索不足并触发补救措施（追加检索或人工审核），能够避免代码生成中的静默错误，为企业级代码生成系统提供更可靠的安全保障机制。

title: SaltBench: A Referee-Gated Protocol for Measuring Method Effects in Machine-Checked Software Work
summary: SaltBench is a benchmark protocol for one question: How does a machine referee change the way a coding agent works? A machine referee --- a proof kernel, a program verifier, or a withheld test suite --- decides what an agent's work is worth, and the agent cannot argue with it. Here we report a protocol that makes the referee's effect measurable and whose answers cannot be narrated afterwards: every outcome is decided outside the agent's own toolchain; the agent is walled off from the network, the reference solutions and the harness itself, and the wall is tested by probes that try to breach it before any scored run, so the isolation is observed rather than assumed; every run is authorized by a dated freeze with its predictions registered; and a budget stop is a halt, never a failure. In this study, the subject of the benchmark is a ``seat'', meaning an agent session in its standard harness. We tested five systems components, all authored in Rust under a pinned Verus toolchain, with a withheld test suite as the referee for each. Four arms are tested: a plain agent; an agent that is also instructed to create a specification and verify the code against it, in a reduced rendering of the method, as registered; and two arms where the specification is provided a priori, extended under a dated amendment to $k=4$, where the registered sign test reached no verdict (3 of 4, $p = 0.3125$, every premium below the resolvable floor). We found that the arm instructed to specify and verify cost more on all five components, and by a practical margin: across these five components no premium exceeded $2.8879\times$ under either reading of the declared set, and the three cheapest sat below $1.4\times$. That bound is a property of this population and not a promise about larger ones: the premium runs near $1$ on the smallest components and rises with size. We publish the complete record.

AI.tldr: SaltBench 是一个基准测试协议，旨在可测量地评估"机器裁判"（如证明内核、程序验证器或保留测试套件）对编码智能体工作方式的影响。该研究以"工作席位"（agent session）为主体，在五个用 Rust/Verus 编写的系统组件上测试四种指令臂：纯代理、要求编写规范并验证代码的代理，以及两个预先提供规范的扩展臂。结果显示：被指示编写规范并验证的指令臂在所有五个组件上都更昂贵（单边符号检验 p=0.0312），但五个组件中有三个的溢价低于可分辨下限 2.0072×，因此不能报告总体幅度；黄金配对（预先提供规范）经扩展至 k=4 后未达到判定（3/4，p=0.3125）。
AI.motivation: 智能体对自身工作的叙述是最不可靠的证据。传统基准测试允许智能体自评或允许实验者在运行后选择解读方式，衡量的只是故事而非结果。本研究旨在构建一个协议，使裁判效应可测量，且其结论事后无法被重新叙述——通过外部裁判、隔离墙实测、预注册冻结和预算停机而非失败的规则来实现。核心问题是：当一个智能体被要求在机器检查的形式化方法下工作时，这种方法（"Salt 方法"）会给它带来多大的成本？
AI.method: 协议设计包括：1) 外部裁判（保留测试套件在智能体外运行）；2) 隔离墙通过 macOS Seatbelt 沙箱强制执行，并由五项烟雾探针在评分运行前主动探测穿透；3) 通过日期冻结提交进行预注册，预测和不利结果名称在第一次模型调用前固定；4) 预算上限视为中止而非失败；5) 编写五个系统组件（Crc32、FreeList、LRU、LZW、Paxos）的自有任务群体（非公开抽取），全部用 Rust + Verus 编写；6) 测试四种指令臂：plain-bare、diet-bare（精简版方法）、plain-statement（预先提供规范）、diet-statement（精简方法 + 预先规范），使用 claude-opus-5 模型，每个条件 n=3；7) 测量指标为每次单元的计量订阅花费（美元），主要读数为跨问题符号检验。
AI.result: 主要结果：diet-bare 臂在五个组件上的成本均高于 plain-bare 臂，单边符号检验在两种读数下均为 5/5，p=0.0312。但只有 FreeList（2.8070× / 2.8879×）和 Paxos（2.4306× / 2.2437×）超过可分辨下限 2.0072×；Crc32、LZW 和 LRU 均低于该下限，因此不能报告总体幅度。黄金配对（预先提供规范的两种方法比较）扩展至 k=4 后为 3/4，p=0.3125，未达到判定。后续正确性检查未能在各臂之间分离结果。出现的仪器发现包括：截断的封顶返回封顶值；统计量仅在封顶单位内是其价格；门控可能因应用处理而惩罚处理；屏幕误报在构造上不可见；拒绝列表的广度仅等同于执行它的层；不绑定声明集的边界无效；评分板对其数据集结构沉默。
AI.conclusion: SaltBench 提供了一个协议，使"机器裁判"对编码智能体工作方式的影响可被测量。其首次测量在被指令编写规范并验证代码的臂上显示出所有五个组件上的成本溢价（p=0.0312），但由于三个组件的幅度低于可分辨下限，且没有组件在评分时携带正确性判定，因此不能声称该方法改变了裁判接受的内容。该协议产生了一套可转移的仪器发现。问题仍然开放：需要在 S2-Lean 上使用修复后的 oracle 变体、S2-Rust 上更低层级、以及 S3-Systems 上具有正确性配对的扩展群体来执行版本 2。

title: FST Pay: Deterministic Safety-Gated Architecture for Youth Digital Payments
summary: Digital payment infrastructures increasingly provide adolescent users with direct access to real-time financial services. While early access promotes financial literacy and digital inclusion, it exposes young users to severe risks of impulsive spending, social engineering frauds, unauthorized transactions, and merchant exploitation. Conventional countermeasures rely on probabilistic machine learning or rigid static controls. However, allowing probabilistic or generative artificial intelligence (AI) models to directly influence real-time payment authorization introduces non-determinism, unpredictable edge-case behavior, and critical audit vulnerabilities. This paper introduces Financial Safety for Teens Pay (FST Pay) as an architectural and formal specification. FST Pay is founded on an immutable operational boundary: strict deterministic safety gating on the real-time authorization path coupled with decoupled downstream AI explanation. Transactions initiated via rails like UPI are subjected to six deterministic invariant checks covering spending limits, guardian co-sign policies, transaction amount thresholds, merchant category codes, temporal access intervals, and hardware integrity constraints. Transactions are classified strictly into ALLOW, REVIEW, or BLOCK outcomes through an ordered, mutually exclusive decision function. High-risk transactions trigger an asynchronous guardian co-sign workflow. Generative AI is relegated entirely downstream of settlement, consuming published post-decision events solely to generate natural-language financial insights without holding mutation privileges over the ledger.

AI.tldr: FST Pay提出了一种面向青少年数字支付的安全架构,通过实时确定性安全门控与下游生成式AI解释解耦的方式,在保证金融清算确定性的同时提供可解释性。
AI.motivation: 青少年过早接触实时数字支付面临冲动消费、欺诈、未经授权交易等风险;现有方案要么采用概率性ML导致审计性差、决策不可预测,要么采用静态规则缺乏上下文解释,而将生成式AI直接用于支付授权存在幻觉、提示注入等严重隐患,需在金融清算的确定性与用户解释的灵活性之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 1) 基于ABAC扩展,构建六维安全不变量向量I={Is, Iauto, Ia, Im, It, Ir},分别对应滚动速度约束、自主清算不变量、单笔交易上限、商户类别限制、宵禁时间窗口、平台硬件信任根认证;2) 定义确定性决策函数D:T→Ω,将每笔交易严格映射到{ALLOW, REVIEW, BLOCK}三元闭集,采用有序互斥的优先级评估;3) 引入架构级非干扰不变量Cap(f_AI)∩{write-ledger, write-wallet, mutate-auth}=∅,通过能力隔离(只读Kafka消费者、隔离数据库连接池)确保下游生成式AI无账本变更权限;4) 设计双阶段管道:Tier1-5分层架构,包括Spring Boot确定性门控服务、Python异步AI工作器、PostgreSQL Aurora不可变分类账、Redis滑动窗口速度缓存、Kafka审计事件流。
AI.result: 论文为架构与形式化规范,未报告实验基准数据,仅提出未来测试床实现的评估框架(p99<15ms延迟、零误放行、监护人响应延迟、AI故障下系统可用性、100%账本可追溯性);理论对比显示FST Pay在决策确定性、解释机制、幻觉风险、监护人监督粒度、审计完整性方面相对纯概率ML、无约束生成AI代理、传统静态零售银行均具优势。
AI.conclusion: FST Pay通过在同步授权路径上强制消除概率性与生成式组件,并将生成式AI严格隔离至结算后的只读事件消费位置,实现了青少年数字支付安全与透明解释的架构级解耦;该设计符合NIST AI 600-1关于生成式AI风险管理的要求,具备形式化不变量、UML时序模型与规范化关系模式,但尚缺乏生产部署基准数据、机器可验证的形式化证明以及对监护人离线场景、MCC伪造商户类别的应对机制,均为未来工作方向。

title: TripleBound: Triplet-Guided Heterogeneous Graph Learning for Microservice Decomposition
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures. Replication package available on GitHub
summary: Cloud computing and DevOps have made microservices a common architecture for scalable, maintainable software systems. However, migrating monoliths to microservices remains challenging due to tight coupling and unclear service boundaries. Existing decomposition approaches typically rely on either structural dependencies or semantic similarity signals, but rarely integrate both within a unified representation learning objective. This paper proposes TripleBound, a hybrid framework for automated monolith-to-microservices decomposition that augments a heterogeneous graph neural network with weakly supervised triplet constraints derived from parser-inferred service groups based on package structure, naming conventions, and code location. TripleBound injects triplet-based constraints directly into the shared structural latent space, enabling both signals to be jointly optimized during representation learning. Structural dependencies are captured using CHGNN, which models the monolith as a heterogeneous graph with program nodes, resource nodes, CALL edges, and CRUD edges. Semantic relationships are incorporated through triplet constraints generated from parser-inferred service groups. Evaluation on AcmeAir, DayTrader, PlantsByWebSphere, and JPetStore shows that TripleBound achieves the highest composite decomposition score under the selected weighting on AcmeAir, DayTrader, and JPetStore compared to CHGNN and MonoEmbed, while CHGNN remains stronger on PlantsByWebSphere. Per-metric analysis reveals trade-offs: gains in structural modularity and inter-partition coupling are accompanied by higher entity distribution imbalance on some datasets. Alternative composite weightings preserve TripleBound's first-place ranking on AcmeAir and DayTrader but not on JPetStore, showing that the aggregate ranking is metric-dependent.

AI.tldr: 提出TripleBound框架，通过将解析器推断的弱监督三元组约束注入到异构图神经网络（CHGNN）的共享结构潜空间中，实现结构依赖与语义相似性的联合优化，用于自动化单体到微服务的分解。
AI.motivation: 现有微服务分解方法通常仅依赖结构依赖或语义相似性中的单一信号，难以同时捕获软件组件间的依赖结构与领域语义关系，限制了分解质量。
AI.method: 将单体建模为含程序节点、资源节点、CALL边和CRUD边的异构图，基于CHGNN进行结构表示学习；通过解析器从包结构、命名约定和代码位置推断服务组，构建弱监督三元组（anchor/positive/negative）并注入同一编码器的共享潜空间；提出包含节点/边重构损失、聚类一致性损失、三元组局部距离正则化与语义三元组margin损失、以及可微的Inter-Cluster Communication Loss（ICC）的联合训练目标，采用动态权重机制平衡局部距离与语义三元组监督。
AI.result: 在AcmeAir、DayTrader、JPetStore三个基准上，TripleBound在选定权重（w_SM=3）下获得最高复合分解分数；在PlantsByWebSphere上CHGNN更强。TripleBound在结构模块性（SM）和跨分区通信（ICP）上有改进，但在某些数据集上实体分布均衡性（NED）出现退化；JPetStore上的优势对权重设置敏感。
AI.conclusion: TripleBound证明弱监督语义三元组可以直接注入结构潜空间进行联合优化，是一种有前景的、应用依赖性的分解配置；但其优势对数据集、指标和权重选择敏感，并非均匀或绝对的优越性，未来工作需进行组件消融、统计显著性检验、运行时/领域信号融合与自适应权重机制。

title: Exploring the Role of Security Experience and ChatGPT Usage Strategies on Secure Software Engineering Education
summary: The rapid adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) is reshaping software engineering education, but their role in secure software engineering education remains underexplored. We report an exploratory empirical study of how 26 graduate students in a part-time MSc Cybersecurity programme used ChatGPT during a vulnerability-fixing assignment. To characterise ChatGPT use, we analysed students' ChatGPT interaction logs using a structured double-coding procedure and examined whether usage patterns and prior cybersecurity expertise were associated with assignment performance. The results show that students with varying levels of cybersecurity expertise used broadly similar ChatGPT strategies. Individual usage patterns showed descriptive differences by grade, but none remained statistically significant after correcting for multiple comparisons. In contrast, diversity of ChatGPT usage, i.e., the number of distinct usage patterns adopted, was positively associated with performance, even after controlling for cybersecurity expertise. These exploratory findings suggest that the way students engage with ChatGPT may be more informative than whether they use it, and motivate future controlled studies to guide students toward effective LLM use in secure software engineering education.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分析26名研究生在漏洞修复作业中使用ChatGPT的对话日志，探讨了使用模式与作业成绩之间的关系。研究发现，单个使用模式与成绩的关联在多重比较校正后均不显著，但ChatGPT使用模式的多样性（采用的不同模式数量）与成绩呈显著正相关，且在控制网络安全专业背景后依然成立。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）在软件工程教育中的应用日益广泛，但在安全软件工程教育中的作用尚未得到充分探索。现有研究多将LLM使用视为二元变量（用或不用），忽略了不同交互模式的影响。该领域需要理解学生如何与ChatGPT互动，以及这些互动方式如何影响学习成果。
AI.method: 采用探索性实证研究方法，对26名在职MSc网络安全专业研究生在漏洞修复作业中的ChatGPT交互日志进行分析。使用Saldaña的半开放编码程序，由两名研究者独立编码并通过共识解决分歧，形成14个使用模式（P1-P14）。采用描述性比较、Wilcoxon秩和检验、Spearman相关分析和线性回归等统计方法分析数据，并使用Benjamini-Hochberg方法进行多重比较校正。
AI.result: RQ1结果显示，不同网络安全专业水平的学生使用了基本相似的ChatGPT策略；RQ2结果显示，单个使用模式与成绩存在描述性差异（如生成基于缓解措施的代码+26.5分），但经多重比较校正后均不显著；RQ3结果显示，使用模式多样性与成绩呈中等正相关（ρ=0.375, p=0.030）；RQ4线性回归显示，每增加一个使用模式与成绩增加3.11分相关（b=3.11, p=0.033），且在控制专业水平后依然显著，而专业水平本身并非显著预测因子。模型解释约21%的方差。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，学生与ChatGPT的互动方式比是否使用ChatGPT更能预测表现，使用模式的多样性与漏洞修复成绩正相关。这一发现强调了批判性、多元化使用LLM的重要性，建议教育者引导学生将ChatGPT作为理解、调试、优化和验证修复的支持工具，而非简单的代码复制来源。研究为未来受控研究提出了五个假设（H1-H5），包括验证使用多样性对成绩的影响、设计指导性干预措施等。

title: CoSTAR: Data Synthesis-Driven Constraint-Aware COBOL Section Summarization for Legacy System Modernization
summary: COBOL remains critical to governments, financial institutions, and large enterprises; yet, aging technologies, shrinking expertise, and missing documentation make modernization of COBOL-based legacy systems increasingly urgent. Before migration, code summarization is a common practice to support legacy system understanding. However, COBOL code summarization, especially on section-level, faces two key challenges: data scarcity and migration constraint preservation. To address these challenges, we propose CoSTAR, an integrated framework that combines execution-validated data synthesis with constraint-aware model training. CoSTAR repurposes general-purpose programming tasks to synthesize execution-validated COBOL code-summary data through LLM-based generation to overcome data scarcity. Based on the synthesized data, CoSTAR augments target sections with relevant data declarations and natural-language explanations, and uses constraint-guided structured rationales to train smaller base LLMs. The trained LLMs preserve the migration constraints for COBOL section summarization. We evaluate CoSTAR on both public and confidential enterprise COBOL systems. CoSTAR effectively synthesizes 3,764 execution-validated training instances. Based on these instances, CoSTAR built on 7B/8B base LLMs can improve these LLMs with average relative gains of 25.38% on ROUGE-L, 53.84% on METEOR, and 37.22% on chrF. In real-world enterprise evaluation, CoSTAR built on only Qwen3-8B, outperforms the enterprise-deployed Qwen3-235B in accuracy, completeness, and conciseness. These results show that CoSTAR enables small, locally deployable LLMs to achieve performance competitive with substantially larger LLMs for privacy-sensitive COBOL legacy systems.

AI.tldr: CoSTAR是一个针对COBOL遗留系统现代化的section级代码摘要生成框架。它通过执行验证的数据合成和约束感知的模型训练两个阶段，解决COBOL section级代码摘要面临的数据稀缺和迁移约束保留两大挑战。在7B/8B基础LLM上取得显著提升，并在真实企业评估中以Qwen3-8B超越企业部署的Qwen3-235B。
AI.motivation: COBOL仍支撑全球关键基础设施（金融、政府等），处理80%的金融交易和约3万亿美元的日商业交易。然而，遗留COBOL系统面临技术老化、专家稀缺、文档缺失等严重挑战。直接LLM迁移（如DOGE对SSA的尝试）已证明不可靠，需要在迁移前先理解遗留系统。COBOL section级代码摘要面临两大核心挑战：(1) 数据稀缺——COBOL仅占编程语言token的0.0186%，且公开数据缺少section级摘要；(2) 迁移约束保留——COBOL将数据定义（data division）与执行逻辑（procedure division）分离，仅靠section代码无法恢复影响行为的PIC、VALUE等关键约束。
AI.method: CoSTAR包含三个阶段：(1) Stage 1数据合成——利用CodeFlowBench中的函数级编程任务（11,592个），通过LLM生成COBOL实现并用GnuCOBOL 3.2编译和测试执行验证（Accept=Compile∧PassAll），从10,924个合格子问题中产出3,764个执行验证的训练实例。(2) Stage 2约束感知训练——训练两个任务特定模型：model-explain（通过正则在data division中提取相关identifier定义并解释其语义）和model-summary（使用四阶段结构化rationale：Identifier Explanation→Constraint Analysis→Logic Abstraction→Final Summary，由teacher LLM生成、judge LLM按Context Adherence/Logical Coherence/Constraint Coverage三标准质量控制），均用LoRA微调。(3) Stage 3推理——顺序应用两个模型，仅需section和数据划分，不依赖大型teacher/judge LLM，支持本地部署。实现细节：teacher使用DeepSeek-V3.2生成代码，Qwen3-Coder-480B生成监督，DeepSeek-R1作为judge。
AI.result: 在Stack-120（120个开源COBOL section）自动评估上：(1) RQ1整体有效性——CoSTAR在四个7B/8B基础LLM上平均相对提升25.38% (ROUGE-L)、53.84% (METEOR)、37.22% (chrF)；最佳变体在METEOR和BERTScore上超越所有大型LLM基线（DeepSeek-V3.2/4-Flash、Gemini-2.5/3.1-Flash-Lite、Claude-Haiku-4.5）。(2) RQ2数据规模——500→3,764实例持续提升各项指标，从2000到3764仍有显著增益。(3) RQ3扩展上下文——Code+IE比仅用Code在METEOR上提升27.89%，Code+DD+IE（Full）最优，METEOR提升34.69%。(4) RQ4结构化rationale——CoSTAR比Summary-only SFT在METEOR上进一步提升52.87%，证明结构化rationale监督是关键贡献。(5) RQ5工业应用——在Industrial-200（200个企业机密section）上，CoSTAR-Qwen3-8B以8B参数在准确性(+4.35%)、完整性(+8.06%)、简洁性(+4.21%)上显著超越企业部署的Qwen3-235B，Holm校正后p<0.01，Fleiss' kappa=0.763（substantial agreement）。
AI.conclusion: CoSTAR通过执行验证的数据合成和约束感知推理的结合，使小型本地可部署LLM能够有效支持COBOL程序理解和现代化。在隐私敏感的遗留系统场景中，经过任务专门化的8B模型可以超越企业部署的235B模型，验证了针对低资源遗留语言的专用框架的实用价值。未来工作将扩展至更多工业系统、COBOL方言、程序粒度和其他低资源编程语言。

title: Deep Learning-based Bug Triage System
summary: Effective bug triage is crucial for streamlining the software development lifecycle by accurately categorizing and assigning reported software defects. In this paper, we propose an automated bug triage system built upon the pre-trained RoBERTa-base transformer architecture. By leveraging deep contextual representations, our approach efficiently classifies incoming bug reports to optimize assignment. Experimental evaluation demonstrates that the proposed system achieves a strong bug identification accuracy of 0.90 within just five training epochs. These findings highlight the efficiency and high performance of fine-tuned transformer models for practical software engineering automation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于预训练RoBERTa-base Transformer架构的自动化Bug分诊系统，用于对Bug报告进行分类和组件识别，仅用5个训练周期即在Bug二元分类任务上达到了0.90的准确率。
AI.motivation: 软件维护占总成本的40%-80%，且Bug分诊耗费维护时间超30%。传统人工阅读Bug报告并分配组件的方式耗时耗力，且并非所有报告都是真实有效Bug（存在重复、无效等）。因此需要自动化方法提升分诊效率。
AI.method: 方法流程包括三个步骤：1）数据收集：从Bugzilla提取Client Software类型产品的BugSummary、Component和Resolution信息，共69431条报告；2）数据清洗：对Bug摘要进行特殊字符去除、停用词消除和词形还原；3）分类：使用RoBERTa-base Transformer进行微调，执行两个任务——组件识别（325类多分类）和Bug识别（二分类，FIXED=1，否则=0）。实验在Tesla T4单GPU上进行，90%训练集/10%测试集划分，仅训练5个周期。
AI.result: 组件识别任务：训练和验证损失均随周期下降，5周期准确率约0.70。Bug识别任务：训练损失下降但验证损失上升，存在轻微过拟合，5周期准确率超过0.90。
AI.conclusion: 基于Transformer微调的Bug分诊系统能有效捕获Bug报告的深层语义，以少量计算成本实现高精度（0.90）。未来工作包括在更大异构多项目数据集上评估、引入严重程度预测、以及采用轻量化/蒸馏Transformer模型以降低部署成本。

title: ChurnBench: A Drift-Aware Benchmark Demonstrating That Refresh Scheduling, Not Cache Age, Governs Staleness in Agentic AI
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Code, data, and evaluation harness: this https URL
summary: In production, agentic systems answer questions over data that lives in several places and keeps changing: licenses are reassigned, users offboarded, prices changed, contracts renewed. Existing retrieval benchmarks freeze the data, so they cannot ask whether an agent's answer is still true, only whether it found the right passage. We present ChurnBench, an open-source benchmark that generates a four-source enterprise data fabric as a timeline rather than a snapshot. Every change is written to an append-only ground-truth ledger, and gold answers are computed from that ledger, never from the live stores. An answer that was correct when its data was retrieved but wrong when evaluated is therefore detected and labeled a freshness error, distinct from a reasoning error; we validate this by resolving ground truth at both timestamps for every case reported. Using the instrument, we find that when a system refreshes on a schedule, cache age does not predict staleness. Across cache ages of 1, 14, and 28 days, freshness errors were 7, 4, and 4, because scheduled refresh bounds staleness by time-to-live, and no TTL lapse was observed in any window. A controlled ablation confirms the mechanism: disabling tiered refresh raises freshness errors from 4 to 45 at 28 days and leaves them identical at one day. The variable a drift benchmark should sweep is therefore TTL configuration against each entity's rate of change, not drift-window length. ChurnBench, the evaluation harness, and all per-error data are released open source.

AI.tldr: ChurnBench 是一个面向企业多源动态数据环境的开源基准测试，将数据建模为时间线而非快照，通过仅追加的"真值账本"计算标准答案，专门用于区分 agentic 系统的"新鲜性错误"（freshness error，即数据检索时正确但评估时已过时）与"推理错误"（reasoning error）。
AI.motivation: 现有检索基准测试对数据进行"冻结"，因此只能评估 agent 是否找到正确段落，而无法评估其答案在动态企业数据环境中是否仍然为真。本文旨在填补这一空白：现有评测忽略了企业数据持续变更（许可证重新分配、用户离职、价格变动、合同续签等）所带来的"陈旧性"问题。
AI.method: 1. 生成一个由四个数据源组成的企业数据 fabric，并将其构建为时间线（timeline）而非快照。2. 所有变更记录到仅追加的"真值账本"（append-only ground-truth ledger）中。3. 标准答案（gold answers）仅从该账本计算，而非从实时数据存储计算。4. 对每个案例同时在两个时间戳（检索时刻和评估时刻）解析真值，从而验证新鲜性错误的判定。5. 设置不同的缓存刷新策略，对比不同缓存年龄（1、14、28 天）下的错误率。6. 进行对照消融实验：禁用分层刷新（tiered refresh），观察错误率变化。
AI.result: 1. 当系统按计划刷新时，缓存年龄（cache age）并不能预测陈旧性（staleness）。2. 在 1、14、28 天的缓存年龄下，新鲜性错误数量分别为 7、4、4；原因是计划刷新通过 TTL（生存时间）限制了陈旧性上限，且在任何时间窗口内都未观察到 TTL 失效。3. 对照消融实验：禁用分层刷新后，28 天时新鲜性错误从 4 升至 45，而 1 天时错误数保持不变。4. 真正应被扫掠的变量是 TTL 配置与每个实体变更速率的匹配关系，而非"漂移窗口长度"（drift-window length）。
AI.conclusion: ChurnBench、其评测框架（evaluation harness）以及所有逐错误数据均已开源。该工作表明：评估动态数据环境下的 agentic 系统，应关注 TTL 配置与实体变更速率的匹配，而非简单的时间窗口长度；分层刷新机制能有效将陈旧性控制在 TTL 范围内。

title: PRISMA-LLM: An Empirical Reporting Framework for AI-Assisted Systematic Reviews
summary: Large language models (LLMs) and AI-enabled software increasingly participate in systematic-review decisions, yet the information needed to audit these workflows is reported inconsistently. We analyze SciLitBench, a corpus of 888 review-automation papers with 14,726 annotations, to characterize changes in methods, review-stage use, evaluation and reported limitations. Automation has shifted toward LLM- and software-facing workflows, including stages that can alter the evidence base. Since 2023, 38.0% of software/product papers reported no evaluation, compared with 9.3% of LLM papers. Reporting coverage increased with LLM workflow complexity, yet 52% of positive-only LLM evaluations still reported an unmet reliability or performance requirement. From these patterns, we introduce PRISMA-LLM, an empirically grounded framework separating implementation disclosure from consequence-sensitive evaluation and limitation reporting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PRISMA-LLM 报告框架，基于 SciLitBench 语料库（888 篇文献自动化论文，14,726 条标注）的实证分析，旨在规范 LLM 辅助系统综述的报告标准。研究发现软件/产品类论文 38.0% 未报告任何评估（LLM 论文仅 9.3%），且 52% 的纯正面评价 LLM 论文仍报告了未达可靠性要求的问题，揭示了"有用"与"适合委派"之间的判断差异。框架采用三层结构：通用清单、五级实施披露层次、后果敏感型评估期望，明确将披露层级与风险层级区分。
AI.motivation: LLM 与 AI 赋能软件正深度参与系统综述决策（包括筛选、数据提取、合成等关键阶段），但相关工作流的可审计信息披露不一致。现有 PRISMA-AI、PRISMA-trAIce 等扩展框架尚未建立在对实际报告实践的实证分析之上，难以判断哪些报告维度最具实质意义。
AI.method: 对 SciLitBench 语料库（888 篇系统综述自动化论文，14,726 条标注）进行二次分析，方法包括：(1) 时间趋势分析（2010–2025年6月，滚动3月窗口，log-linear 拟合估计月增长率4.7%）；(2) 构建 0–15 分的"报告丰富度"描述性指数（覆盖性能、比较、修改、资源、局限性五个维度）；(3) 按方法类型（传统 ML/深度学习/BERT/LLM/软件产品）和 LLM 时代工作流复杂度（提示词式、结构化、检索/适配/智能体、多智能体）分组比较；(4) 报告丰富度与无评估率统计对比（2023 年后论文）；(5) 整体印象与高门槛未达率关联分析。
AI.result: (1) 自动化工作流已从搜索导航扩展至筛选/选择和证据构建等可能改变证据基础的阶段；(2) 2023 年后软件/产品论文平均报告丰富度 3.3，38.0% 无评估；LLM 论文 6.3，9.3% 无评估；(3) 报告丰富度随 LLM 工作流复杂度单调上升：纯提示词 5.2（13.4% 无评估）→ 工程化 8.4（1.7%）→ 检索/适配/智能体 9.1（0%）；(4) 118 篇纯正面评价 LLM 论文中 52% 仍报告了高门槛未达问题；(5) 84.1% LLM 使用专有/托管模型，仅 4.9% 开放权重。
AI.conclusion: PRISMA-LLM 框架以三层结构（通用清单 16 项、五级实施披露、后果敏感型评估）将实施披露与后果评估分离，强调披露层级而非风险层级。该框架基于实证模式而非方法论风险评分，鼓励在关键决策点（无论技术复杂度如何）触发更强的评估要求。框架尚未经过正式共识制定或前瞻性用户测试，需未来验证与完善。

title: Reproducibility in the Age of Agentic AI: Context Engineering at the Timescale of a Codebase
summary: Reproducible research practices are context engineering for AI coding agents. I argue that agents lower the cost of maintaining tests, commit histories, repository structure, instructions, and decision records while making their benefits immediate. Researchers remain responsible for verifying these artifacts and the scientific judgments they encode.

AI.tldr: 本文主张可复现性研究实践本质上是为AI编程智能体所做的"上下文工程",并将传统的良好软件工程实践(测试套件、提交历史、仓库结构、指令文件、决策记录)重新诠释为代码库尺度上的上下文工程。文章论证智能体显著降低了这些制品的生产成本,同时让它们的收益变得立竿见影,从而使可复现性实践获得了前所未有的推动力,但研究者仍须作为所有者与验证者对制品的科学判断负责。
AI.motivation: 作者长期倡导可复现研究实践,但深感这些实践因高摩擦成本而难以推广;生成式AI智能体的出现带来了重新评估这一现状的契机。动机在于解释为何传统的良好软件实践在智能体时代获得了新的存在理由,以及如何借此推动可复现研究的真正落地。
AI.method: 本文为观点/论述性论文(essay),而非实证研究。方法上通过:(a)对一个现有智能体系统进行"上下文设计"视角的解构诊断;(b)将五类传统制品(指令文件、测试套件、提交历史、仓库结构、决策记录)逐一映射到智能体上下文的类别(常驻语义记忆、可执行语义记忆、情景记忆、预处理上下文、静态上下文);(c)交叉引用GitHub对2500份智能体指令文件的实证研究以及研究-软件工程(RSE)社区的关切声明,论证多源汇流;(e)对乐观论点给出三类限定(技能退化、生成非确定性、激励错位)并加以回应。
AI.result: 作者得出若干结论:(1)每一项良好的研究软件实践都严格对应一种智能体上下文类别,是"代码库尺度上的上下文工程";(2) GitHub研究显示高效的指令文件覆盖指令、测试、项目结构、代码风格、git工作流、边界六个领域,其中四项与可复现性实践几乎完全重合,体现两条独立路径的汇流;(3) 智能体将制品的逐次成本压低至接近零,同时让原本的长周期回报获得了即时收益——同一份制品既服务未来读者也服务当下会话;(4) 新出现的"调用层"(斜杠命令、技能)是可复现实践在智能体时代的新组成部分;(5) 验证与所有权归人类,制品本身不能替代研究者的科学判断;(6) 训练数据出处、资源不平等、机构卸责等更宏观议题超出本文范围。
AI.conclusion: 可复现性与"对智能体友好"是同一属性的两面——都为缺乏作者上下文情境的读者(人类或机器)服务的外部化记录。AI智能体并未自行让研究变得可复现,但它把"按可复现方式工作"的成本压低、把回报即时化,从而使过去难以推广的实践获得了新的、更易被接受的论据。研究者必须保留作为所有者与验证者的位置:可以委托起草,但不可委托判断。论文以对2012年《可复现性PI宣言》的更新作结,新增了关于指令文件、特征测试、决策记录、提交原因说明以及对智能体的受控调用等承诺。

title: An analysis of the relationship of input metrics
summary: Input metrics evaluate the progress of testing in terms of features of inputs present in a test suite. Previous works, as early as the 1950s, established a number of such metrics, but few endeavored to compare them. This paper does so by utilizing existing methods proposed for other metric classes in partition testing literature. After defining and reviewing common input metrics, we begin with a short case study revealing that typical empirical comparison strategies are fundamentally insufficient for comparing metrics. Then, we demonstrate how one rigorously improves a standard metric by defining and implementing $k$-alt-path, a new metric which reduces redundancy while improving sensitivity over $k$-path. Each of the other common input metrics are then systematically compared before discussing the implications of our findings. With these contributions, we bring forward partition testing analysis methods that justify and form a strategy for future research in refining input metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文系统性地比较和改进了软件测试中的输入度量标准。作者指出传统经验比较方法的根本不足，提出了一种新的度量方法 k-alt-path，并系统地对比了常见输入度量。
AI.motivation: 输入度量用于评估测试套件对输入特征的覆盖程度，但自1950年代以来虽有多种此类度量被提出，却鲜有系统性的比较研究。现有的经验性比较策略存在根本性的不足，无法有效区分和评估不同的输入度量，因此需要更严格的方法来比较和改进这些度量。
AI.method: 1. 定义并综述常见的输入度量；2. 通过短案例研究揭示典型经验比较策略的根本不足；3. 基于分区测试文献中为其他度量类别提出的方法进行严格比较；4. 提出并实现 k-alt-path 新度量，作为对标准 k-path 度量的改进；5. 系统性地比较各种常见输入度量。
AI.result: 1. 揭示了典型经验比较策略对比较度量而言根本不够充分；2. 成功定义并实现了 k-alt-path 新度量，该度量在减少冗余的同时提高了相对于 k-path 的灵敏度；3. 系统性地比较了其他常见输入度量；4. 提出了未来细化输入度量的研究策略和方向。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过引入分区测试分析方法，为输入度量的比较和改进提供了严格的方法论基础。所提出的 k-alt-path 度量改进了标准度量，并形成了一套未来研究输入度量细化的策略，对软件测试领域的度量研究具有重要贡献。

title: DR-LabStack: Design and Implementation of a Clinician-Facing Web System for Diabetic Retinopathy Prediction
summary: Pretrained diabetic retinopathy (DR) prediction models differ in their input fields, serialization formats, preprocessing requirements, and output semantics. Making these models accessible through a common clinical interface therefore requires explicit coordination between the user interface and the inference service. We designed and implemented DR-LabStack, a React-Flask web system integrating four externally developed pretrained models: RuleFit, Pruned RuleFit, Elaborative XGBoost, and Two-level Ensemble. A shared form retrieves ordered model features, renders model-specific numerical and categorical controls, and constructs a positional input vector. Backend adapters load heterogeneous artifacts and apply the ensemble's accompanying scaler, while a common JSON response supports binary classification display alongside method and source information. Functional evaluation on September 8, 2026 used copied application files and real model artifacts in a documented isolated environment. All four models loaded and exposed their 14-, 6-, 8-, and 25-field contracts. Sixty-two Flask test-client requests characterized service behavior; 12 limited-vector checks confirmed invocation-path and threshold consistency. Twenty-four browser-component scenarios with mocked transport verified input ordering and result rendering and characterized input-validation behavior. The resulting system demonstrates a reusable interaction and serving workflow for heterogeneous DR models. The contribution is web-system design, integration, and software functionality; clinical effectiveness and clinician usability require separate evaluation.

AI.tldr: DR-LabStack 是一个面向临床医生的 Web 系统，基于 React–Flask 架构集成了四个异构的糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）预训练模型（RuleFit、Pruned RuleFit、Elaborative XGBoost、Two-level Ensemble），通过共享表单、自适应后端适配器和统一 JSON 响应实现位置式输入向量的协调；论文报告了功能性软件评估结果，但未进行临床或可用性验证。
AI.motivation: 不同的 DR 预训练模型在输入字段、序列化格式、预处理需求和输出语义上存在显著差异。核心动机是解决三个工程问题：(1) 位置式推理 API 中特征顺序是正确性条件；(2) 异构工件需要模型特定的加载和预处理（含外部 scaler）；(3) 统一显示必须区分共享响应格式与共享概率含义，从而为临床医生提供一个可复用的交互与服务工作流。
AI.method: 系统采用 React 前端 + Flask 后端架构。前端通过 /get_features 接口动态获取每个模型的特征顺序，生成模型特定的数值/类别控件，并按相同顺序构建位置式输入向量；后端启动时递归扫描 models/ 目录（.pkl 和 .json），对 JSON XGBoost 和 Python 序列化分别采用不同适配器加载，对以 "two level ensemble" 开头的工件触发配对 StandardScaler 的 CompositeModel 包装；/predict 端点接收 JSON 列表并以严格阈值 >0.5 统一映射为二分类。评估采用三层证据：62 次 Flask test-client 请求、12 次有限向量路径与阈值一致性检查、24 次基于 React 19/Chrome 152 的浏览器组件场景（使用 mock transport）。
AI.result: 四个工件均成功加载并暴露其 14、6、8、25 字段契约；12 次路径/阈值检查全部一致；scaler 被排除在独立模型列表之外并与 ensemble 配对。62 次请求中：长度错误、空列表、非数值首值返回 500；数值字符串、嵌套单行列表、负值、域外神经病变码 9 被接受；未知模型/无效信封返回 400；未知模型特征返回 200+空列表。24 个浏览器场景验证了字段顺序渲染、class 0/1 文本映射、必填校验，以及十进制 stepMismatch 在 blur 后同步的现象。所有结果仅证明软件行为，不构成临床有效性证据。
AI.conclusion: DR-LabStack 演示了一个可复用的、面向异构 DR 模型共享的交互与服务工作流。其贡献在于 Web 系统设计、集成与软件功能性，而临床有效性与临床医生可用性仍需单独评估。未来工作应聚焦类型化特征 schema、服务端输入验证、显式模型-预处理对象绑定、可复现依赖环境、跨浏览器与真实前后端集成测试，并在授权队列与明确目标下开展诊断与可用性研究。

title: Estimating Inconsistency Response Surfaces under Uncertainty in Cyber-Physical System Development
comment: Extended version of the paper accepted at IEEE ICDM 2026; 10 pages + appendix, 11 figures, 3 tables
summary: Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS) are commonly represented through multiple interconnected models. During development, CPS consistency requires that shared model elements remain compatible across these models. Uncertainty, for example, due to sensor noise or model abstraction, changes the admissible values of model elements and can introduce inconsistencies, i.e., situations in which models can no longer be jointly satisfied. While existing approaches can determine consistency for a given uncertainty configuration, they provide limited support for systematically exploring, analyzing, and explaining inconsistency across large uncertainty spaces. We address this challenge by reformulating inconsistency as an intervention response modeling problem. Using Saltelli sampling and multi-fidelity Monte Carlo estimation, we generate intervention-response datasets and train a surrogate model that directly predicts inconsistency from the propagated uncertainty geometry. Experiments on 48 scenarios and 10 CPS domains show that the surrogate matches Monte Carlo estimates while reducing evaluation time from milliseconds to microseconds, enabling orders-of-magnitude more response-surface evaluations within fixed computational budgets. Building on the learned response surfaces, we perform sensitivity analysis to identify dominant uncertainty drivers and introduce a gradient-based consistency recourse method to determine minimal uncertainty interventions that restore consistency. The results show that inconsistency under uncertainty can be effectively learned, analyzed, and repaired through response-surface modeling, providing a scalable foundation for uncertainty-aware consistency management in CPS development.

AI.tldr: 本文针对信息物理系统（CPS）开发中多模型一致性分析面临的挑战，将不确定性下的一致性分析重新建模为干预-响应面学习问题。基于约束 zonotope 表示不确定性，通过 Saltelli 采样与多保真蒙特卡洛（MFMC）估计生成干预-响应数据集，训练 Product-Set Transformer（PST）代理模型直接从不确定性几何预测不一致性。在 48 个场景、10 个 CPS 领域上的实验表明，代理模型匹配 MC 精度但将评估时间从毫秒级降至微秒级，并支持灵敏度分析与基于梯度的一致性修复（recourse）。
AI.motivation: CPS 由多个相互关联的模型构成，一致性要求共享元素在各模型中保持兼容。不确定性（传感器噪声、模型抽象等）会改变模型元素的可接受值范围，可能引入不一致性。现有方法只能判断特定配置下是否一致，缺乏对大不确定性空间进行系统探索、分析和解释不一致性全局行为的支持。此外，精确的 zonotope 包含推理已被证明是 W[1]-难问题，难以扩展。
AI.method: 方法包含五个核心组件：(1) 基于约束 zonotope 的集合不确定性表示与通过不确定性映射（UM）的依赖传播；(2) 三种不一致性估计器——蒙特卡洛（MC）、轴对齐包围盒（AABB）几何代理、多保真蒙特卡洛（MFMC）控制变法（将样本相关性约0.94转化为8-11倍方差缩减）；(3) 干预配置 θ=(s_u, Δc_u, R_u)^T 参数化缩放、中心平移与相关性，通过 Saltelli 采样（2048 个基样本→16384 次评估）生成数据集；(4) Product-Set Transformer 代理——输入 5 个逐维特征（归一化中心偏移、源/目标幅度、生成器行对齐、宽比）+ 5 个全局特征（对数体积比、归一化中心距离、维度、支持函数特征），通过自注意力（2 头、64 维 FF）和逐维 MLP 解码为 log 包含概率，以"噪声 AND"乘积结构估计联合不一致性；(5) Sobol 全局敏感性分析 + 基于惩罚函数最小二乘的一致性修复（recourse），通过代理模型的解析梯度实现快速收敛。
AI.result: 在 48 个场景（10 个 CPS 领域：汽车、HVAC、机器人、医疗设备、铁路、卫星、智能电网、水/化工、风力涡轮机等）和 13 个未见场景上的实验表明：(1) MFMC 接近 MC 参考（ρ=0.997, R²=0.997），AABB 系统性高估不一致性（ρ=0.932）；(2) PST 代理达到 ρ∈[0.989,0.994]，MAE<0.015，低于 MC 标签噪声下限（0.016）；(3) 代理模型将 2D/3D 场景评估时间从 MFMC 的 3306μs 降至 4μs（827×加速），1 分钟内可完成 1700 万次评估；(4) 中心不确定性 Δc_u 是最主要驱动因素（S₁=0.36-0.45），缩放 s_u 次之，相关性 R_u 主要通过交互效应贡献（S_T≤0.20）；(5) 基于代理的修复方法在约 30ms 内找到近优解，而 MFMC 方法需超过 10 秒，成功率超 90%。架构消融证实 PST 在数据稀缺的 3D 保留场景上优于普通 MLP（R² 0.989 vs 0.781）。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的不一致性响应面建模框架将 CPS 一致性分析从单点验证转化为系统性的不确定性景观学习、灵敏度分析与可修复性推理。代理模型以微秒级推理速度与 MC 级精度相结合，使原本不可行的规模化干预探索成为可能，为不确定性感知的一致性管理提供了可扩展基础。未来工作将扩展到更大规模的多模型结构与更高维不确定性表示，并研究自适应采样策略以降低数据生成与代理训练成本。

title: DeFiFlowBench: Benchmarking and Improving Safe Executability in Natural-Language DeFi Workflow Synthesis
comment: Code and benchmark: this https URL
summary: A structurally valid DeFi workflow can still authorize a costly trade. We introduce DeFiFlowBench, a benchmark of 207 team-authored prompts for natural-language DeFi workflow synthesis. It measures graph coverage, configuration completeness, and declared safety predicates, then tests supported trade configurations on a local EVM. Direct, constrained, and few-shot prompting produce 14-19 unsafe held-out executions per configuration under a fixed 5% price-impact cap. A slippage bound derived from a quote does not prevent the price impact of the order itself. We propose Koan-Safe, which combines a prompt-only intent parser, a replaceable generator, and structural repair with default safety parameters. On 75 held-out workflow prompts, its hybrid variant scores 0.67 on the static safety proxy, compared with 0.33 for the best baseline. Koan-Safe records no unsafe executions on the saved benchmark outputs. A matched-candidate ablation produces 14-17 unsafe executions when enforcement is disabled. Additional tests expose the limits of default injection: permissive existing thresholds can still authorize unsafe trades. A separately evaluated policy cap addresses this failure on a 36-case diagnostic grid. These results support explicit trade protections and execution-based evaluation, while distinguishing declared safety from a general guarantee.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出DeFiFlowBench基准测试（207条团队编写的DeFi工作流合成提示）和Koan-Safe方法，旨在解决自然语言生成的DeFi工作流"结构有效但执行不安全"的问题。核心发现是滑点保护无法防止订单自身的价格冲击，并通过本地EVM执行验证表明基线方法产生14-19次不安全执行，而Koan-Safe混合变体在静态安全代理上达到0.67（最佳基线0.33），且零不安全执行。
AI.motivation: 结构有效的DeFi工作流仍可能授权高成本交易。现有研究关注工作流的结构正确性和可执行性，但忽略了交易保护机制是否充分——尤其是滑点保护与价格冲击保护的混淆问题。LLM基线即使有安全指令，也常常遗漏价格冲击门控，导致实际执行时产生严重损失。
AI.method: （1）DeFiFlowBench基准：207条提示（120开发+87留出），含3层静态评分（图形有效、可执行、静态安全代理）+本地EVM执行检查（恒定乘积AMM，5%价格冲击上限）。（2）Koan-Safe方法：解耦为提示型意图解析器+可替换生成器（规则/LLM/混合）+结构修复与默认安全参数注入层。（3）配对候选消融实验控制模型输出变化。（4）34对变形测试套件检验安全性对风险相关改写的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 基线方法在静态安全代理上≤0.33，产生14-19次不安全执行；Koan-Safe混合变体（Gemini）达到0.67且零不安全执行；强制层开启/关闭消融显示禁用时产生14-17次不安全执行；变形套件中Koan-Safe变体违反≤2/34对（基线15-16/32）。后置策略上限在36案例诊断网格上将不安全执行清零。但现有宽松阈值仍可授权不安全交易，表明默认注入存在局限。
AI.conclusion: 结构修复与安全默认值能改善静态覆盖与本地交易结果，但默认注入在候选已有宽松参数时不足。工作流接口需要显式单位契约、数值策略验证以及确保保护覆盖执行路径的检查。静态高分或零观察不安全执行不构成通用安全保证——需区分声明安全与一般保障，配置级执行评估与全工作流验证仍是不同层面的问题。

title: M3-Former: Multimodal Transformer with Mixture-of-Experts for Long-Term Vessel Trajectory Prediction
summary: To address the challenges of behavioral multimodality, limited semantic utilization, and long-term error accumulation in vessel trajectory prediction, this paper proposes M3-Former, a multimodal trajectory prediction framework enhanced by large language models (LLMs). The proposed framework incorporates vessel static attributes and navigational intent as semantic priors for long-term trajectory modeling. Specifically, a unified multimodal representation space is constructed, in which static semantic information is encoded by a pre-trained LLM and aligned with dynamic trajectory features through self-attention. To jointly capture global route planning and local motion variations, a dual-granularity Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture is introduced, where sequence-level experts model global navigation trends and token-level experts refine fine-grained maneuvering behaviors. In addition, a Steering-Weighted Cross-Entropy loss is designed to alleviate the long-tail distribution of sparse turning samples and improve prediction accuracy in critical maneuvering scenarios. Experiments on a real-world Danish AIS dataset demonstrate that M\textsuperscript{3}-Former consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across prediction horizons from 1 to 4 hours. In the 4-hour prediction task, the proposed method reduces Average Displacement Error (ADE) and Final Displacement Error (FDE) by 4.4\% and 5.1\%, respectively, compared with the strongest baseline. Qualitative and ablation analyses further verify that semantic fusion effectively reduces long-term trajectory drift, while the dual-granularity MoE improves robustness in complex waterways and route-branching scenarios. The proposed framework establishes a semantic-guided hierarchical prediction paradigm, in which high-level navigational intent and local motion dynamics are jointly modeled for robust long-term vessel trajectory forecasting.

AI.tldr: M3-Former提出了一种基于LLM语义增强和双粒度MoE架构的船舶轨迹长期预测框架，在丹麦AIS数据集上将4小时预测的ADE和FDE分别降低4.4%和5.1%。
AI.motivation: 长期船舶轨迹预测面临行为多模态性、语义信息利用不足和长时误差累积三大挑战。现有方法过度依赖动态轨迹特征而忽视高层导航意图语义，导致长时预测中误差迅速累积，且难以建模同一历史状态对应多条合理未来路径的多模态特性。
AI.method: 1) 多模态特征融合：静态船舶属性（如目的地、船型、尺寸、ETA）经自然语言描述后由冻结预训练LLM编码，与动态轨迹特征在统一序列维度拼接，通过共享Transformer自注意力实现跨模态对齐；2) 双粒度MoE架构：序列级MoE通过全局上下文池化和门控网络建模宏观导航趋势，令牌级MoE对每个时间步动态选择专家捕获局部机动行为，采用序列→令牌（MoE-S→T）的路由顺序；3) 转向加权交叉熵损失（SWCE）：基于相邻COG变化量对转弯样本施加额外权重，缓解直行样本主导的长尾分布问题；4) 空间离散化：将连续坐标回归转化为离散空间分类任务，实现多模态概率生成。
AI.result: 在丹麦海事局2023年Q1 AIS数据集（1,923,380样本，4,089艘船，26,374轨迹段）上，1-4小时预测均达到最优：4小时预测ADE=6.4727，FDE=13.6142，较TrAISformer分别降低4.4%和5.1%；消融实验验证MoE、多模态融合和转向加权损失三者均贡献正向增益；MoE-S→T配置的重要性为0.587且与验证损失呈负相关（-0.342），显著优于T→S配置。
AI.conclusion: M3-Former通过"语义引导的层次化建模"范式，将LLM提取的导航意图语义与双粒度MoE的局部-全局建模相结合，有效抑制了长时轨迹漂移，在急转弯、航道分叉等复杂场景中展现了优越的物理合理性和鲁棒性。

title: Halo: Improving forecast accuracy through heteroscedastic estimation
summary: Heteroscedastic forecasting, where a network estimates a scale parameter alongside a location parameter, is normally motivated by uncertainty quantification. This paper shows it also improves the point estimate, in contrast to reported negative results for heteroscedastic estimation outside time series. Halo is a modification that reuses an existing deep forecaster's architecture, giving it a second output for the scale of its implied distribution and training it under the matching negative log likelihood. Adapting three state-of-the-art models --- a transformer, a graph network paired with a variational autoencoder, and a single-layer convolutional network --- under both Gaussian and Laplacian losses demonstrates the phenomenon. On the five electricity price markets of a standard forecasting benchmark, Halo improves MSE and MAE in 28 of 30 model-market-metric comparisons, cutting average MSE by 2.6% to 16.5% and average MAE by 1.7% to 11.0%. Two findings emerge: (1) whether the scale estimate comes from a second projection head or from a full parallel network matters far less than whether the network estimates scale, and (2) the improvement holds under the hyperparameters already tuned for the point-estimate baseline, so retuning is optional.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Halo方法，通过让深度时间序列预测网络额外估计尺度（方差）参数并进行异方差（heteroscedastic）训练，不仅能实现不确定性量化，还能提升点估计的精度。该方法在三个SOTA模型（TimeXer、GCGNet、CrossLinear）和五个电力价格基准数据集上的28/30比较中改善了MSE和MAE。
AI.motivation: 传统上，异方差估计主要用于不确定性量化，但此前有研究（如Stirn et al., 2023）表明在某些神经网络任务中异方差估计反而会损害点估计精度。本文旨在探索在时间序列预测这一特定领域中，异方差估计是否能改善而非损害点估计精度。
AI.method: Halo是一种对现有深度预测器架构的修改方法：给网络增加一个输出维度用于估计隐含分布的尺度参数（如高斯分布的方差或拉普拉斯分布的尺度参数），并使用对应的负对数似然（NLL）作为损失函数进行训练。对于高斯分布，采用Seitzer et al. (2022)提出的β-NLL（含stop-gradient）以提高训练稳定性。架构上提供两种实现：(1) 并行双网络结构（简单模型适用）；(2) 共享特征的双投影头结构（复杂模型适用，更高效）。还解决了与Series Standardization非平稳性调整的兼容性问题（尺度估计需乘以输入标准差）。
AI.result: 在EPF基准的五个电力价格市场（NP、PJM、BE、FR、DE）上，对三种SOTA模型进行测试：TimeXer（Transformer）、GCGNet（GNN+VAE）、CrossLinear（单层CNN）。Halo在30次模型-市场-指标比较中28次改善了MSE和MAE，平均MSE降低2.6%~16.5%，平均MAE降低1.7%~11.0%。两个关键发现：(1) 尺度估计采用并行网络还是双投影头差异不大，关键是网络是否估计了尺度；(2) 使用为点估计基线调好的超参数即可获得提升，重新调参是可选的。
AI.conclusion: Halo是一种简单通用的架构无关修改，可显著提升深度时间序列预测的点估计精度。其结果与Stirn et al. (2023)在非时序任务中的负面结论形成对比，作者推测电力价格数据中存在的时变波动性为尺度估计提供了学习信号。未来工作包括在其他基准、预测跨度和多种子上的进一步验证，以及明确异方差估计何时改善/不改善点估计的条件。

title: Zero-shot rib design: merging training-free generative prior with topology optimization
summary: Natural load-bearing patterns such as leaf venation, trabecular bone, and spider webs achieve high stiffness per unit mass, yet classical topology optimizers rarely reach such geometries, and few let engineers express structural design intent through natural language. This work treats a frozen text-to-image diffusion model as a training-free source of design knowledge and distills it into the physics loop of density-based topology optimization via score distillation sampling, so that a text prompt becomes an explicit, machine-interpretable representation of engineer intent. The prompt-induced generative gradient and the finite element sensitivity are combined at every iteration, letting physics decide which prompt-induced features survive. In 245 primary SDS runs spanning four geometric domains and two physics regimes, 38 of 49 prompt--domain combinations achieved statistically significant compliance reductions (up to $-31.5\%$ mechanical and $-23.0\%$ thermoelastic), outperforming gradient-based baselines. Cross-domain morphological analysis identifies a recurring structural signature of improvement: in most domains the generative prior suppresses dead-end branches in the rib skeleton, with endpoint--compliance correlation $r = +0.56$ to $+0.99$. A Heaviside projection with $\beta$-continuation resolves a pronounced intermediate-density tendency in this diffusion--physics coupling ($42.6\%$ to $<3\%$), and an automated skeleton-based pipeline converts optimized density fields into \rev{candidate geometry ready for computer-aided design. By retargeting the generative prior across domains, loading conditions, and physics objectives through a change of text prompt, with each new problem's physics setup specified separately, the framework uses a pretrained generative model as a reusable, training-free prior for engineering design.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种零样本肋板设计框架，将冻结的文本到图像扩散模型（Stable Diffusion 2.1）作为训练免费的设计知识源，通过分数蒸馏采样（SDS）将其蒸馏到基于密度的拓扑优化（SIMP）的物理梯度中，使自然语言提示成为工程师设计意图的显式可机器解释表示。提示诱导的生成梯度与有限元灵敏度在每次迭代中结合，由物理决定哪些提示诱导特征得以保留。
AI.motivation: 经典SIMP拓扑优化因惩罚参数引入的高度非凸性，易陷入局部最优，难以到达叶脉、骨小梁、蜘蛛网等自然界高效承载几何形态。此外，传统参数化模板仅能表达设计师预枚举的有限设计空间，缺乏一种让工程师以自然语言表达结构设计意图、并使优化器可直接利用的机制。现有数据驱动生成式方法需大量领域特定训练数据且泛化性受限，CLIP等方法只能提供全局图像-文本相似性而无法生成像素级梯度。
AI.method: 1. **SDS-SIMP梯度耦合**：将密度场渲染为512×512灰度图像，经冻结的VAE编码到潜空间，通过U-Net噪声预测差计算SDS梯度，与FEA灵敏度梯度加权求和（λ_phys=1.0，λ_sds按域调整）。2. **四阶段调度**：预热（30次迭代仅用物理梯度）→余弦冷却（λ_sds在500次迭代内衰减至零）→扩散时间步退火（t从0.98到0.50，由粗到细）→EMA平滑（α=0.9）。3. **Heaviside投影与β-continuation**：β从1每50次迭代翻倍至64，将SDS引起的灰度密度比从42.6%降至<3%。4. **后处理流水线**：二值化→Zhang-Suen细化→距离变换→图提取→三次Bézier拟合→STEP格式CAD导出。5. **物理模型**：Mindlin-Reissner板理论+MITC4单元（板弯曲域）；平面应力四节点双线性单元（D_Link工业域）；SIMP插值p=3，r_min=5，r_max=10。
AI.result: 在245次SDS运行（4个几何域×2个物理机制）中，49个提示-域组合中38个实现统计显著的柔度降低（p=0.031二项检验，BH校正后q<0.05），最高机械-31.5%、热弹性-23.0%，中位Cohen's |d|=1.49。最佳SDS运行在D_Circle(2.522 vs MMA 2.598)和D_Hole(43.20 vs MMA 48.85)上优于MMA调优基线。跨域形态学分析显示，骨架端点数n_end与柔度呈正相关（Pearson r=+0.56至+0.99，中位+0.97），表明生成先验通过抑制非承载死端分支改善设计。热传导实验为负结果，划定了适用边界。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将SDS从视觉领域扩展到物理约束优化，证明了冻结文本到图像扩散模型可作为工程设计的可重用、训练免费先验。自然语言提示作为显式知识表示，通过FEA灵敏度在每次迭代中过滤其物理后果。"载荷路径对齐"假设解释了提示在不同域中的排名逆转。最佳SDS权重λ_sds需与物理梯度幅度成比例缩放。β-continuation解决了连续生成先验与离散/二值设计空间的通用协调问题。未来工作将扩展至3D多视图SDS、文本反演自动先验发现，以及流固耦合、超材料单胞设计等严重局部最优问题。

title: Byzantine-Robust Federated Fire Detection with a Rotating Coordinator
summary: We study the application of federated learning (FL) to indoor fire detection. Such fire-detection systems use edge cameras that record sensitive footage which cannot easily be collected at a central server. Existing federated solutions leave three practical obstacles unaddressed: limited uplink bandwidth, Byzantine (malicious or faulty) clients, and unconditional trust in a single, permanently fixed aggregation server. Our main contributions address all three. In particular, we provide (i) a curated indoor fire-detection dataset assembled from eight public sources; (ii) an edge-deployable detector whose model updates are compressed up to 10 time with only a small loss in balanced accuracy; and (iii) a semi-decentralized Byzantine-robust FL method that combines history-aware aggregation with a rotating coordinator, evicting stealthy attacks that per-round filters miss while removing the fixed-server single point of failure. On the held-out test set the rotating-coordinator method matches its fixed-server counterpart in accuracy and detection speed, and a physically distributed six-node cloud deployment confirms feasibility.

AI.tldr: 本文针对室内火灾检测场景,提出一种半去中心化的联邦学习框架,结合通信压缩、历史感知拜占庭鲁棒聚合(SafeguardSGD)与轮换协调器机制,同时解决上行带宽受限、恶意/故障客户端以及固定聚合服务器单点故障三大实际问题,并在六节点云部署中验证可行性。
AI.motivation: 室内火灾蔓延迅速,但传统烟雾/热度传感器响应滞后且易误报;边缘摄像头结合CNN可实现早期视觉检测。然而,摄像头分布在不同机构下,涉及隐私敏感数据,难以集中收集训练。联邦学习虽适合此场景,但仍面临三方面挑战:(1)上行带宽受限;(2)拜占庭(恶意或故障)客户端可投毒;(3)固定聚合服务器构成单点故障,在安全关键应用中尤为不可接受。现有工作(如IOFireNet、FireFedXNet、FedMA)未同时解决这三个问题。
AI.method: 三项核心贡献:(C1)整合8个公开来源构建18,790张室内火灾二分类数据集,并提供IID与non-IID分区;(C2)以冻结的ImageNet预训练MobileNet-V2为骨干,仅训练轻量级1280→256→2头部,采用INT8/INT4均匀量化和带误差反馈的Top-K稀疏化实现最高10×上行压缩;(C3)将历史感知聚合规则SafeguardSGD(维护每客户端短/长窗口累积量,基于偏离诚实簇几何中位数方向进行阈值检测)与轮换协调器架构结合,每轮通过资格筛选(属于保留集G_t、可用性≥0.8、近期连续参与)后按分区标识符轮询选举下一协调器,并在交接时序列化全局权重、每客户端累积量A_i/B_i、保留集和参与历史,使检测状态在角色转移中得以保留。在Flower框架下通过AWS EC2六节点(1 SuperLink + 5 SuperNode)gRPC通信进行物理分布式部署验证。
AI.result: 诚实客户端下FedAvg在测试集上达到BA 0.9835(IID)/0.9818(non-IID),高于集中基线0.9615;通信压缩方面,INT8(4×)仅损失0.0016 BA,INT4(8×)与Top-K k=0.05(10×)分别损失0.5和0.8 BA点;拜占庭鲁棒性方面,面对sign-flip、缩放、噪声等显式攻击三种防御均有效,但Krum在stealth-flip中间区(α≈0.4–0.5)恶意梯度仍被选中约35%轮次,CClip在α≥0.5时完全失效,而SafeguardSGD对IPM在第6.3±0.5轮驱逐、对α≥0.3的stealth-flip实现驱逐(驱逐轮次随α增大从28降至10);轮换架构与固定服务器架构在无攻击BA上差距<0.001(0.9565 vs 0.9575),驱逐轮次一致,且无攻击场景下协调器角色在5节点间均匀分布(各20轮)。Grad-CAM与遮挡敏感性分析证实模型关注局部高强度火焰区域而非背景伪相关。
AI.conclusion: 该系统同时解决了室内火灾联邦检测的通信成本、拜占庭鲁棒性和固定服务器单点故障三大问题;历史感知SafeguardSGD能检测并永久驱逐每轮几何滤波器无法识别的隐蔽低幅度攻击,轮换协调器架构在均匀分配聚合角色的同时保持该能力;在18,790图像数据集和分布式AWS EC2部署上匹配集中基线BA、上行压缩达10×、且无需固定可信服务器即可容忍单个拜占庭客户端。局限在于实证仅基于5客户端和单个静态非合谋对手,未来工作将拓展至自适应、多客户端合谋威胁模型、可验证聚合及更大规模部署。

title: Artificial Intelligence Algorithms for the Detection of Pathologies Related to Lung Cancer through Image Analysis using Convolutional Neural Networks and Data Augmentation: a systematic mapping of the literature
summary: Lung cancer is one of the leading causes of death worldwide, and its early diagnosis is crucial to improving patients prognosis and quality of life. However, the process of interpreting medical images for the detection of lung cancer is complex and requires trained experts. In this context, artificial intelligence (AI) and deep learning (DL) emerge as potential tools to automate and optimize image analysis. The objective of this work is to review the most recent and relevant applications of AI and DL in the field of radiology for the detection of lung cancer. To this end, an exhaustive search was carried out in scientific databases such as PubMed,IEEEXPLORE, Scopus and Web of Science, and 96 articles published from 2015 to the present addressing the use of AI and DL in biomedical engineering were selected. Emphasis is placed on the use of convolutional neural networks (CNN) with transfer learning and Data Augmentation as promising techniques to improve the accuracy and efficiency of the image interpretation process. The results show that the use of AI and DL can offer an effective alternative for the early diagnosis of lung cancer, with high sensitivity and specificity. However, current limitations and challenges that must be addressed to guarantee its responsible and safe application in clinical practice are also identified, such as the lack of standardized data, the ex plainability of the models, patient privacy, and the ethical and social implications. It is concluded that the use of AI and DL can have a positive impact on the care of patients with lung cancer, but further research and regulation are required to ensure its quality and reliability.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于肺癌检测中AI与深度学习应用的系统性文献综述研究，系统梳理了2015年以来使用CNN和Data Augmentation进行肺癌影像分析的研究，探讨了模型选择、数据增强策略及临床应用的局限性。
AI.motivation: 肺癌是全球主要死因之一，早期诊断对改善患者预后至关重要。然而医学影像解读过程复杂且依赖专业专家，AI和深度学习（特别是CNN与数据增强）有望实现影像分析的自动化和优化，从而提高诊断的准确性、效率及可及性。
AI.method: 遵循Petersen等（2008）的系统映射协议和Kitchenham & Charters（2007）的系统综述方法。在PubMed、IEEE Xplore、Scopus和Web of Science四个数据库中检索2015年至今的相关文献，使用关键词组合（AI、DL、CNN、Data Augmentation、肺癌、诊断、影像分析）。初始获得167篇，经标题/摘要筛选剩59篇，再经引言/结论筛选剩35篇。围绕三个研究问题（CNN模型选择、数据增强优势、临床应用挑战）进行数据提取、分类与综合。
AI.result: 1）CNN模型方面：预训练模型（如VGG16、ResNet）结合迁移学习在肺癌CT影像分析中表现优异；2）数据增强方面：通过旋转、缩放、噪声等变换增加训练数据量和多样性，可有效降低过拟合风险，提升模型鲁棒性；3）临床应用方面：AI/DL能以高敏感性和特异性辅助早期诊断，但仍面临数据标准化不足、模型可解释性差、患者隐私以及伦理社会问题等挑战；4）未来方向：可探索监督学习方法（如SVM）和无监督深度学习方法（如自编码器）在病理发现中的应用。
AI.conclusion: AI与深度学习算法在肺癌病理影像检测中展现出巨大潜力，能为早期诊断提供有效替代方案，对肺癌患者诊疗可产生积极影响。然而，要确保其在临床实践中的可靠、安全应用，仍需进一步研究解决数据标准化、模型可解释性、隐私保护和伦理规范等关键问题，并通过更严格的监管来保证其质量与可信度。该综述为后续博士论文工作奠定了基础。

title: GEOSTEER: Geodesic Optimization for Activation Steering in Large Language Models
summary: Activation steering provides a lightweight way to control large language models (LLMs) by modifying their hidden activations at inference time. Among these approaches, norm-preserving steering aims to change model behavior without altering the activation norm, reducing the risk of representation collapse and degradation. However, existing norm-preserving methods are limited by predefined steering trajectories and by their reliance on one-step updates, which may fail to capture the complex structure of activation distributions. We propose GeoSteer, an optimization-based method for norm-preserving activation steering. GeoSteer formulates steering as a Riemannian optimization problem and updates activations through a sequence of small geodesic steps on the representation manifold. To avoid fixed steering directions, GeoSteer learns a nonlinear activation-space objective that distinguishes desired from undesired activations, and uses this function to adaptively guide each steering step. This multistep formulation yields smoother, more stable, and more consistent steering behavior while preserving the activation norm. Across TruthfulQA, RealToxicityPrompts, and UltraFeedback benchmarks, GeoSteer consistently improves over state-of-the-art activation steering baselines. These results suggest that norm-preserving steering can be made more effective by replacing predefined one-step edits with adaptive, geometry-aware optimization.

AI.tldr: GeoSteer提出了一种基于黎曼优化的范式保留型激活引导方法，通过在单位超球面上进行多步测地线更新来自适应地引导大语言模型的隐层激活方向，结合非线性探针目标函数，在TruthfulQA、RealToxicityPrompts和UltraFeedback三个基准上以极低的推理开销一致优于现有最佳激活引导方法。
AI.motivation: 现有范式保留型激活引导方法（如Angular Steering、Spherical Steering、HPR）依赖预定义的引导轨迹和单步更新，无法捕捉激活分布的复杂结构，限制了表达能力。同时，加性引导可能破坏激活范数，导致表征退化。
AI.method: 将激活引导建模为单位超球面上的黎曼优化问题。训练阶段，利用Polynomial Count Sketch构建非线性特征，训练二分类探针区分期望与非期望激活；推理阶段，通过切空间投影计算黎曼梯度，沿测地线进行K步小步迭代更新（步长η=T/K），每步根据当前激活状态自适应重新计算引导方向，最终恢复原始范数得到编辑后的激活。
AI.result: 在Falcon-7B、Mistral-7B、LLaMA3.1-8B和Qwen2.5-7B四个模型上，GeoSteer在帮助性胜率、TruthfulQA真×信息得分和RealToxicityPrompts毒性降低三个主要指标上均达到最优；消融实验验证了测地线步数、总引导强度T=0.64以及非线性目标函数（PCS优于RFF和线性目标）的有效性；推理开销仅约0.9%，吞吐量几乎无损。
AI.conclusion: 用自适应、多步、几何感知的黎曼优化取代预定义的范式保留型单步编辑，能够实现更平滑、更稳定、更一致的激活引导，同时几乎不增加推理成本，验证了几何感知优化对范式保留型激活引导的有效性。

title: Conformal Calibration Transfer
comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
summary: Conformal prediction converts point predictions into set-valued predictions with coverage guarantees under exchangeability between calibration and deployment data. We study conformal calibration transfer, where this requirement fails because labeled calibration is available only in a source space, while prediction sets are needed in a target space linked to the source through unlabeled paired observations (e.g., paired modalities or sensor changes). We propose Transported Conformal Calibration (TCC): we transport labeled source calibration into the target space using the paired data, and then correct residual post-transport mismatch using only unlabeled target inputs. We instantiate this correction with two complementary methods: TCC-KS, which uses a label-free uncertainty surrogate to detect mismatch and adjust calibration conservatively, and weighted-TCC, which reweights transported calibration toward the target domain for improved efficiency when weights are stable. We provide finite-sample target-domain coverage guarantees that adapt to an observable measure of mismatch. Across CIFAR-100-C, Tiny-ImageNet-C, and SEN12MS, we show reliable target-domain coverage transfer without labeled target calibration data, with label-free diagnostics that predict when correction is needed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Transported Conformal Calibration (TCC)，用于解决在跨空间（源空间与目标空间）场景下的共形预测校准迁移问题。当目标空间缺乏标注校准数据但有无标注配对观测时，TCC通过学习传输映射将源域标注校准数据迁移到目标域，并引入两种无标签校正机制：TCC-KS（基于无标签不确定性代理的单侧KS差异来收紧校准水平）和weighted-TCC（传输后重要性加权）。论文提供了有限样本覆盖率保证和不可能下界，在CIFAR-100-C、Tiny-ImageNet-C和SEN12MS数据集上验证了方法有效性。
AI.motivation: 标准分裂共形预测要求校准数据与测试数据可交换，但在实际部署中常出现标注校准数据仅存在于源空间、而预测需求在另一目标空间的跨空间偏移场景（如传感器升级、模态变化），且目标域标注成本高昂。现有方法要么要求同空间协变量偏移，要么不能提供无标签下的有效校准。
AI.method: 1. 学习传输映射 f: X_s→X_t，利用无标注配对数据将源域输入映射到目标域。2. 在传输后的标注样本上计算非一致性分数并形成初始分位数。3. TCC-KS：在无标签不确定性代理 T(x)=1−max_y p̂(y|x) 上估计单侧KS差异 δ⁺，调整校准水平为 α⋆=max(0,α−δ⁺)。4. weighted-TCC：在传输后估计密度比权重，对传输分数进行重要性加权重校准。5. 可选KL预测对齐正则项：L_KL= KL(p̂_t(·|f(x_s))‖p̂_t(·|x_t)) 改善传输质量。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-100-C、Tiny-ImageNet-C和SAR→RGB（SEN12MS）上的实验表明：(1) TCC-KS在11个欠覆盖配置中100%恢复有效覆盖率，平均集大小膨胀1.82倍；(2) δ⁺与集大小膨胀和安全裕度的相关性分别为0.772和0.734；(3) weighted-TCC在ESS%>70%时高效，接近Oracle CP效率；(4) +KL预测对齐可降低δ⁺并稳定权重，例如Tiny-ImageNet-C上δ⁺从0.1006降至0.0148，ESS%从48.4升至91.8；(5) 在SUN RGB-D上同样验证了方法有效性。
AI.conclusion: TCC通过传输映射和无标签校正机制，实现了在无目标域标注校准数据下的共形校准迁移。TCC-KS作为保守安全栏在欠覆盖时恢复有效性，weighted-TCC在权重稳定时提供高效集。两种机制均配备可部署的无标签诊断信号（δ⁺和ESS%），为实际部署中的方法选择提供操作指导。理论上证明了无标签场景下非平凡覆盖率保证需要额外结构假设（A2），但通过使该假设显式化并提供诊断，TCC在实际场景中表现出可靠性能。

title: A Bellman Optimality Equation for Plasticity
summary: In continual reinforcement learning, carefully managing the stability-plasticity tradeoff remains a core challenge. Recent work by Abel et al. (2025) formalized this dilemma by defining plasticity as the generalized directed information from an agent's observations to its actions, and empowerment as the generalized directed information from its actions to its observations. This formulation successfully reframes the traditional stability-plasticity tradeoff as an empowerment-plasticity tradeoff. However, while extensive literature exists on optimizing for empowerment, there is currently no research addressing the optimization of plasticity under this new definition. This paper presents preliminary work toward optimizing plasticity within Markov decision processes. We show that there exists a Bellman optimality equation for optimizing plasticity similar to previous work for empowerment.

AI.tldr: 本文针对Abel等人(2025)提出的可塑性(plasticity)的信息论定义,首次推导出MDP中用于优化可塑性的Bellman最优性方程,并通过三个实验环境验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 在持续强化学习中,稳定性-可塑性权衡(stability-plasticity tradeoff)是一个核心挑战。Abel等人(2025)将可塑性重新定义为从观测到动作的广义定向信息(generalized directed information),并提出需同时维持empowerment和可塑性高于临界阈值。然而,尽管empowerment的优化已有广泛研究(如Leibfried等人2019年的Bellman方法),但针对这一定义下可塑性的直接优化尚属空白。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 1. 基于Leibfried等人(2019)的empowerment Bellman最优性方程框架,推导可塑性对应的Bellman最优性方程。关键区别在于:empowerment使用I(A_t; S_{t+1}|S_t)作为即时奖励,可塑性使用I(S_{t+1}; A_{t+1}|S_t, A_t)作为即时奖励,价值函数建立在状态-动作对(s_{t-1}, a_{t-1})上而非仅状态s。2. 证明Bellman算子是γ-压缩映射,保证唯一不动点存在。3. 证明目标函数关于策略π是凸的,因此最优策略可限制为确定性策略(Bauer极值原理)。4. 提出基于多权重背包动态规划(Multi-Weight Knapsack DP)的表格值迭代算法,以处理策略在不同下一状态间的耦合优化问题。5. 设计Control-Gated MDP基准环境分析可塑性-empowerment景观,并在Road Environment和Two-Room Environment上扩展验证。
AI.result: 1. 成功推导出可塑性的Bellman最优性方程,并证明了压缩性和最优策略可确定性。2. Control-Gated MDP上,值迭代单调非递减收敛,最终达到约0.92 bits的可塑性(empowerment为0),验证了可塑性与empowerment之间的权衡。3. Road Environment实验展示了不同历史上下文下的可塑性价值差异,边界状态(试图离开道路)价值最低。4. Two-Room Environment(5×7网格,35状态,两个房间:一个完全噪声,一个完全确定性)中,智能体学习选择进入噪声房间以最大化可塑性价值。5. 发现Bellman最优性方程与定向信息定义之间存在差异:多个相同价值的策略可能具有不同的总可塑性。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了首个针对Abel等人(2025)信息论定义下可塑性优化的Bellman最优性方程,填补了该领域的空白。理论上证明了Bellman算子的压缩性和最优策略的确定性,并通过多权重背包DP实现了表格求解。实验验证了该方法在三个递增复杂度的环境中能有效优化可塑性。未来工作包括:开发基于深度神经网络的在线采样算法以扩展到高维连续环境,以及将可塑性优化与empowerment和外部奖励相结合,以实现在持续学习中动态平衡三者。

title: From Connectivity to Rewards: Dense Reward Learning with Directed State Graphs
summary: The integration of graphs with Goal-Conditioned Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning (GCHRL) has received increasing attention, as graphs naturally encode task hierarchies for effective subgoal sampling. However, existing methods often overlook intrinsic connectivity information, failing to fully leverage the underlying topology for efficient learning. Most graph-based GCHRL methods use the graph as a stochastic sampling tool rather than as an environmental model that encodes connectivity and state-accessibility information. This limitation is particularly acute in quasimetric environments, where the inherent asymmetry of state transitions poses a fundamental challenge to stable policy learning and robust path planning. In this paper, we address these problems by introducing a state connectivity model designed to predict pairwise state connectivity strength in asymmetric environments. We transform these connectivity strengths into scalar auxiliary dense rewards, providing continuous guidance across multiple hierarchical levels. We demonstrate that our proposed framework, Graph-Guided Quasimetric Dense Reward (G2QDR), can theoretically be integrated into any existing GCHRL architecture, and the state connectivity model is efficiently implemented via a neural network trained on a directed state graph generated during exploration. Empirical results across a wide range of sparse reward environments indicate that, in general, G2QDR can enhance the performance of baseline GCHRL approaches with acceptable computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出G2QDR框架，通过在线构建有向状态图并学习状态连通性模型，将状态间的连通强度转化为辅助密集奖励，用于解决稀疏奖励下GCHRL方法在非对称（quasimetric）环境中难以有效利用拓扑结构的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于图的GCHRL方法多将图用作随机子目标采样工具，未能充分利用其内在连通性信息；在状态转移具有非对称性的quasimetric环境中，这一缺陷尤为突出，导致策略学习不稳定和路径规划困难。
AI.method: 1）在探索过程中在线增量构建固定节点数的有向状态图，边权通过多项式衰减进行初始化与累积更新；2）使用前馈神经网络（FFN）作为状态连通性模型，以有序状态对表示（如拼接/门控融合）为输入，预测任意状态对的连通分数；3）将连通分数转化为高层约束奖励、低层修正奖励以及非对称惩罚项，通过阶段依赖的λ控制器（预热→激活→全奖励→退火→最终）在训练过程中动态调节辅助奖励强度。
AI.result: 在AntMaze、AntGather、AntPush、AntFall和Pusher五个MuJoCo稀疏奖励环境中，将G2QDR集成到HIRO、HRAC、HESS、HLPS四种基线GCHRL算法上，总体上提高了成功率和稳定性，且在非对称环境中相对无向图方法G4RL的提升更明显；额外分析表明模型的非对称性区分能力和单调性保持率随训练逐步提升，且采样频率是影响效率的关键因素。
AI.conclusion: G2QDR是一个可即插即用于现有GCHRL架构的通用框架，通过有向图建模状态连通性并转化为分层密集奖励，有效改善了稀疏奖励与非对称环境下的学习效率与稳定性；但其性能对多个超参数敏感，图结构受行为策略影响存在探索偏差，且辅助奖励非势函数，可能改变最优策略。

title: RiVaT-Fuse: Reliability-Calibrated Variational Tensor Fusion for Multimodal Prediction under Modality Uncertainty
summary: Image-metadata prediction requires fusing heterogeneous evidence whose reliability can vary across samples and latent factors. Existing representation-level fusion methods typically choose an aggregation architecture, such as concatenation, gating, conditional modulation, or attention, without explicitly defining what the fused representation should mean under modality uncertainty. We propose RiVaT-Fuse, a reliability-calibrated variational tensor fusion framework that defines fusion as sample-wise latent-state estimation. Rather than producing a fused vector by direct aggregation, RiVaT-Fuse estimates a consensus latent state through a variational objective that balances image evidence, metadata evidence, structured cross-modal interaction, and stability. The resulting framework replaces scalar modality confidence with matrix-valued trust geometry, decomposes interaction into additive, multiplicative, and relational components, and couples the latent state with conditional robustness and structured multi-task prediction. We provide well-posedness and stability interpretations of the latent solve and instantiate the framework with efficient low-rank-plus-diagonal trust operators. On an image-level image-metadata prediction benchmark, RiVaT-Fuse achieves the strongest overall predictive rank among direct representation-level baselines while improving probability and label stability under perturbation.

AI.tldr: RiVaT-Fus提出了一种基于变分潜状态估计的多模态融合框架，将图像-元数据融合重新定义为样本级可靠性校准的潜状态求解问题，通过矩阵值信任算子、结构化张量交互、条件分布鲁棒学习和多任务耦合实现优于现有表示级融合基线的方法。
AI.motivation: 现有表示级多模态融合方法（拼接、门控、条件调制、注意力）虽然架构丰富，但对融合表征在模态不确定性下的语义定义不足，缺乏对样本级、方向级可靠性的显式建模。论文旨在解决"每个样本应如何信任各模态"这一核心问题。
AI.method: 1）变分潜融合：将融合定义为强凸二次目标的唯一极小值 h*(x)=H(x)^{-1}b(x)，其中 H(x) 为可靠性几何矩阵，b(x) 聚合模态证据与交互；2）矩阵值信任算子：采用低秩加对角形式（Diag+U·Diag·U^T+εI），捕捉方向级各向异性信任；3）结构化张量交互：分解为加性修正（A_I、A_M）、低秩乘法结合（∑α_k R_k(U_k z_I⊙V_k z_M)）、元数据条件化的关系注意力 W_R∑π_ℓ Z_{I,ℓ}；4）条件 DRO：依据可靠性状态 s=[q,u,r] 自适应调整模糊半径 ρ(s)；5）图拉普拉斯任务正则化 + 二次决策头；6）理论保证：H(x)⪰μI 保证适定性与扰动稳定性。
AI.result: 在视网膜图像级多模态基准（3603/772/773 图像-元数据样本，1个序数+2个二分类任务）上，RiVaT-Fuse 平均排名 1.35（最优），在序数任务准确率（0.864）、QWK（0.843）、两个二分类 AUC（0.950/0.971）上均达到最佳，同时在扰动下表现出最低的平均标签翻转率（0.044）、最小的二分类概率漂移（0.025/0.042）以及最低的二元-2 Brier 分数（0.060）。
AI.conclusion: RiVaT-Fuse 将多模态融合从启发式特征聚合提升为可靠性校准的潜状态估计原则，统一了矩阵值信任、结构化交互、条件鲁棒性与任务耦合，在表示级融合基线中实现了最优的整体预测性能与最佳的概率/标签扰动稳定性平衡，但作者明确指出缺乏组件级消融实验，理论保证为充分条件结果。

title: Processing and classifying bird songs using wavelet techniques and supervised learning
summary: This study proposes an integrated framework for the processing and classification of invasive bird species vocalizations within natural soundscapes, characterized by high levels of environmental noise. We address the challenge of signal degradation by employing a Bayesian wavelet shrinkage methodology based on the Epanechnikov kernel prior, which offers a closed form decision rule and high computational efficiency for processing large bioacoustic datasets. The methodology was applied to recordings of three species obtained from the iNaturalist platform: \textit{Euphonia violacea}, \textit{Leiothrix lutea}, and \textit{Passer domesticus}. After signal denoising, we extracted a comprehensive set of features, including Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCCs) and spectral indices such as entropy and zero-crossing rate. Several supervised learning models: Random Forest, Multinomial Logistic Regression and Support Vector Machine (SVM) were evaluated across different feature dimensionalities. Our results demonstrate that the proposed wavelet based preprocessing significantly enhances classification performance, with the SVM model achieving the highest accuracy (up to 0.9398) under a 10-dimensional MFCC configuration. This research provides a robust statistical tool for automated ecological monitoring and the management of biological invasions.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于Epanechnikov核先验的贝叶斯小波收缩去噪框架，结合MFCC等声学特征与监督学习模型（RF、LR、SVM等），用于自然声景中三种入侵鸟类鸣声的自动分类。在iNaturalist数据上，SVM在10维MFCC配置下达到最高准确率0.9398。
AI.motivation: 自然环境中的鸟声录音常受高环境噪声干扰，信号退化严重；同时入侵鸟种的生态监测需求日益增长，亟需一种对噪声鲁棒且计算高效的自动化声学分类工具，以辅助生物入侵管理与生物多样性保护。
AI.method: （1）预处理：从iNaturalist下载三种鸟类（Euphonia violacea、Leiothrix lutea、Passer domesticus）的鸣声录音，统一为16 kHz，剔除静音段，截断至2的幂次长度。（2）去噪：采用基于Epanechnikov核先验的贝叶斯小波收缩方法（spike-and-slab混合先验+指数先验方差），通过闭式后验均值进行系数估计；超参数α按分辨率层级自适应，β取各层系数最大绝对值，λ由最细层标准差自适应确定。（3）特征提取：DaubExPhase滤波器（10号）离散小波分解提取能量与标准差特征，并计算MFCC及其min/max/mean/median/sd/skewness/kurtosis等汇总统计，以及谱心、谱熵、过零率、RMS、Q25、Q75等声学指标。（4）分类：比较Random Forest、Relevance Vector Machine、KNN、Multinomial Logistic Regression与SVM（RBF核），80/20分层划分，10折或5折交叉验证调参，以准确率、平衡准确率、Kappa、敏感性、特异性及McNemar检验评估。
AI.result: 两组二分类任务中，SVM均表现最优：Data 1（Passer domesticus vs Leiothrix lutea）在m=10时准确率0.8501、Kappa 0.6924；Data 2（Euphonia violacea vs Leiothrix lutea）在m=10时准确率0.9398、Kappa 0.8119，平衡准确率0.8911。多项式逻辑回归紧随其后。RVM因严重偏向多数类而失效（特异度仅约0.10）。PCA显示m=4与m=10均能有效区分物种。变量重要性分析表明：Data 1中低阶MFCC（尤其MFCC_min2、MFCC_mean1/2、MFCC_med1/2）为主导判别特征；Data 2中谱熵、过零率与谱心等全局描述符与MFCC共同贡献，区分难度更大。此外，研究还针对Leiothrix lutea和Passer domesticus完成了风险评估，两者均被评为"极高入侵风险"，建议拒绝引入。
AI.conclusion: 贝叶斯Epanechnikov小波收缩去噪在低信噪比条件下表现出高效且稳健的信号恢复能力；结合MFCC等特征与SVM分类器，可实现对入侵鸟类鸣声的高精度自动识别（最高0.9398），为生态监测与入侵管理提供了有效的统计工具。未来可扩展至超多样性声景，并探索与深度学习架构的融合以实现稀有或拟声鸣声的实时检测。

title: Flow Duality and Source Geometry for Categorical Generation
summary: Continuous and discrete flow matching are usually treated as separate constructions. This paper identifies a duality between them: projecting continuous convex-interpolant paths with one-hot targets through a position-wise argmax yields discrete convex-interpolant paths. The result requires source laws with appropriate coordinate symmetry and boundary regularity, and it makes the continuous source distribution an explicit design choice for categorical generation. We derive the induced discrete interpolation behavior for Gaussian, bounded-uniform, and centered negative-exponential sources, showing that different source geometries lead to qualitatively different transition timing and vocabulary-size dependence. Small visual diagnostics and a short language-modeling pilot suggest that these source-design effects can also appear in learned transports and early generative quality.

AI.tldr: 本文识别了连续流匹配与离散流匹配之间的对偶关系：通过位置级 argmax 将具有凸插值路径和一热目标编码的连续流投影，可得到离散凸插值路径。该结果使连续源分布成为离散（分类）生成的一个显式设计选择，并针对高斯、有界均匀、中心化负指数三种源族推导了诱导的离散插值系数。
AI.motivation: 连续流匹配与离散流匹配通常被视为独立的构造框架，缺乏统一的理论联系。Sahoo 等人（2025）已证明离散扩散可视为连续扩散的 argmax 投影，本文将这一对偶性推广到凸插值流匹配场景，并指出源分布选择并非中性的实现细节，而是会显著影响离散生成行为（特别是过渡时序与词表规模依赖性）。
AI.method: 核心方法是一种 argmax 兼容的提升耦合构造：先从坐标置换不变连续源采样 Z₀，取 X₀ = argmax(Z₀)，然后通过与 Z₀ 条件独立的离散核 π(·|X₀) 采样 X₁，设置 Z₁ = onehot(X₁)，最后构造凸插值 Z_t = (1-k̃_t)Z₀ + k̃_t Z₁。通过位置级 argmax 投影 Z_t 得到离散过程 X_t = argmax(Z_t)。关键数学工具包括：(1) 证明 argmax 是可测映射；(2) 证明坐标置换不变且几乎无平局条件的连续源投影后产生均匀离散源；(3) 利用 Z₀ ⊥ X₁ | X₀ 的条件独立性建立跨位置分解；(4) 推导三种源族下诱导离散插值系数的闭式/积分表达式。
AI.result: 主要理论结果：(1) 在技术条件（坐标置换不变、无平局、对偶间隙非原子性、argmax 兼容提升耦合）下，连续凸插值流的位置级 argmax 投影导出具有凸插值条件分布的离散流；(2) 若各位置源律相同，标量系数 k_t 在所有位置共享；(3) 三种源族的诱导系数为——高斯源：k_t^Gauss = V∫φ(m)Φ(m)^{V-2}(Φ(m)−Φ(m−c_t))dm，随词表 V 增大而延迟；有界均匀源：k_t^Unif = (Vr_t − r_t^V)/(V−1)，其中 r_t = clip(c_t/ε, 0, 1)；中心化负指数源：k_t^NegExp = 1−exp(−βc_t)，与词表大小无关。实验上，一个 10k 步 OpenWebText 试点训练中，中心化负指数源相比高斯源使估计 KL 降低 0.380 nats（相对 19.9%）。
