AI.result: 实验在NanoGPT-Small/Medium/Wide（491M-1.63B参数）上使用FineWeb、OpenWebText、C4三个数据集，对比Muon、MUonClip、SPECTRA。主要结果：1) 学习率稳定性：Soft Musec在η=0.01到0.8范围内保持稳定，而Muon在大学习率下发散，MuonClip在部分配置下发散。2) 训练动力学：Soft Musec和SPECTRA从损失尖峰中快速恢复，Muon恢复缓慢且收敛到更高损失。3) 权重范数分析：Muon的QK/VO/MLP谱范数达到300-400，Soft Musec和SPECTRA保持低于10。4) 计算开销：Soft Musec相对Muon增加的计算开销可忽略（≤3%）。5) Soft Musec的更新矩阵有效秩低于SPECTRA，因其动量反馈机制持续调节谱分量。
AI.conclusion: Musec通过谱裁剪替代谱平坦化，从优化器层面（架构无关）解决了Muon的训练不稳定性问题。Soft Musec在多个数据集和模型规模上稳定优于现有Muon变体，并首次为Muon类算法在非凸非光滑设定下提供了收敛性保证，复杂度与最优一阶方法匹配。该方法为大规模语言模型训练中的矩阵优化器提供了一个理论严谨且实用的稳定化方案。

title: Learnware and AI Model Management System
summary: The transition from file storage to database management systems transformed stored data into managed resources. AI now faces an analogous transition from AI model storage to AI model management. Existing model pools essentially serve as \textit{AI model storage systems}. What is needed instead are \textit{AI model management systems} that enable models trained by different developers, for different tasks, with different data, and under different objectives to be identified, reused, and even assembled to address future user tasks. Because AI model developers are generally unwilling to share their training data, such systems should operate without accessing the training data of model developers and, ideally, without accessing raw data of future users. This requirement poses a fundamental challenge: the functionality of a modern AI model may not be fully understood even by the developer who trained it. How, then, can a system identify which models are useful for a given user task, let alone assemble models developed independently for different purposes? At first glance, this objective may appear unattainable. It becomes possible, however, by upgrading the basic unit of management from a machine learning model to a \textit{learnware}. \textit{Learnware = Model + Specification}. The specification, whose assignment transforms a trained model into a learnware, is generated with the help of a machine learning process without disclosing the training data of the developer and has a theoretically established data-preservation property. The \textit{Learnware Dock System (LDS)} provides a path toward powerful AI model management systems. Because specifications are generated according to a published reference and are comparable across models, they can also serve as an AI model \textit{collaboration protocol} through which independently developed models, including intelligent agents, can collaborate.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"learnware"（Learnware = Model + Specification）概念及Learnware Dock System（LDS），主张将AI模型管理从"模型存储"升级为"模型管理系统"，通过机器学习过程自动生成的规格（specification）实现模型的识别、重用与组装，且全程无需访问开发者训练数据或用户原始数据。
AI.motivation: 当前AI模型共享方式类似于数据库出现前的文件存储——开发者上传模型文件并附自然语言描述，但现代模型的复杂性使开发者本人也难以充分描述其能力，用户也无法精确表达任务需求；因此需要一种类比于DBMS的"AI模型管理系统"来管理大规模异构模型，同时保护开发者和用户的数据隐私。
AI.method: 核心方法是为每个模型附加由机器学习过程自动生成的"规格（specification）"，包括语义组件（任务类别、接口、标签含义等）和统计组件（模型能力分布的统计学刻画）。提出了RKME规格（基于核均值嵌入的显式函数）、PAVE规格（基于参考模型参数更新的隐式函数）和构造性规格（用于智能体服务的预算化profiling）三种生成方案。LDS由checker、organizer、searcher、reuser四个模块组成，支持异构特征/标签空间的模型识别、组装、锚点检索、冗余过滤等机制，并通过理论证明了规格的data-preservation与差分隐私性质。
AI.result: 原型系统Beimingwu已开源并容纳约1200个learnware。表格数据实验显示规格匹配能有效追踪最佳单模型、异构空间下80%案例超过本地训练、无关任务的模型也能被重新利用；LLM实验中8B规模101个专门化模型组成的LDS在金融和医疗上超过70B以上的大模型；136个智能体实验中查询级识别准确率达86.59%（系统内）和90.83%（系统外），分别超过GPT-4.1达2.8和4.5个百分点，并随智能体数量增加而提升。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明learnware范式可行：规格作为机器可处理的模型接口，使独立开发的模型能在不共享数据或内部参数的情况下被比较与组合，类比SQL之于数据库、TCP/IP之于网络，为AI模型协作协议奠定了基础。但效率、可扩展性、溯源与问责机制等仍有较大改进空间。

title: Why Does Post-Training Quantization Work?
summary: Post-training quantization compresses large language models (LLMs) by storing their weights at reduced precision, and each quantized weight introduces an error into the hidden states. Naively, these errors should accumulate with depth and corrupt next-token prediction; randomly initialized models accumulate these discrepancies rapidly, whereas quantized pretrained models accumulate much less hidden-state error and largely maintain downstream task performance, even though they were never trained with quantization noise. This raises the question we address: why does post-training quantization work? Comparing full-precision and quantized forward passes, we identify two mechanisms that characterize pretrained quantization robustness. First, the error a layer newly introduces tends to oppose the error it inherits from the layer's input. The two cancel partially such that the discrepancy between full-precision and quantized passes grows slowly. This counteracting residual interaction develops during pretraining. Our quantitative analysis identifies it as a major factor slowing hidden-error growth. Second, LM-head geometry preferentially preserves the scores and probabilities of high-ranked tokens, which typically represent the model's most confident predictions. Together, these mechanisms explain why quantization error that passes through numerous layers can still produce only small output changes, and we verify the findings across models and quantization settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了后训练量化（PTQ）在大语言模型中为何有效的原因，通过对比全精度与量化前向传播，识别出两个关键机制：1）预训练模型中每层新引入的误差倾向于抵消其从输入继承的误差，从而减缓隐藏状态误差的累积；2）LM头的几何结构优先保留高排名的token分数和概率，从而保持模型的输出稳定性。
AI.motivation: 后训练量化（PTQ）将LLM的权重量化至低精度，但每个量化权重会引入误差到隐藏状态中。直观上这些误差应随深度累积并破坏下一token预测，但实践中量化预训练模型仍能保持性能。本文旨在探究为何后训练量化有效——即为什么量化误差经过多层传播后仍只产生较小的输出变化。
AI.method: 1）对比全精度（BF16）与量化（NVFP4 W4）模型的前向传播，逐层追踪隐藏状态误差的增长；2）推导隐藏状态误差范数平方的精确递推关系，将其分解为三项：相对附加误差T_add、误差交互T_inter（抵消作用）和残差范数贡献T_align；3）通过干预实验（去除或反转抵消作用）验证其因果效应；4）对最终隐藏状态误差进行长度-角度分解，分析LM头几何结构对输出分数和概率的影响；5）推导高维旋转下投影角变化和分数变化的理论估计（定理2和定理3）。
AI.result: 1）预训练模型与随机初始化模型的权重重建误差几乎相同（余弦相似度约0.9955），但预训练模型的隐藏状态误差增长显著更慢（Qwen3-32B最终相对误差约为随机初始化的1/6.7）；2）量化引入的块更新误差Δu^(ℓ)倾向于与块输入隐藏误差Δh^(ℓ-1)方向相反（82.5%的块中余弦为负），通过T_inter项累积抵消了T_add贡献的50.2%-63.4%；3）去除或反转抵消作用会使最终隐藏误差分别增加2.94×和8.41×，KL散度显著增加，验证了抵消作用的因果效应；4）最终隐藏状态误差主要是角度变化（88.9%-98.7%），平均旋转约12.47°；5）由于高维衰减（μ_d≈√(2/π(d-1))），词汇平均投影角变化仅约0.159°（78.6×衰减）；6）高排名token的投影角较小，因此其相对分数和概率变化更小，符合定理2和定理3的理论预测；7）这些机制在Qwen3、OLMo3、Gemma3及MoE模型上一致成立，且对权重量化、激活量化及不同PTQ算法（RTN、GPTQ、AWQ）均稳健。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示了后训练量化在预训练LLM中有效工作的两个关键机制。第一，预训练模型中学到的"抵消作用"（counteraction）使得每个Transformer块引入的更新误差倾向于与累积的隐藏状态误差方向相反，通过精确的递推分解和干预实验证明了这一机制是减缓隐藏误差增长的主要因素，其来源主要是块对输入误差的响应而非直接权重扰动（贡献99.9%）。第二，最终隐藏状态误差主要为方向旋转而非范数变化，高维LM头几何使得该旋转对每个固定权重向量的投影角影响极小，且高排名token的较小投影角使其分数和概率对旋转更不敏感。这两个机制共同解释了为什么多层累积的量化误差最终只导致较小的输出变化，且在不同模型架构、量化设置和PTQ算法中均得到验证。

title: Predicting Privacy Leakage from Weight Spectral Density
summary: Membership inference attacks (MIAs) are widely used to audit the privacy disclosure risk of machine learning models, however current state-of-the-art attacks require training computationally expensive shadow models, making large-scale privacy evaluation impractical. In this work, we investigate whether inexpensive spectral metrics derived from the heavy-tailed self-regularisation framework can serve as proxies for MIA vulnerability. We evaluate several WeightWatcher spectral metrics on image and tabular classification tasks and compare their relationship with MIA privacy leakage against conventional measures of generalisation. Across datasets, stable rank exhibits a strong positive correlation with overall MIA success, while Log alpha-Norm shows a consistent negative correlation with MIA vulnerability at the low false-positive regime. These associations are observed to be stronger than those obtained using the generalisation gap. The results indicate that neural network spectra may contain information about privacy leakage that is not fully captured by conventional measures of overfitting, motivating spectral analysis as a promising direction for scalable privacy auditing.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于WeightWatcher（WW）框架的廉价谱指标能否作为成员推断攻击（MIA）隐私泄露风险的代理指标。通过对CIFAR-10和Volkert数据集上的44个MLP模型进行实验，发现稳定秩与LiRA AUC呈强正相关，对数α范数与低FPR区间的TPR呈负相关，且这些关联均强于传统的泛化间隙指标，表明权重谱密度中包含隐私泄露相关信息。
AI.motivation: 当前最先进的MIA隐私审计方法（如LiRA、RMIA）需要训练大量计算昂贵的影子模型，难以实现大规模隐私评估。在受信任研究环境（TRE）中，需在模型发布前对其进行隐私风险筛查，而昂贵的参考模型攻击使得此项工作在大规模场景下不切实际。因此亟需寻找无需训练影子模型、无需访问数据的廉价隐私风险代理指标。
AI.method: 1. **理论基础**：采用重尾自正则化（HT-SR）理论，利用WeightWatcher（WW）工具从训练后的权重矩阵经验谱密度（ESD）中提取谱指标，无需访问数据。2. **评估指标**：包括泛化指标（训练/测试精度、泛化间隙）、WW谱指标（α幂律指数、对数α范数、对数谱范数、稳定秩）以及LiRA隐私指标（AUC和TPR@0.001）。3. **实验设计**：在CIFAR-10和Volkert数据集上训练44个具有不同深度和宽度的MLP模型（11种架构×2学习率×2权重衰减），使用SACRO-ML实现的LiRA（64个影子模型）评估隐私泄露。4. **分析方法**：通过Spearman秩相关分析谱指标与隐私泄露关系；采用多元OLS回归和逻辑回归验证指标的互补性；将模型分类为高/低风险进行二元预测评估。
AI.result: 1. **稳定秩与LiRA AUC**呈强正相关：CIFAR-10上ρ=0.87，Volkert上ρ=0.60（p≤0.01），强于泛化间隙（ρ=0.67和0.54）。2. **对数α范数与LiRA TPR@0.001**呈一致的负相关：CIFAR-10上ρ=-0.55，Volkert上ρ=-0.40（p≤0.01），强于泛化间隙（ρ=0.04和-0.34）。3. **组合预测**：泛化间隙与对数稳定秩联合预测LiRA AUC的R²达0.82（CIFAR-10）和0.62（Volkert），优于任一单独指标。4. **二元分类**：α和对数α范数能稳定区分高低风险模型（ROC-AUC 0.70-0.83），但泛化间隙和稳定秩在不同数据集上表现不一致；组合两者可获得更稳定的跨域性能。5. 谱指标与泛化间隙提供了互补的隐私泄露信息，组合使用能改善预测效果。
AI.conclusion: 权重矩阵的谱特性为评估隐私风险提供了一种有前景且计算高效的信号，无需昂贵的攻击模拟。稳定秩与整体MIA成功（LiRA AUC）强相关，对数α范数与低FPR区间的隐私泄露（TPR@0.001）一致相关，两者的关联均强于传统的泛化间隙，且谱指标与泛化间隙捕获互补信息，组合使用可进一步提升预测能力。这为大规模、数据免费的隐私审计和基于隐私特性的模型选择提供了新方向。然而，结果受限于仅使用MLP、CIFAR-10与Volkert数据集以及LiRA单一攻击方法，尚未在更复杂架构（如ResNet、Transformer）、更多数据模态或替代攻击下验证其普适性。未来工作应探索谱指标与似然比攻击所利用的损失分布性质之间的直接联系，并尝试非线性组合以提升低FPR区间的预测性能。

title: Dynamic language model representations for multi-objective reaction optimisation
summary: Optimising chemical reactions across multiple objectives, such as yield, selectivity, and safety, is central to chemical synthesis, and model-driven approaches depend critically on how reaction components are represented. Established featurisations are either chemically uninformative, as with one-hot encodings, or, as with molecular descriptors, do not readily extend across chemically distinct components. For structurally and functionally diverse components, it is therefore unclear what a shared representation should contain. Constructing such a representation is itself a challenging research undertaking that must be revisited for each new reaction system. Here we bypass this step by learning the reaction representation dynamically from text. Textual descriptions of reaction conditions are encoded by a fine-tuned language model trained jointly with Gaussian process surrogates, yielding task-adaptive representations within a multi-objective Bayesian optimisation loop. Across nickel- and palladium-catalysed cross-couplings in both sequential and parallel experimentation regimes, this approach reaches optimisation convergence in fewer experiments than descriptor libraries or one-hot encoding. Applied prospectively to a palladium-catalysed cyanation spanning mixed ligand denticity and heterogeneous additives, and to a three-objective asymmetric hydrogenation across chiral iridium and ruthenium catalyst families, two rounds of high-throughput experimentation (192 reactions, under 3% of each design space) delivered conditions translating directly to gram scale in 94% and 84% isolated yield, the latter at 99.6% enantiomeric excess.

AI.tldr: 本文提出名为"Alice"的框架，通过联合微调的大型语言模型（LLM）嵌入直接从文本描述中学习化学反应条件的动态表示，绕过传统描述符工程的瓶颈，实现跨化学异质组件的多目标贝叶斯优化。
AI.motivation: 传统化学反应优化中，分子描述符依赖先验化学直觉且难以跨化学异异质组件迁移，one-hot编码缺乏化学相似性信息，而为每个新反应系统构建共享表示本身就是一项艰巨的研究任务。
AI.method: 使用LoRA微调的语言模型（T5-base+均值池化）将反应条件的文本描述编码为嵌入，通过目标特定的投影头输入到独立的高斯过程代理模型中，以联合边际对数似然最大化进行端到端训练，嵌入多目标贝叶斯优化循环（qLogNParEGO采集函数）。
AI.result: 在镍/钯催化Suzuki偶联基准测试中达到收敛所需实验次数约为描述符库和one-hot编码的一半；在钯催化磺胺偶联HTE优化中仅需约1.2轮96孔板迭代（基线约2.4轮）；前瞻性应用于钯催化氰化（30,000条件搜索空间）和三目标不对称氢化（8,064条件），仅用两轮192次实验（<3%搜索空间）即在克级制备中分别获得94%和84%分离产率，后者ee达99.6%。
AI.conclusion: 动态语言模型表示为多目标反应优化提供了一种通用方法，可在无需专家特征工程的前提下跨越化学异质的反应系统，有望拓展至生物催化等领域。

title: AdamX: Cosine similarity meets gradient descent
summary: We introduce AdamX, a first-order optimizer that incorporates cosine similarity as an adaptive mechanism for controlling update magnitudes. The proposed method is scalable, model-agnostic, and straightforward to integrate into existing training pipelines. We further introduce a variance rectification scheme that promotes smoother optimization during the early stages of training. Overall, we provide empirical evidence that AdamX achieves competitive convergence rates across a range of benchmark datasets and architectures. Performance is evaluated in terms of the number of epochs required to reach predefined performance thresholds under a fixed hyperparameter budget. Code and Experiments available at: this https URL .

AI.tldr: AdamX是一种新的梯度下降算法，将余弦相似度作为自适应更新幅度控制机制，并结合方差修正以提升早期训练稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有优化器（如Adam）在不同任务和架构上对超参数敏感且收敛效率有限，需要一种更通用、可扩展且易集成的优化方法。
AI.method: 提出一阶优化器AdamX，利用余弦相似度自适应控制参数更新幅度，并引入方差修正方案缓解训练初期的不稳定性。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集和架构上的实验表明，AdamX在固定超参数预算下，以达到预定性能阈值所需的训练轮数衡量，达到了具有竞争力的收敛速率。
AI.conclusion: 余弦相似度作为自适应机制结合方差修正能够有效提升优化效率，AdamX是一种简单、可扩展且模型无关的优化方案。

title: CoRA-NAS: Coarse Ranking and Anchor-Residual Refinement for Neural Architecture Search
summary: Zero-cost proxies rank architectures cheaply, but their reliability varies across search spaces. We introduce CoRA-NAS (COarse Ranking + Anchor-residual), a two-stage framework combining a static ranking prior with low-cost learning-curve refinement. CoRA-Rank aggregates capacity and structure-at-initialization proxies through an equal-weight log-rank consensus and a target-free consensus gate. CoRA-Refine samples anchors across this prior, extrapolates their early validation curves, and propagates a learned residual correction with an ExtraTrees model. The refinement uses approximately 1% of the cost of fully training the candidate set. Fully trained architecture-accuracy labels are not used to fit the ranker. One configuration is used across spaces, with space-specific architecture encodings. Across NAS-Bench-201, NAS-Bench-101, TransNAS-Bench-101, and NATS-SSS, CoRA-Refine achieves mean Spearman correlations of 0.946, 0.715, 0.786, and 0.894, respectively. Its worst-space correlation of 0.715 is the highest among the compared methods. On NAS-Bench-201/CIFAR-100, its selected architecture reaches 73.32% accuracy, near the reported ground-truth best of 73.37%. On the pure size space, refinement recovers the static prior's shortfall relative to parameter count, while remaining tied with the strongest capacity proxies within noise. The resulting framework combines cross-space ranking robustness with low-cost architecture selection.

AI.tldr: CoRA-NAS提出了一种两阶段、免标签的神经架构搜索框架：Stage 1通过等权重秩共识聚合零成本代理构建静态先验，Stage 2利用约1%训练成本的早期学习曲线残差修正先验，在四个视觉基准上实现单一配置下的跨空间鲁棒排序。
AI.motivation: 现有零成本代理在不同搜索空间中可靠性差异显著，存在容量代理在结构变化空间失效而结构代理在尺寸变化空间失效的交叉现象；现有组合方法要么需要查询真实精度（标签），要么需要逐空间调参，无法在单一配置下实现跨空间鲁棒。
AI.method: 方法分两阶段：Stage 1 (CoRA-Rank) 对5个零成本代理（#Params, Synflow, jacov, AZ-NAS的expressivity和trainability视图）进行百分位秩排序，通过无标签共识门控剔除符号翻转的代理，再用等权重对数秩共识聚合；Stage 2 (CoRA-Refine) 在先验上分层采样约6.4%的锚点，训练约15%的epoch得到早期验证曲线，用LLW+pow3秩平均无目标外推得到精度预测，计算残差后用ExtraTrees模型传播到全部架构，最后通过操作局部性平滑输出最终排序。
AI.result: 在NB201/NB101/TransNAS/NATS-SSS四个视觉基准上，CoRA-Refine的Spearman相关系数分别为0.946/0.715/0.786/0.894，最差空间0.715为所有比较方法中最高；NB201/CIFAR-100选择精度达73.32%，接近真实最优73.37%；在DARTS真实单元空间上从零训练达到2.81% CIFAR-10错误率。
AI.conclusion: CoRA-NAS证明了一个干净（等权重、可解释）的静态先验加上少量无标签曲线残差可以在单一配置下实现跨结构、跨尺寸、跨任务空间的鲁棒架构排序；该框架是代理无关的Rank+Refine框架，其收益随先验和架构编码的信息量而定。

title: CausalArena: Benchmarking Causal Discovery in the Foundation Model Era
summary: Causal discovery aims to uncover causal structures from data and is fundamental to scientific reasoning and intervention-based decision making. Its evaluation relies heavily on structural causal models (SCMs), which specify a causal graph together with the mechanisms that generate data, yet existing studies differ substantially in graph families, mechanisms, and evaluation protocols. The emergence of causal discovery foundation models (CDFMs) further complicates evaluation: performance may reflect not only causal discovery ability, but also overlap between pretraining environments and test SCMs, making results on fixed synthetic benchmarks difficult to interpret. We introduce CausalArena, a unified and evolvable benchmark for causal discovery under a common protocol. Synthetic SCMs supply controlled breadth over structures and mechanisms; semantic operational SCMs provide human-auditable, semantically grounded environments beyond standard synthetic generators; and formula-grounded SCMs test discovery under explicit scientific mechanisms. Public real-world datasets provide an additional external-validity check. Experiments across classical, neural, and pretrained methods reveal substantial ranking shifts across SCM families and protocols, showing that strong performance in one benchmark regime does not reliably transfer to others. These results highlight benchmark diversity and pretraining--evaluation overlap as central challenges for evaluating causal discovery in the foundation model era.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CausalArena，一个面向基础模型时代的因果发现统一基准，包含1,200个可执行SCM规范（合成、语义操作、公式驱动科学三类），通过18种方法（经典、神经网络、预训练）评估揭示排名在不同SCM家族间显著波动，并强调预训练-评估重叠是核心挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有因果发现评估存在三大缺陷：不同研究使用不同的图家族、机制和协议导致结果不可比；预训练因果发现基础模型（CDFM）的评估可能混合因果发现能力与预训练-评估分布重叠；公开的固定基准可能被未来模型纳入预训练数据。这要求基准设计满足四个标准：广度、新鲜度、基础性和可诊断性。
AI.method: 构建包含三类互补SCM家族的统一基准：(1) 1,000个合成SCM（涵盖10种图拓扑、16种机制、14种根分布、15种噪声，维度10-100），用于受控广度评估；(2) 100个语义操作SCM（覆盖10个运营领域如公共健康、网络安全），通过智能体工作流构建，提供可审计的操作基础；(3) 100个公式驱动科学SCM（覆盖10个科学领域），基于显式科学方程。所有SCM编译为统一可执行规范，共享观测和干预评估协议（观测n=1000，混合800观测+200干预），并使用公开真实数据集作为外部效度检验。评估18种方法，采用F1、SHD等指标，并进行因子级分析、预训练暴露诊断（ID/OOD分析）和运行时间分析。
AI.result: 实验揭示三个核心发现：(1) 方法排名在不同SCM家族间显著变化，FoundCause在合成/语义/公式三类观测F1分别为0.62/0.63/0.52为最强，但其在真实数据上仅0.21，而TabCausal在真实数据obs+int上达0.46最强；(2) FoundCause和TabCausal在预训练文档支持的ID/OOD类别间相对增益差距最小（0%和4%），泛化更稳定，而AVICI的ID-OOD差距达6%；(3) 样本量效应在n=1000后趋于饱和，干预协议对IGSP影响最大（F1 SD=0.100）。运行时间方面Arrow最快（0.077秒/图），FoundCause最慢（4.754秒/图）但F1最高。
AI.conclusion: CausalArena通过结合合成SCM的广度、语义SCM的操作基础和公式SCM的机制基础，为基础模型时代的因果发现评估提供了可演化的统一框架。关键启示是：单一基准分数不足以评估因果发现能力，必须跨SCM家族读取排名并考虑预训练-评估重叠；通过版本化发布和可扩展接口支持基准演化是应对数据污染的务实策略。

title: TART: A Modular Tool for Technique-Aware Audio-to-Tablature Guitar Transcription
summary: Automatic Music Transcription (AMT) for guitar remains limited by three challenges: existing systems often fail to capture expressive techniques such as slides, bends, and percussive hits; they often assign notes to incorrect string-fret combinations; and they are typically trained on clean recordings, limiting their generalization to noisy real-world audio. To address these challenges, we propose TART, a modular four-stage audio-to-tablature pipeline consisting of (1) an audio-to-MIDI transcription model, (2) an expressive technique classifier, (3) an audio-conditioned T5 encoder-decoder for string-fret assignment, and (4) an automated tablature generator. We evaluate TART in a zero-shot setting on GuitarSet, EGDB, and two augmented benchmarks, Noisy GuitarSet and Noisy EGDB. Averaged across these four benchmarks, TART achieves 81.35% audio-to-MIDI F50 (+6.67 points over the best prior baseline), 71.8% string-fret Tab F1 (+8.5 points over the best prior baseline), and 54.08% end-to-end Tab F1. To our knowledge, TART is the first framework to generate guitar tablature with both fingering and expressive technique annotations directly from guitar audio.

AI.tldr: TART 是一个面向吉他的四模块音频到六线谱（tab）转录流水线，包含音频转 MIDI、演奏技法分类、弦-品位分配（AudioFret）和 MusicXML 谱表生成四阶段，在四个零样本基准上达到音频转 MIDI F50 81.35%、弦-品位 Tab F1 71.8%、端到端 Tab F1 54.08%，是首个直接从吉他音频生成同时包含指法和演奏技法标注的 tab 框架。
AI.motivation: 吉他自动音乐转录（AMT）存在三大难题：现有系统无法捕获滑音、推弦、击打等表现性技法；常将音符分配到错误的弦-品位组合；且主要在干净录音上训练，难以泛化到真实嘈杂场景。作者旨在联合解决这三方面问题。
AI.method: 模块化四阶段流水线：（1）基于 Kong et al. 高分辨率 CRNN 的音频转 MIDI，使用 GAPS、Guitar-TECHS、François Leduc、GOAT 四个数据集联合训练，并设计保留起音对齐的随机噪声增强器；（2）基于 CNN-BiLSTM 的九类技法分类器（输入 128×92 的 MFCC+Mel+Chroma 特征），整合五个公开数据集为统一标签体系；（3）AudioFret：扩展 Fretting-Transformer，将 T5 编码器-解码器从 d_model=128/3 层扩展到 d_model=256/6 层/8 头/gated-GELU，并通过一个 CNN 音频编码器将每个音符 200ms 的梅尔谱嵌入注入编码器，端到端融合音色与符号信息；（4）基于 BeatNet 节奏量化与 MusicXML 渲染的谱表生成，融合前两阶段输出。
AI.result: 在零样本 GuitarSet、EGDB、Noisy GuitarSet、Noisy EGDB 四个基准上的平均结果：音频转 MIDI F50 81.35%（较最优基线 Riley et al. +6.67 点，尤其在 EGDB/噪声版本上提升 8-10 点）；技法分类 Macro F1 95.9%，显著优于 Fiorini et al.（62.7%）和 Stefani et al.（71.6%）；AudioFret 平均 Tab F1 71.8%（较原 Fretting-Transformer +8.5 点，消融显示规模化骨干贡献 +3.7，音频条件再贡献 +4.8）；端到端 Tab F1 54.08%，从 Stage 1 到 Stage 3 的错误传播成本约 17.75 点。
AI.conclusion: TART 是首个联合建模音高、表现性技法和弦-品位的吉他 tab 生成框架，在干净和嘈杂场景均达到新的零样本 SOTA，缩小了吉他 AMT 与钢琴 AMT 的差距。仍存在局限：无法检测无音高打击音符、每音符仅标注单一技法（难以表示"推弦+揉弦"组合）、固定节奏量化可能导致和弦分组错误。

title: From Protocols to Evidence: Bounded Claims for AI in Service of the Common Good
summary: Artificial Intelligence does more than create a governance problem. It can also reveal where institutions have already failed to provide responsiveness, belonging, care, and accountability. Once deployed, AI becomes an intervention in those conditions. It can repair, compound, substitute for, or conceal the failures it encounters. Responsible AI must therefore evaluate both the system and the institutional rupture into which it is introduced. The move from principles to protocols is already underway. The EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, and assurance practices translate commitments into roles, requirements, records, oversight, and assessment. The harder questions are what these protocols actually establish, whose power they leave untouched, and where measurement must stop. Pope Leo XIV's Magnifica Humanitas provides a broader moral frame centered on dignity, technological power, and the common good. Drawing on that frame, we develop a rupture test that links institutional baselines to system evaluation. We distinguish evidence-bounded deployment, which limits claims to what has actually been evaluated, from measurement-bounded governance, which records constraints that favorable evidence cannot override. Within those limits, RISE AI provides an architecture for making bounded, evidence-based claims about Responsibility, Inclusivity, Safety, and Empowerment. Responsible AI requires better engineering, institutional repair, and continued moral and political judgment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种"有界主张"框架,认为AI既是干预也是揭示,需同时评估系统本身与其部署所处的制度断裂;以教皇利奥十四世《Magnifica Humanitas》为道德框架,提出"破裂测试"和"测量有界治理",并构建RISE AI证据架构(责任、包容、安全、赋能四个领域),主张工程改进与道德政治判断必须并行推进。
AI.motivation: 现有的负责任AI治理已从原则走向协议(EU AI Act、NIST AI RMF、ISO/IEC 42001等),但核心难题尚未解决:这些协议实际确立了哪些主张,哪些权力未被触及,以及测量应在何处止步。同时,AI常被部署于已经存在制度失败的语境中(响应性、归属感、关怀、问责的缺失),AI既是这些失败的诊断工具,也是改变这些制度的干预手段,可能修复、加剧、替代或掩盖失败。因此需要一种既评估系统又评估制度断裂的框架,并明确证据的边界。
AI.method: 1. 提出"破裂测试"(rupture test):在部署前识别先在的制度/关系失败,明确人类与非AI基线,判断AI介导系统是修复、加剧、替代还是掩盖该失败;2. 以《Magnifica Humanitas》为道德人类学框架,引入尊严、政治经济、技术权力等维度,强调控制平台、基础设施、数据、算力的经济行为者所设定的参与条件本身就是治理对象;3. 区分"证据有界部署"(evidence-bounded deployment)与"测量有界治理"(measurement-bounded governance):前者将主张限于已被评估的证据,后者记录有利证据无法超越的约束;4. 构建RISE AI证据架构,围绕四个领域(Responsibility, Inclusivity, Safety, Empowerment)建立版本化的主张-证据图与上下文与权力记录(context-and-power record),采用"规范领域→有界系统主张→指标→证据来源→有界推理"的效度链;5. 给出五个设计模式(可问责性、可争议性、保留能动性的接口、情境感知评估、证据有界部署)及公共福利决策的实例验证。
AI.result: 论文为概念性与框架性工作,未进行实证验证。给出:(a) 破裂测试的操作逻辑;(b) 主张-证据图与上下文与权力记录的模板;(c) 公共福利AI决策中"可争议性"主张的完整RISE链条实例(见表2);(d) 跨领域探索(教育中的学习迁移与学生原创性、临床决策支持中的责任分配与可覆盖性);(e) 七项研究路线图(参与式内容效度、评估者间可重复性、结果效度、变化敏感性、决策效用、政治经济敏感性、操作负担与比例性)。同时明确局限:工作是概念证明而非实证验证,主张表述与阈值设定仍需规范性判断,日志与溯源可能引发隐私风险,政治经济分析易流于表面。
AI.conclusion: 负责任AI不能仅靠更好的工程设计,也不能仅靠道德与政治判断;两者必须协同推进。工程是必要的,因为它使道德承诺转化为实际行为;道德与政治判断是必要的,因为AI重新分配了能动性和责任,提出了设计本身无法解决的问题。RISE AI使主张-证据关系、权力分配与测量边界变得可见,但测量本身无法赋予道德或政治合法性。最终问题不是机器是否会变得更像人,而是人类是否将建造配得上人性的制度与系统。

title: Data Scarcity and Model Sparsity: Mixtures-of-Experts Overfit More to Repeated Data
summary: As the supply of human-written text is exhausted, it has become standard practice to repeat language model training data. Prior work has studied data repetition for densely activated Transformers, but the effects of data repetition remains largely unexplored for recently dominant sparse architectures such as Mixture-of-Experts (MoE), despite their increased compute efficiency. We vary data repetition rates across single- and multi-domain data mixes, and across MoE settings, including expert count and granularity. We consistently find, for models ranging from 80M to 1B active (8.5B total) parameters, that MoEs degrade more rapidly under data repetition. This effect increases with sparsity, dictated by total rather than active parameters. While 80M dense models can repeat data over 8x with minimal degradation, MoEs instead begin to suffer at 4x, and deteriorate rapidly, ceding their performance benefits in all-unique data settings to underperform dense models after 32x. We experiment with existing regularization methods as a potential remedy. We find that some methods, such as dropout, can mitigate overfitting. In particular, with strong masking-based regularization, MoEs are able to outperform dense models even when data is repeated more than 64 times. However, no method fully matches the performance of all-unique training data. Finally, we analyze internal mechanisms correlated with MoE overfitting in high repetition regimes, and find that MoE routing universally stabilizes early in training, and that expert specialization correlates with overfitting to repeated data. In sum, our work addresses the adverse interactions between sparsity and data repetition: we present evidence for the core mechanisms of overfitting and its potential remediation, and suggest promising avenues for future methods to reduce over-specialization in model parameters by disrupting memorization patterns.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了数据重复（data repetition）对稀疏激活的混合专家模型（MoE）与密集Transformer模型的不同影响，发现MoE在数据稀缺场景下退化更严重，其根源在于路由器早期固化（router ossification）导致专家过度专业化（expert specialization），并验证了dropout等掩码类正则化方法可有效缓解此问题。
AI.motivation: 随着高质量人类文本数据的枯竭，在语言模型训练中重复使用数据已成为常态。同时，为提高计算效率，MoE架构被广泛采用。然而，稀疏性（sparsity）与数据重复之间的交互作用此前未被充分研究：MoE在唯一数据上表现优异，但在高重复率下是否会因专家过度专业化而遭受更严重的过拟合？该问题对数据受限时代的大模型训练至关重要。
AI.method: 1. **模型配置**：训练80M、200M、1B三种激活参数规模的密集Transformer与多种MoE配置（专家数n∈{8,16,32,64,128,256}，粒度g∈{1/2,1/4,...,1/32}，稀疏度s∈{2,4,8,16,32}），最高达8.5B总参数。2. **数据设置**：固定总token预算T≈20·N_a（部分实验扩展至80·N_a），变化唯一token数U和重复率R∈{1,2,...,1024}，使用OLMoE数据混合（DCLM、StarCoder、peS2o、Wikipedia）。3. **实验维度**：单域与多域混合、不同数据质量过滤（DCLM-baseline vs pool）、混合域内的差异化重复率。4. **正则化方法**：Dropout、Expert Dropout、FFN Output Masking、Expert Output Masking、Weight Decay、Gradient Norm Clipping、Router Jitter。5. **机制分析**：通过连续checkpoint的top-1专家一致性度量路由固化（routing ossification）；通过专家敲除（expert knockout）度量专家专业化程度；通过共激活熵度量专家协同模式。
AI.result: 1. **MoE退化更严重**：80M密集模型可承受8×重复率无明显退化，而MoE在4×即开始退化；32×重复时MoE性能优势逆转，反被密集模型超越。2. **稀疏度加剧过拟合**：过拟合程度由总参数而非激活参数决定；总参数越大（如200M密集 vs 80M-MoE(64×1/4)的244M总参数），对数据重复越敏感。3. **跨域一致性**：过拟合模式在网页、代码、学术、百科四种差异显著的单域数据上几乎一致。4. **数据过滤影响有限**：仅密集模型在重度未过滤数据上退化更快，MoE对过滤不敏感。5. **混合域的正则化效应**：将重复域与不重复的语义相似域（如peS2o+DCLM）混合可减轻过拟合。6. **正则化效果**：Dropout、Expert Dropout、FFN/Expert Output Masking等掩码类方法显著缓解过拟合（高dropout下MoE在64×重复率仍优于密集模型）；但Weight Decay、Gradient Norm Clipping、Router Jitter效果甚微；任何方法均无法完全恢复全唯一数据的性能。7. **机制发现**：MoE路由器在训练极早期（10%步数内）即固化（top-1一致性>95%），高重复率进一步加剧固化；专家专业化（敲除成本）随重复率上升；Dropout通过降低专家专业化（而非改变路由器）发挥作用。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示了数据稀缺与模型稀疏性之间的负面交互：MoE架构的计算效率优势在数据受限场景下被过拟合所抵消。过拟合的核心机制是路由器早期固化导致专家参数在训练过程中仅接触极小的、准静态的token子集，进而过度专业化。基于输出掩码的正则化方法（如dropout）通过迫使专家学习更分散、更鲁棒的表示来缓解该问题。未来研究方向包括：开发专门打破专家过度专业化模式的新型正则化策略，以在数据受限时代保持MoE的计算效率优势。

title: Detectable Only Where It Is Confounded: What Verified Duplication Counts Say About Membership Evidence in Language Models
comment: 14 pages, 6 figures. Code, data, and sentence banks: this https URL
summary: When a language model finds a sentence unusually cheap to predict, it is tempting to conclude that the sentence was in its training data. Almost every published test of that inference has had to guess which sentences were in the training data, the members, and which were not. This paper removes the guessing. Two model families, OLMo-2 and Pythia, publish their pretraining corpora, and a public index over those corpora returns the exact number of times any sentence appeared in each. Those counts make three questions answerable directly. The answers form a pincer, closing from two sides. At the duplication levels ordinary text actually has, five models from 1B to 13B parameters carry at most a faint trace of their own exposure. We measure that trace with a design that reads the same sentence through two models, which cancels fluency and quality by construction, and it comes to a rank correlation near -0.08, where -1 would be a perfect relation and 0 none. Where the trace does become strong, above roughly a thousand copies, the two corpora agree on which sentences those are, because they are the famous ones, so exposure can no longer be told apart from fame. Two further measurements show how apparent membership signal gets manufactured. A common way to build a non-member is to change one word of a member. The model does prefer the original, but the gap is the same whether the original appeared once or a hundred times, so what the model is rewarding is the author's word choice, not memory. Above a thousand copies the gap grows with model size on the twelve sentences we can test there, at the same boundary where the pincer closes. And swapping the controls for sentences that differ from the members in register moves a detector from 0.83 to 0.94 AUC, on a scale where 0.5 is a coin flip and 1.0 is perfect separation. We release the sentence banks, counts, and code.

AI.tldr: 本文利用 OLMo-2 与 Pythia 两个公开预训练语料及 infini-gram 索引，获得句子的精确重复次数作为"曝光剂量"，系统检验基于损失的语言模型成员推断攻击的可靠性。研究发现：在普通文本重复量级（1–1000 次）下，曝光在损失中留下的痕迹极弱（Spearman 相关约 -0.08，方差贡献不足 1%）；而在损失信号变强的区段（>1000 次重复），这些句子恰恰是"著名文本"，两个语料对此类高频句子几乎一致地认为是成员，导致曝光与"著名度"不可分离，形成一个"夹击"论证。同时揭示两类混淆来源：通过替换一词构造的非成员对照被模型以约 0.4 nats/token 的差距系统性地区分（实际测的是作者措辞而非记忆）；用语域不同的合成句子替换对照可将 AUC 从 0.83 推至 0.94。作者开源了句子库、计数与代码。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型成员推断（membership inference）研究普遍依赖对训练集的猜测来构造成员/非成员集，这导致成员与非成员在日期、来源、文风、长度等方面存在分布差异，探测器可能在不知觉"成员性"的情况下取得高分（近年的 Duan et al. 2024、Meeus et al. 2024、Das et al. 2024 等已指出该问题）。同时，研究多以二元标签处理成员性，未引入"曝光剂量"概念。本文的目标是：(1) 利用公开语料索引获得句子级精确重复计数，将成员性从二元标签转为剂量；(2) 设计能"固定句子、变化曝光"的实验，剥离流畅度与质量混淆。
AI.method:
1. 数据与计数：使用 infini-gram 对 OLMo-mix-1124（OLMo-2 预训练语料）与 Pile（Pythia 预训练语料）进行精确字符串计数；选取 10–16 词的句子；构建三类句库：著名句库（12 句，~1,200 次中位重复）与 pass 3 / pass 4 中部句库（来自 6 本公版小说的中段，162/585 句，重复量级在十次）。
2. 非成员构造：从同一句替换一个同长度同语域的近义词，并核实替换后在索引中返回零次。
3. 直接损失检验：以成员/非成员句子上的平均每 token 损失为评分，用 AUC 衡量判别能力，按重复量分带分析（1–9、10–99、100–999、>1000）。
4. 差异设计（differential design）：对每句同时读取 OLMo-2 与 Pythia 同尺寸模型，计算二者损失差与二者语料 log 计数差，并在"书内"做 Spearman 相关，以消除句子流畅度/质量/长度等混淆；用书内置换检验做显著性。模型规模涵盖 OLMo-2 1B/7B/13B 与 Pythia 6.9B/12B（共五个模型，1B–13B 参数）。
5. 编辑对照分析：测量原句与一词编辑句之间的损失差，按重复量分带观察其是否随曝光增长。
6. 语域对照分析：对同一组著名成员，分别用同源编辑与自写合成散文做对照，比较 AUC。
7. 辅助实验：尝试用梯度上升"反学习"抵抗度做成员信号，未成功（附录 A）。
AI.result:
1. 基于损失的成员检验在中段句库（重复 1–999 次）AUC 在 0.57–0.66 之间，跨三个数量级"基本不随重复数变化"；在著名句库上 AUC 升至 0.83（95% bootstrap 0.65–0.98，n=12）。
2. 差异设计：书内 Spearman 相关 −0.084（7B vs 6.9B，p=0.016，n=747）、−0.065（13B vs 12B，p=0.067，n=747），对应方差贡献 <1%，且不随规模增大而增强。书间相关大（−0.94 / −0.49）但 13B 比 7B 弱，bootstrap 区间覆盖 0，与"品味"而非"记忆"相符。
3. 一词编辑对照：原句对编辑句的中位损失差约 0.4 nats/token（约 1.5 倍概率差），在 92%–100% 的配对中原句更低；该差距在 1–999 次重复区间几乎不随重复量变化；仅在著名句库（>1000 次）随模型规模增长（1B 0.550 → 7B 0.787 → 13B 0.932 nats/token）。
4. 语域对照：同一著名成员集合，用同源编辑做对照 AUC=0.83，用合成散文做对照 AUC=0.94（1B），13B 时两者均达到 1.000。
5. 夹击结论：损失可检测的区段（>1000 次）恰是两语料对"著名度"高度一致的区段，此时曝光与著名度不可分；两语料存在分歧的低重复区段，曝光痕迹微弱（|r|≈0.08）。
AI.conclusion: 对于所测 1B–13B 规模模型与英文文学散文，在普通文本的重复量级上，损失对训练集暴露几乎没有可测痕迹；只有当句子被重复上千次（典型即著名文本）时损失信号才增强，而此时已无法把"成员性"与"著名度"分开。成员推断攻击的高 AUC 多由对照构造的人为分布偏移造成：替换一词测的是作者措辞偏好，语域差异则可单方面推高 AUC。作者指出三种可打破该"夹击"的途径——更大模型、对著名文本不一致的公开语料对、以及在预训练中注入受控唯一序列。同时承认 13B 量化（8-bit）、句库规模较小（著名句仅 12 句）、仅 6 本英文公版小说等局限；并提示其 13B 数据中已出现一个在 12 句内仍可见的、随重复数增长的趋势（r=0.206, p=0.039），可能是夹击的第一道裂痕。所有句子库、计数与代码以 MIT 协议开源。

title: Structurally Speaking: Motif-Oriented Graph Captioning through Bidirectional Graph-Text Translation
summary: Graph captions should help readers understand graph structure, rather than simply translate adjacency matrices into long textual edge lists. A useful graph caption abstracts connectivity into recognizable motifs, such as hubs, paths, cycles, cliques, and bridges, because these motifs provide compact structural units that are easier to read, compare, and recover. In this paper, we study motif-oriented graph captioning as a bidirectional graph-text translation task, where captions must both preserve enough topology for graph recovery and express the graph through concise motif-level descriptions. We show that direct prompting of GPT-5.1 often produces graph-recoverable captions by enumerating node-to-node connections, but these captions are verbose and can contain inconsistent motif interpretations. To address this gap, we introduce Structurally Speaking, a lightweight structured prompting protocol that guides translation between explicit connectivity and motif-level abstraction. Experiments on a synthetic motif-based dataset show that structured prompting produces shorter and more motif-consistent captions while maintaining comparable graph recovery. These results suggest that explicit topology-to-motif reasoning guidance can make LLM-generated graph captions more interpretable without model fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"Structurally Speaking"，一种轻量级的结构化提示协议，用于将LLM生成的图描述从冗长的边枚举转变为简洁的基序（motif）级抽象，同时保持图可恢复性。
AI.motivation: 直接提示LLM生成图描述时，虽然能通过枚举节点间连接实现图恢复，但描述冗长且基序解读不一致；可恢复性不等于可解释的基序级抽象，需要一种方法平衡两者。
AI.method: 将双向图-文本翻译形式化为诊断任务：(1) 图→描述通过邻接列表→基序分析→生成描述三步完成；(2) 描述→图通过解析结构→分配节点→构建边列表→构建邻接列表→转换邻接矩阵五步完成。比较直接提示、零样本结构化提示和少样本结构化提示三种方案，使用GPT-5.1在220个合成基序图（40个测试）上进行循环一致性评估（Graph-Caption-Graph用边P/R/F1；Caption-Graph-Caption用ROUGE-1和描述长度）。
AI.result: 直接提示实现完美F1=1.0但描述平均1222字符、ROUGE-1精度仅0.076；零样本结构化提示将长度降至313字符、ROUGE-1精度提升至0.224、F1为0.972；少样本结构化提示实现长度136字符、ROUGE-1精度0.452、F1为0.997。结构化提示在保持可比图恢复能力的同时，显著提升描述简洁性和基序一致性。
AI.conclusion: 显式的拓扑到基序推理引导可使LLM生成的图描述更具可解释性，无需模型微调。该工作验证了结构化思维链提示在图-文本翻译中平衡结构保真度和基序抽象的有效性。

title: Rebalancing Token Importance in Language Models with TF-IDF Weighted Cross-Entropy Loss
summary: Large language models are typically trained under uniform token weighting, which allows frequent and low-information tokens to dominate learning and can increase the tendency to memorize surface-level text spans. To address this, we present an information-weighted cross-entropy loss that rescales token-level contributions using TF-IDF statistics, emphasizing semantically informative tokens while down-weighting ubiquitous ones. Experiments on five decoder-only LLMs ranging from 1.1B to 13B parameters show consistent reductions in memorized substring length while preserving perplexity and downstream task performance. Under LoRA fine-tuning, TF-IDF reduces average substring memorization length by 14% across all five models. Under full-weight fine-tuning on TinyLLaMA 1.1B, the reduction reaches 58%. Our approach is architecture-agnostic and can be incorporated into existing training pipelines with less than 3% computational overhead, offering a lightweight and principled way to mitigate memorization without disrupting standard training dynamics.

AI.tldr: 提出TF-IDF加权的交叉熵损失函数，通过语料库统计信息重新分配token级梯度，在5个1.1B-13B的解码器LLM上一致地减少逐字记忆，同时保持困惑度和下游任务性能，计算开销低于3%。
AI.motivation: 标准LLM训练对所有token一视同仁，导致高频低信息token主导学习，增加表面文本的逐字记忆风险，威胁隐私和版权。现有缓解方法（去重、差分隐私、遗忘学习等）各有代价：计算昂贵或损害模型实用性。需要在训练阶段从梯度分配角度解决记忆问题。
AI.method: 核心方法：TF-IDF加权交叉熵损失，在标准交叉熵基础上为每个token乘以TF-IDF权重。技术上，使用滚动缓冲区（K=16个mini-batch）近似语料库级统计量，计算TF（序列内频率）和平滑IDF（log((1+N)/(1+df))+1），然后将原始权重归一化至单位均值（E[w]=1），保留所有token的监督信号，仅重新分配梯度压力。
AI.result: 在5个模型（TinyLLaMA 1.1B、Pythia 1.4B、GPT-J 6B、LLaMA-2 7B/13B）上：LoRA微调下平均LMS减少14%；TinyLLaMA全参数微调下LMS减少58%（从8.30降至3.50，最大跨度从128降至18）；困惑度在5/6配置中持平或改善；摘要和QA性能差异在噪声范围内（≤1.5% EM, ≤0.6% F1）；计算开销仅增加约3%。
AI.conclusion: TF-IDF加权交叉熵是一种架构无关、计算高效、即插即用的训练目标修改，能在保持模型效用的前提下有效缓解LLM的逐字记忆问题。token感知目标为隐私保护和数据治理提供了可扩展的轻量级策略。未来可扩展至对抗提取评估、预训练阶段应用和子词层面的权重分布分析。

title: When Noise Fabricates Bias: The Fragility of LLM-as-a-Judge Bias Measurement under Noisy Text
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at W-NUT 2026. Code: this https URL
summary: Large language models are increasingly used as judges to measure social bias in text, yet the passages they judge are often noisy, containing typos, informal spelling, and broken punctuation. The consequences of such surface noise for social bias measurement remain unclear. To investigate this question, we apply five realistic noise conditions at multiple intensity levels to 3,822 stereotype-related responses and compare the resulting bias judgments with those on the original text. We find that such surface noise does not degrade bias measurement symmetrically: it is far more likely to turn neutral judgments into biased ones than biased judgments into neutral ones, by up to a 120x margin. We further observe two non-obvious effects across four LLM judges: in the most fragile judge the distortion is at its purest at mild, realistic noise levels, where erasure is scarcest, and as judges grow robust it attenuates toward parity rather than reversing. Bias measured on noisy text is therefore systematically overestimated, most in the categories that matter most for fairness.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了表面噪声（拼写错误、非正式拼写、标点崩溃）对LLM-as-a-judge偏见测量可靠性的影响。作者构建了Fable基准，在3822个刻板印象探测响应上施加五种噪声条件，发现噪声系统性地将中性判断翻转为偏见判断（即"伪造偏见"），而非将偏见判断抹除为中性，且这种不对称性在最脆弱的法官中最严重（最高120倍），并集中在宗教、残障等公平性最敏感的类别上。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多被用作自动测量文本社会偏见的"法官"，但其评估的真实文本（社交媒体、论坛帖子等）常包含拼写错误、非正式拼写、标点缺失等表面噪声。此前工作已表明LLM法官对噪声敏感，但噪声对社会偏见判断的具体影响尚不清楚。核心问题是：表面噪声是否对称地影响偏见测量？
AI.method: 1. 构建Fable基准：基于CLEAR-Bias的3822个二元选择偏见项目（7个偏见类别，91个名字对×42个问题），由GPT-5.4-mini标注为A/B/None。2. 定义五种噪声条件：typo（键盘相邻替换/交换/删除）、informal（社交媒体缩写）、punct（标点和大小写崩溃）、colloquial（informal变体，使用其他英语变体的标记）、combined（前三者组合）。噪声强度p∈{0.1,0.3,0.5,0.7,1.0}。3. 使用四个LLM法官（Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen3-8B、Gemma-4-12B-it、GPT-5.4）进行判断，每个法官以自身clean判断为基线。4. 核心指标为"自基线翻转率"，区分伪造（None→有方向）与抹除（有方向→None）。
AI.result: 核心发现：(1) 噪声不对称地扭曲偏见测量，中性判断翻转为偏见的概率远高于反向（Llama最高达120倍，p<0.001）；(2) 这种伪造集中在宗教、残障、性取向、社会经济地位等最敏感的偏见类别，而性别受影响最小；(3) 四位法官的鲁棒性差异约一个数量级（Gemma最鲁棒约1.2%翻转率，Llama最脆弱约10.7%）；(4) 随着法官鲁棒性增强，不对称性趋向平等（GPT仅1.3倍），但从不反转；(5) 组合噪声比单一类型放大伪造效应高达2.5倍；(6) 在最脆弱的Llama法官中，不对称性在轻度真实噪声水平（p=0.3，120倍）比极端噪声（p=1.0，50倍）更纯粹，因为极端噪声会增加抹除稀释比例；(7) 效果在四个随机种子下稳定（68倍到∞之间）。
AI.conclusion: 表面噪声系统性地让LLM-as-a-judge高估文本中的偏见，而非低估；这种"伪造偏见"在脆弱法官中最严重，并在公平性最关键的类别中最为集中。鲁棒性消除扭曲但不反转其方向。实践启示：偏见测量流水线应在真实轻度噪声下用组合噪声压力测试其法官，并报告其测量的偏见对输入质量的敏感度。论文发布了Fable基准和种子控制的噪声注入工具包。

title: Negative Self-Distillation: Learning to Reason by Avoiding Flaws
summary: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) has emerged as a popular paradigm for large language model (LLM) self-improvement, allowing models to act as their own teachers by leveraging privileged information such as ground-truth solutions. However, recent findings indicate that OPSD can severely degrade the performance of LLMs on complex reasoning tasks: By forcing the student to imitate an artificially confident reasoning trace conditioned on privileged information, OPSD inadvertently suppresses expressions of uncertainty and penalizes the exploratory, self-corrective behaviors required to solve challenging problems. To address this, we introduce Negative Self-Distillation (NSD), a new framework that optimizes LLMs by diverging from flawed reasoning rather than imitating privileged solutions. Instead of relying on ground-truth answers or external supervision, NSD uses the model itself to generate a question-specific negative condition (eg, acting as a ``careless reasoner'') and pushes the student's distribution away from this self-generated negative teacher. Naively applying unlearning objectives to achieve this divergence is problematic, as flawed reasoning tokens are confounded with basic linguistic tokens; indiscriminately penalizing both risks catastrophically degrading the model's foundational language capabilities. We resolve this by designing a dynamic gating mechanism that automatically identifies and isolates reasoning-critical tokens, ensuring gradient updates target only behavioral flaws while preserving the model's linguistic priors. Empirically, NSD consistently outperforms OPSD and other label-free, self-bootstrapping reinforcement learning (RL) baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出NSD（负自蒸馏）框架，通过让模型远离自生成的"有缺陷推理"来增强LLM推理能力，无需真实标签或外部教师；结合动态门控机制和Sigmoid有界非似然目标，在数学推理任务上显著优于OPSD、Intuitor和TTRL等基线。
AI.motivation: 在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）让模型在带特权信息（如标准答案）的条件下产生"虚假自信"的推理轨迹，强制学生模仿这类轨迹会抑制探索性和自我纠错行为，反而损害复杂推理能力。需要一种不依赖真实标签、避免过度自信训练信号的新方法。
AI.method: 1. 负条件生成：让模型自身基于问题（可选地结合其初始解答）生成一个"粗心推理者"式的负条件提示 n_i；2. 双教师对比：冻结参考模型 π_ref（仅基于问题）和负教师 π_neg（基于问题+负条件），比较两者在学生采样 token 上的概率差 G_t = max(0, π_neg − π_ref) 作为门控信号，自动识别被负条件放大的"推理缺陷 token"；3. Sigmoid 有界非似然惩罚 L_GU = G_t · 1/(2−π_θ)，在高概率 token 处自然衰减梯度；4. 配合前向 KL 正则项 L_KL（基于参考模型的单样本加权估计）防止分布漂移。总损失 L_NSD = L_GU + α·L_KL。整体无需真实标签，每样本只需一次 rollout，支持并行前向传播。
AI.result: 在7个数学推理基准（AIME 2024/2025/2026、HMMT 2025、AMC 2023、OlympiadBench、MATH-500）上，NSD在Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B三种规模上分别获得 +2.3%、+7.5%、+6.0% 的平均提升，p 值均具统计显著性。Pass@8、thinking 模式下同样领先；反射行为频率从基线 3.6 提升至 7.5（OPSD 仅 2.2，Intuitor 仅 0.8）。消融实验表明 KL 约束对防止训练崩塌不可或缺，门控机制在过滤"风格 token"方面优于熵加权和 OPSD 损失加权。负条件策略方面，question-only 和 wiki-irr（加入无关维基百科文本）等轻量离线策略也能取得与在线 solution-aware 相当甚至更优的效果，且 wall-clock 训练时间从 68s 降至 54s。
AI.conclusion: NSD 是一种标签自由、全自举的推理增强框架，通过让模型显式远离自身生成的缺陷推理模式，有效避免了 OPSD 引起的过度自信和反射行为塌缩问题。门控机制 + Sigmoid 有界非似然 + KL 锚定的组合在数学推理任务上取得一致最优，同时保持高训练效率并可灵活适配多种负条件生成策略（包括策略梯度框架）。对于极弱模型可能因生成负条件质量有限而效果受限。

title: But How Would AI Agents Run a Town's Economy?
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables. Dataset and analysis code: this https URL
summary: We placed 100 memory-equipped large language model (LLM) agents in charge of a closed, money-conserving spatial economy on real Pokhara Lakeside geography (earning wages, running businesses, setting prices) and ran this multi-agent simulation for up to 26 simulated weeks, well past the 1-2 weeks typical of agent-society studies. Across 91 validated runs (2.44M agent decisions, 21.5B tokens), the money stops moving, in a specific and measurable way. A 12x tourist demand shock raises business revenue 4.62x ($p<0.001$), which we decompose exactly into a 1.50x extensive margin (more businesses trading) and a 3.07x intensive margin (more revenue each). Monetary transmission stops there. Wages move 1.03x ($p=0.42$); 0.3% of 3,981 menu items are ever repriced ($p=0.47$). A randomized cash transfer (NPR 5,000 to 20 of 100 agents) shows the same pattern from the opposite direction: 96.7% is still held 311 pulses later, marginal propensity to consume 3-4% by two independent measures, indistinguishable from zero. The wealth distribution is consequently near-frozen at the horizon this literature uses ($\rho=0.964$ over 2 simulated weeks), but not frozen. $\rho$ falls to 0.832 at 12 weeks and 0.752 at 26, a horizon-dependence no short study can see. Matched ablations show which knob actually matters. Swapping the backing LLM moves every outcome we measure ($p=0.0039$); deleting agents' memory moves none of them detectably. A purely social tool fails 94-97% of the time across two model families, compared with ~96% success on economic tools, with no measurable shift away from it. Every headline number is verified twice, by a live validator and by an offline recomputation that reconciles each agent's wealth against its own signed transaction history, and we release the full run corpus for reanalysis.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个由100个具备记忆能力的大语言模型(LLM)智能体组成的封闭、守恒货币空间经济仿真系统，基于真实地理（尼泊尔博卡拉湖畔），运行长达26个模拟周。通过91次有效运行（244万次决策、215亿token），发现货币在系统中"停止流动"：旅游需求冲击12倍仅使企业营收增长4.62倍，但工资涨幅仅为1.03倍（p=0.42），菜单调价比例仅0.3%；随机现金转移311周期后96.7%仍被持有，边际消费倾向仅3-4%；财富分布在2周时看似"冻结"（ρ=0.964），但在26周时ρ降至0.752，揭示了研究时间视野对结论的关键影响。消融实验表明，决定行为的是底层LLM选择（p=0.0039）而非记忆机制。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体社会研究多在1-2个模拟周内运行，缺乏对封闭经济系统中资源是否真正流动、冲击能否传导、财富分布是否真正演化的长期验证。本文旨在探究：当LLM智能体被部署到经济角色中时，注入系统的资源能否如真实经济般循环流动。
AI.method: 构建基于真实博卡拉湖畔地理的封闭守恒货币仿真系统，100个记忆增强的LLM智能体在762家注册企业中工作、定价、交易；采用7组实验臂（基线、旅游低/高、冲击、财富转移、布局对照、无记忆、跨模型）和长期臂（12周、26周）；通过双重独立验证管道（实时TypeScript验证器+离线Python CSV重算器）审计每笔交易；在41,328个记录周期上实现货币严格守恒；采用配对种子Wilcoxon检验进行消融对比。
AI.result: 核心发现：(1) 12倍旅游需求冲击使企业营收精确分解为1.50倍广延边际×3.07倍集约边际=4.62倍，但工资仅1.03倍（p=0.42），3981项菜单中仅0.3%被重新定价（p=0.47）；(2) 5000尼泊尔卢比随机转移311周期后96.7%仍被持有，边际消费倾向3.3%（财富轨迹法）和4.0%（支出法），均不显著区别于零；(3) 财富分布在2周时ρ=0.964、12周时ρ=0.832、26周时ρ=0.752，呈现视野依赖性；(4) 替换LLM使所有指标显著变化（p=0.0039），而删除记忆无任何可检测效应；(5) 社交工具"邀请对话"在两个模型族上失败率94-97%，占总工具失败的79.6%，且智能体无明显适应性调整。
AI.conclusion: LLM智能体经济体存在系统性的货币传导失败：资金在企业层面停留，不向工人工资或商品价格传导；直接发放的现金转移几乎不被消费；财富分布在短周期看似冻结但实际缓慢均衡；行为差异主要由底层LLM决定而非记忆机制。要构建类人经济模型，首要解决的是激励智能体调整工资与价格的机制，而非记忆或治理问题。所有运行的完整数据集（244万决策、215亿token）已发布以供复现分析。

title: NCP-ArchPreview Technical Report: Moving towards Latent Space Language Models through Next Concept Prediction
summary: We introduce NCP-ArchPreview, a latent-space language model that pushes autoregressive pretraining beyond standard next-token prediction (NTP). Alongside NTP, the model learns through Next Concept Prediction (NCP) to predict discrete concepts that span multiple tokens, introducing an explicit and more challenging concept-level objective while preserving standard token-level autoregressive generation. NCP-ArchPreview builds a latent space by constructing a product-quantized concept vocabulary directly from its hidden states, and subsequently learns to predict future concepts via a dedicated Concept Module. These predicted concepts are then fed back to the token level to guide subsequent generation, with NTP and NCP trained jointly end-to-end. We scale this architecture to 8.9B parameters and train it on 5.73T tokens from the Dolma-3 dataset, marking the largest demonstration of a latent-space language model to date. Remarkably, by consuming only 51.3% of the total training tokens, NCP-ArchPreview achieves the final pretraining loss of OLMo-3-7B. Following full pretraining, it outperforms OLMo-3-7B by 2.45 points on the downstream macro-average, including a notable 5.99-point gain on GSM8K. Controlled experiments isolate a clear progression of performance gains stemming from both the latent architecture and the NCP objective. Furthermore, utilizing only 85% of the standard computation, NCP-ArchPreview approaches the training loss of a strictly parameter-aligned 8.9B baseline. The learned latent space remains highly valuable after the pretraining stage: updating just the 17M-parameter VQ module yields a novel, lightweight interface for domain adaptation, while a simple injection of concept representations into a DFlash2 drafter improves the mean accepted length by 4.17% with negligible overhead.

AI.tldr: NCP-ArchPreview 是一种8.9B参数的潜在空间语言模型，在标准next-token prediction (NTP) 之外引入 Next Concept Prediction (NCP) 目标，预测跨多个 token 的离散概念，以仅51.3%的训练 token 量即可达到 OLMo-3-7B 的最终预训练损失，并在下游任务上平均提升 2.45 分。
AI.motivation: 标准自回归语言模型仅依赖 next-token prediction，难以显式建模跨多个 token 的高层次语义结构。论文旨在通过引入概念级预测目标，让模型学习更抽象、更长程的语言单元，从而提升预训练效率和下游表现。
AI.method: 1. 在隐藏状态上构建 product-quantized 概念词表，形成 latent space；2. 设计独立的 Concept Module 预测未来概念；3. 将预测的概念反馈到 token 层以指导生成；4. NTP 与 NCP 联合端到端训练；5. 模型扩展至 8.9B 参数，使用 Dolma-3 数据集训练 5.73T tokens。
AI.result: 仅用 51.3% 的训练 token 即达到 OLMo-3-7B 的预训练损失；下游 macro-average 提升 2.45 分，其中 GSM8K 提升 5.99 分；仅用 85% 标准计算量即接近参数匹配的 8.9B baseline 训练损失；此外，仅更新 17M 参数的 VQ 模块即可实现领域适配，向 DFlash2 drafter 注入概念表示可使 mean accepted length 提升 4.17%。
AI.conclusion: NCP-ArchPreview 证明在自回归预训练中引入概念级潜在预测目标，能够在显著降低计算成本的同时提升性能；学到的 latent space 在预训练后仍具实用价值，可用于轻量级领域适配和推测解码加速，是目前最大的潜在空间语言模型演示。

title: CMNIE: An Information Extraction Benchmark for Chinese Military News
summary: Structured extraction from Chinese military news supports intelligence analysis, decision-making, and knowledge base construction. However, existing resources provide limited support for joint informa?tion extraction in this domain, especially when events, event arguments, entities, and relations must be modeled together. We present CMNIE, an information extraction benchmark for Chinese military news. Extend?ing military-domain resources beyond document-level event annotations, CMNIE jointly annotates event triggers, event arguments, named enti?ties, and entity relations under a unified domain schema. The dataset contains 13,000 instances collected from public Chinese military news, with manual annotations for 7 event types, 10 argument roles, 7 entity types, and 8 relation types. We evaluate supervised IE models, zero-shot large language models, and fine-tuned LLM-based extraction methods on a shared test set. Experimental results show that CMNIE remains chal?lenging, especially for relation extraction and exact matching of event?argument spans; zero-shot LLMs often identify relevant semantic units but fail to match gold span boundaries exactly. CMNIE provides a stan?dardized benchmark for studying schema adherence, exact span match?ing, and joint structured extraction in specialized Chinese news.

AI.tldr: CMNIE 是一个面向中文军事新闻的信息抽取基准数据集，包含13,000条人工标注实例，统一标注事件触发词、事件论元、命名实体和实体关系四个层次，并在该基准上系统评估了监督IE模型、零样本大语言模型和微调LLM抽取方法。
AI.motivation: 现有中文军事领域信息抽取资源（如CMNEE）主要聚焦于文档级事件标注，缺乏对事件、论元、实体和关系的联合建模支持，难以衡量系统能否完整恢复实例的信息结构。中文军事新闻因包含大量武器代号、部队缩写、地缘实体及无显式谓词的关系（如所属、下属、合作、敌对），对IE系统构成独特挑战。
AI.method: 1）数据来源：从新浪军事、凤凰军事、网易军事爬取2010年8月至2022年2月的公开军事新闻40,000余篇，经去重清洗后通过触发词字典检索保留约20,000候选文本，人工筛选得到13,000条标注实例。2）标注体系：通过语料分析、先验标注和专家讨论构建统一模式，包含7种事件类型（Experiment、Manoeuvre、Deploy、Accident、Indemnity、Support、Exhibit）、10种论元角色、7种实体类型（PER、TIME、GPE、EQU、ORG、LOC、FAC）和8种关系类型（Belong、Carry、Subordinate、Equal、Hostility、Develop、Cooperation、Fellow）。3）标注流程：采用两阶段多轮标注，20名标注员加5名领域专家，批次质量审核门槛95%以上；预裁决IAA中事件Fleiss' kappa达0.9075，实体F1达0.8688，关系F1为0.7266。4）评测方法：基于TextEE协议报告精确/召回/F1，提供精确匹配与宽松匹配两种指标；评估对象涵盖DyGIE++、OneIE、UIE等监督模型，Qwen2.5、GLM-4、Llama、DeepSeek-V3.1、GPT-5.1等零样本LLM，以及GoLLIE、ADELIE、KnowCoder等微调LLM抽取方法。
AI.result: 1）数据集统计：13,000实例（含6,997条事件标注和6,003条空事件），共6,997事件触发词、23,087论元、97,508实体提及、40,252关系提及；实体以EQU和ORG为主，关系以Belong、Subordinate、Equal为主，事件以Manoeuvre最频繁。2）基准结果：OneIE在AC上取得最高53.9 F1，NER达70.2 F1；GoLLIE+Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct在TC（70.3）和RE（50.2）上领先，RE较最强监督基线UIE提升25.1点；零样本LLM整体落后最佳成绩20.9–26.0点，其中DeepSeek-V3.1-Chat在TC/AC领先，GPT-5.1在RE领先。3）精确-宽松匹配差距：DeepSeek-V3.1-Chat TC*达71.3但TC仅49.4，差距21.9点，表明边界精度是零样本LLM的核心瓶颈。4）错误分析：RE错误因实体端点错误被复合放大，事件错误集中在触发词遗漏和角色混淆，NER错误集中在装备型号和组织边界。
AI.conclusion: CMNIE为中文军事新闻信息抽取提供了标准化的联合基准，揭示了显式跨度建模在精确论元抽取中的优势，以及基于模式条件的生成式微调在关系抽取中的优势；精确与宽松匹配之间的显著差距确立了边界精度作为零样本抽取的核心挑战；该基准支持对模式遵循、跨度敏感抽取和联合结构化预测的研究，并开源发布供社区使用。

title: Think Before You Link: Rarity, Reasoning, and Retrieval in Multilingual Entity Linking
summary: Multimodal entity linking grounds entity mentions in text and images to knowledge-base entries. These systems degrade on rare entities, but prior work measures rarity primarily through popularity-based metrics such as pageviews. We broaden this view using knowledge-graph structural metrics that capture how well an entity is documented and connected. These metrics identify many rare entities that popularity metrics miss. Across the resulting rare-entity slices, state-of-the-art accuracy drops by 15.4-39.9%, showing that different rarity definitions expose different failure modes. To address these failures, we introduce a simple, training-free framework in which a reasoning-capable vision-language model iteratively searches and reasons over Wikipedia, gathering evidence dynamically. Controlled experiments show that reasoning and retrieval are complementary. Reasoning alone does not significantly improve accuracy on rare entities. Retrieval without reasoning improves rare-entity accuracy but can hurt overall accuracy. Their combination performs best. On MERLIN, a multilingual multimodal entity linking benchmark over five languages (Hindi, Indonesian, Japanese, Tamil, Vietnamese), our best system improves over the state of the art by 6.9% overall and by up to 23.3% on rare-entity slices. We release MERLIN-Rare, rare-entity test slices for targeted evaluation, with our framework.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多语言多模态实体链接任务中稀有实体性能下降的问题，提出基于知识图谱结构的多维稀有度度量，并设计了一个结合推理型视觉语言模型与迭代检索的无训练框架，在MERLIN基准上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有实体链接系统在稀有实体上性能显著下降，但先前工作主要通过流行度（如页面浏览量）来衡量稀有度，忽略了文化特异性与结构稀疏性等维度，误判了"低流行度"与"真正的稀有性"之间的区别。
AI.method: 1) 利用Wikipedia编辑指标和Wikidata结构指标（共15个）多维度刻画实体稀有度，构造MERLIN-Rare测试切片；2) 提出一个无训练的两模块框架：推理型VLM（Qwen3-VL Thinking/Instruct系列，2B/4B/8B）迭代搜索维基百科（BM25或语义嵌入检索），最多20次检索，第二模块从推理轨迹中提取最终标题。
AI.result: 在MERLIN五语言基准（印地语、印尼语、日语、泰米尔语、越南语）上，最佳系统8B-Think+Embed整体准确率达87.9%，超越SOTA（Cultural Pangea）+6.9%；在稀有实体切片上优势最高达+23.3%。实验表明推理与检索互补：单独推理对稀有实体无显著提升；检索对稀有实体有帮助但可能损害整体准确率；二者结合效果最佳。检索失败占剩余错误的72%。
AI.conclusion: 稀有度应超越流行度度量，结构稀疏性是性能下降的关键因素。推理与检索的结合为解决文化长尾实体链接提供了有效路径，4B推理模型配检索可媲美8B非推理模型，为模型扩展提供了替代方案。未来需改进跨语言检索以缓解主要错误来源。

title: Analyzing Traditional and Neural Approaches to Multilingual Readability Assessment
summary: Transformer-based models excel at Automatic Readability Assessment (ARA), yet feature-based models remain in active use because their predictions tie back to linguistic properties. This matters because readability labels are subjective and rater-dependent, so high accuracy on noisy ground truth may reflect surface patterns rather than the linguistic structure that defines difficulty. We test whether transformers internalize the same features as traditional models across Arabic, English, French, Hindi, and Russian using the ReadMe++ dataset. Shapley Additive Explanations (SHAP) identify the features driving traditional classifiers, which we then use as TCAV concept sets to probe multilingual XLM-R and language-specific encoders. Transformers recover surface-length, syntactic, and lexical-diversity signals, and reflect the ordinal CEFR structure of the traditional models. Alignment varies by model family, language, and layer, with language-specific encoders tracking traditional models more clearly than XLM-R. High linear separability does not always imply directional influence, limiting linear probing for count-based readability features.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SHAP-TCAV框架，在五种语言（阿拉伯语、英语、法语、印地语、俄语）上对比传统特征分类器与Transformer编码器（XLM-R与语言专属编码器）的可读性评估机制，发现Transformer内部确实习得了与特征模型相同的语言学信号，但方向性对齐程度因语言和模型家族而异。
AI.motivation: Transformer模型在自动可读性评估（ARA）上表现优异，但其内部表征不透明。鉴于可读性标签主观且评分者依赖，仅凭准确性无法判断模型是否真正捕捉了定义难度的语言学结构，还是仅拟合了表面噪声。本文旨在探究Transformer是否内部习得了与传统特征模型相同的可读性相关语言学信号。
AI.method: 采用两阶段管道：(1) 在ReadMe++语料（阿、英、法、印、俄五种语言，9685句，六级CEFR分类）上训练Logistic回归、线性SVM和随机森林三种传统分类器，使用LFTK提取手工语言学特征并经分层相关性聚类筛选，用SHAP识别驱动分类的关键特征并以Borda计数聚合排名；(2) 将SHAP选出的top/bottom 10特征构建为TCAV概念集，探测微调后的XLM-R和语言专属编码器（BERT、AraBERTv02、CamemBERT、MuRIL、RuBERT）在12层中的表征方向性，采用Bonferroni校正的t检验（α=0.01）评估显著性。
AI.result: 性能方面：Transformer在QWK（0.82-0.86）上全面超越传统模型（0.65-0.78），语言专属编码器在多数语言上与XLM-R相近但阿语AraBERT优势明显；特征分析显示总字符数、平均词长、形容词/介词计数等表面长度与词类特征在所有语言中排名靠前，且SHAP极性随CEFR级别呈序数平滑变化；TCAV方向性分析表明，英语BERT（0-5层）、俄语RuBERT（4-6层）、法语CamemBERT（6-11层）和印地语XLM-R（3-5层）中SHAP方向成功迁移，但阿拉伯语例外——尽管CAV准确率达0.90-0.98，方向性却未对齐；线性可分性高不一定意味着功能性概念使用。
AI.conclusion: 特征模型与Transformer在相同的语言学信号和方向上趋同：Transformer重新发现了特征模型已有的结构，而非编码完全不同的表征，这种一致性为Transformer ARA的优越性能提供了独立于准确率的解释基础；然而对齐的清晰度因语言和模型家族而异，阿拉伯语形态学可能削弱了表面计数与难度之间的线性联系，提示对形态丰富语言需要形态学感知概念和非线性探测方法；任务本身的序数结构在两种方法中自发涌现，表明显式序数损失的边际收益可能有限。

title: Larger Context Window, Fewer Overcorrections: Optimizing Prompts and Batching for Minimal-Edit Grammatical Error Correction
summary: Minimal-edit Grammatical Error Correction (GEC) is a challenging task for zero- and few-shot prompted Large Language Models (LLMs), which systematically overcorrect and degrade $F_{0.5}$ by rewriting well-formed spans. While fine-tuning provides an effective solution, it imposes substantial infrastructure demands. We introduce a prompt-based approach that closes the gap to fine-tuned models through three advances in GEC prompting methodology. First, we introduce taxonomy-based instructions to enforce minimal-edit constraints with a comprehensive list of grammatical error rules, equipping the LLM with a bounded, metric-aligned scope of correctable edits, which benefits the strongest models while remaining model-dependent overall. Second, we show that batching multiple uncorrected sentences into a single input context acts as a targeted regularizer against overcorrection, systematically reducing the edit rate across diverse LLM families; we hypothesize this arises from attention dilution effect induced by the bounded capacity of self-attention scores. Finally, LLM-assisted Prompt Optimization refines these instructions. Powered by Gemini 3.1-Pro, our prompt achieves $F_{0.5}=78.32$ on the BEA-2019 test set - establishing a new prompt-based SOTA while shrinking the gap to the fine-tuned single-model SOTA (Staruch et al., 2025) to a mere $0.38$ points. Code, prompts, and outputs are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于提示工程的方法，通过基于分类法的指令、批处理推理和LLM辅助提示优化，使零样本/少样本提示的LLM在最小编辑语法纠错任务上达到与微调模型相当的性能。使用Gemini 3.1-Pro在BEA-2019测试集上取得F₀.₅=78.32，与当前最佳单模型微调系统差距仅为0.38分。
AI.motivation: 提示型LLM在最小编辑语法纠错（GEC）任务中系统性过度纠正常态化、降低F₀.₅分数；微调虽有效但基础设施开销大。本文旨在弥合提示方法与微调SOTA之间的差距，使无法承担微调成本的用户也能获得高质量GEC能力。
AI.method: 三大方法学进展：(1) 基于分类法的指令——将25个ERRANT错误类别显式编码进提示，为LLM提供有界、与指标对齐的可编辑范围；(2) 批处理作为正则化器——将多个句子打包到单一上下文输入中，作者假设由于自注意力分数的容量有界而产生"注意力稀释"效应，从而抑制过度纠正；(3) LLM辅助提示优化——基于Claude Code的人机协作贪心搜索，通过ERRANT按类别诊断、提出精确单一变更、在开发集上验证F₀.₅提升后采纳。评估覆盖6个商用LLM（GPT-5.4、Claude Opus 4.6、Gemini 3.1-Pro及对应中型版本）和1个开源模型Qwen3-8B，测试集为BEA-2019和CoNLL-2014。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) Gemini 3.1-Pro + 优化提示（A.6.4）在BEA-2019测试集取得F₀.₅=78.32，建立提示型GEC新SOTA，与微调SOTA（Staruch et al., 2025）的F₀.₅=78.70仅差0.38分；在CoNLL-2014测试集取得F₀.₅=67.08。(2) 批处理系统性地抑制了过度纠正：例如Qwen3-8B的零编辑句子比例从43.8%（B=1）升至80.7%（B=120），但流畅度（Scribendi得分）下降。(3) 分类法对强模型有利、对弱模型相当于噪声：F₀.₅最优批大小在B=5（Qwen3-8B）至B=60（中型商用模型）之间。(4) LLM优化的提示在原生模型上效果最佳且常可迁移到其他模型家族。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明通过精细的提示设计和上下文管理，通用LLM可在最小编辑GEC上达到微调质量，无需权重更新。这使高质量GEC在无法部署微调模型的资源受限或受合规约束的场景中变得可行。该框架还可生成高质量的合成训练数据用于微调GEC模型。局限性包括：商用API不透明且可能存在预训练数据污染；优化仅在中型模型上进行；评估限于英语学习者作文；注意力稀释假说缺乏受控验证。

title: LLM-Anchored Paralinguistic Enrichment for Alzheimer's Disease Detection
summary: Speech-based automatic detection of Alzheimer's disease (AD) provides a non-invasive and scalable approach to early cognitive screening. AD affects both lexical-semantic organization and speech production, including atypical pauses and word elongations. However, existing methods have yet to fully integrate these paralinguistic cues with linguistic content. We propose LLM-Anchored Paralinguistic Enrichment (LAPE), which enriches LLM-derived linguistic representations with paralinguistic cues through three coordinated innovations. The first is prosodic event textualization, which enables the LLM to model pauses and elongations jointly with lexical content by encoding them as explicit markers with bounded duration-aware repetition. The second is lexico-prosodic unitization and chunking, which preserves event identity and magnitude in both modalities by pooling only consecutive word units. The third is text-anchored paralinguistic fusion, which integrates local and utterance-level speech features by using NormGate to normalize and dynamically scale them relative to text. We evaluate LAPE on ADReSS and ADReSSo using participant-level cross-validation and leave-one-subject-out evaluation. LAPE achieves state-of-the-art performance across all four primary settings. Code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LAPE框架,通过韵律事件文本化、词汇-韵律单元化与分块、文本锚定的副语言融合三大创新,将LLM语言学表征与停顿、延长等副语言线索深度整合,在ADReSS和ADReSSo数据集的CV和LOSO四种设置下均达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有AD语音检测方法未能充分整合副语言线索(停顿、延长等)与语言学内容;同时多模态融合中文本往往强于语音,模态贡献不均;且现有方法对局部韵律结构与话语级语音特征的协调不足。
AI.method: 三大创新:(1)韵律事件文本化——将停顿和音节延长编码为带时长感知的有界重复标记(〈pause〉×1/2/3、〈elongated〉×1/2/3),让LLM联合建模词汇与时间;(2)词汇-韵律单元化与分块——以词时间戳为支架,将Kimi和Whisper特征组织为词/停顿/延长/边界单元,仅对连续词单元进行均值池化分块,保留事件身份与幅度;(3)文本锚定副语言融合——通过NormGate对三个语音块(局部Whisper、话语级eGeMAPS、WavLM)相对于文本进行样本级归一化与动态门控缩放,文本作为直接锚点。
AI.result: 在ADReSS和ADReSSo的CV与LOSO四种设置下,LAPE准确率分别达98.18%、94.01%(CV)和95.37%、91.57%(LOSO),均刷新SOTA,领先最强基线2.21–8.37%(平均5.55%)。联合协议优于单一事件协议,分块粒度优于词/标记粒度,NormGate平均提升1.38%,文本单独显著优于语音单独。
AI.conclusion: LAPE为语音AD检测提供了统一的副语言增强框架,通过文本锚定设计有效协调局部与话语级语音证据并处理模态贡献不均问题,未来将扩展至更丰富的副语言线索文本化及向小型LLM蒸馏。

title: SearchAtlas: Analyzing Agentic Search Strategies via Evidential Query Graphs
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 30 pages, 9 figures, including appendices
summary: LLM search agents are often evaluated on final-answer accuracy, overlooking the process. Analyzing a search strategy requires understanding how credible evidence is retrieved to address question constraints. This valuable information is buried in raw search trajectories that are long and difficult to parse. We introduce SearchAtlas, a framework that converts search trajectories into structured graphs whose edges represent how evidence is propagated across the reasoning trace, from the query that retrieves it to the final answer. Our automated parsing pipeline achieves a mean edge F1 of 86.0% against human-annotated graphs and remains consistent across repeated runs. We analyze five search agents on three benchmarks, revealing systematic differences in search scale and evidence aggregation. SearchAtlas exposes fragmented answer support, question constraints that do not reach the answer, and unverified parametric knowledge entering the response. These process failures are strongly associated with incorrect answers, even more so than an LLM judge given either the raw trajectory or the ordered query list, suggesting that the constructed graphs provide useful interpretability. Moreover, an audit of cases in which process-diagnostic scores disagree with final-answer correctness shows that they capture information not reducible to answer accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SearchAtlas 框架，将 LLM 搜索代理的原始轨迹转换为证据依赖有向无环图（DAG），用于系统化分析搜索策略与诊断过程失败，而非仅依赖最终答案准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有搜索代理评估主要依赖最终答案准确性，忽视了搜索过程本身。两个代理可能采用截然不同的搜索策略但获得相同准确率，而原始轨迹冗长扁平、难以解析，掩盖了证据流动。因此需要一种显式表示证据依赖关系的结构化方法，以追踪答案如何被支持、识别过程失败位置。
AI.method: SearchAtlas 包含：(1) 图定义：将轨迹转为类型化 DAG，节点为查询、Prior Knowledge（PK）、最终答案 A，边包括约束使用（q₀→q）、证据使用（q→v）、失败响应、PK 边；(2) 两阶段自动化构建管线：确定性预处理提取查询节点与失败信息，再由 LLM 进行证据归因与父节点剪枝（最小父集覆盖 MPSC）；(3) 基于问题约束类型（顺序约束 vs 并行约束）定义三类诊断指标：答案路径拓扑（顺序用答案骨干集中度 B_ans、并行用答案路径直达度 G_direct）、约束接地（顺序用 BCG、并行用 DCC）、先验知识依赖（顺序用 PKA_ans、并行用 PKD_ans）。实验覆盖 5 个搜索代理（WebSailor、MiroThinker、TYDP 及两个变体）在 3 个基准（BrowseComp、WebWalker-Hard、DeepSearchQA）上的 1,350 条轨迹。
AI.result: 自动化管线对 100 个人工标注 DAG 达到平均边 F₁ 86.0%，跨四种归因模型稳定；图统计显示代理间搜索规模差异显著（如 MiroThinker 中位 103 节点/165 边 vs TYDP-Qwen3 中位 6/7）；三类诊断联合 AUC 达 0.840–0.856，显著优于基于原始轨迹或有序查询列表的 LLM 评判器（准确率 77.6% vs 73.8%/67.7%，正类 F₁ 74.0% vs 60.6%/44.4%）；DAG 定位的约束接地与 PK 信号均优于轨迹范围基线。过程诊断与答案正确性一致但承载互补信息：高分错误多为"目标绑定错误"（结构合理但指向错误实体），低分正确多为过度搜索或先验知识捷径。
AI.conclusion: SearchAtlas 证明通过结构化证据流表示可有效审计搜索代理的过程质量，揭示最终答案准确率无法捕捉的过程失败模式（碎片化答案支持、未接地约束、未经验证的先验知识）。该方法为搜索代理的可解释性评估提供了新范式，未来可扩展至更通用的智能体工具调用场景。局限包括：依赖 LLM 归因决策、仅恢复轨迹暴露的信息、依赖问题类型正确分类、限于英文封闭答案深度搜索任务。

title: Auto-RecSys: Harnessing Autonomous Research Agents for Industry-Scale Recommender System
summary: Auto-research agents have shown the potential to automate hypothesis generation, experiment execution, and iterative refinement. However, scaling this paradigm to industry-scale recommendation models introduces two challenges: (1) long feedback loops, where model training can take days, making serial iteration prohibitively slow and requiring parallel exploration across multiple research directions; and (2) system complexity, where large configurations, fragile infrastructure dependencies, and multi-day GPU jobs require robust and recoverable execution. We present Auto-RecSys, an autonomous research system for long-horizon experimentation on industry-scale recommendation models. Auto-RecSys addresses these challenges through three harness designs: (1) distributed asynchronous execution for running multiple experiments in parallel across servers, (2) centralized cross-server memory for persistent and recoverable execution across sessions and failures, and (3) cognitive-procedural separation, where natural-language skill files guide LLM reasoning while deterministic scripts enforce operational correctness. Auto-RecSys further employs a dual-loop self-evolving architecture: an Execution Evolution Loop in which model-specific playbooks accumulate operational knowledge by recording failed attempts and crystallizing successful pipelines, and an Idea Evolution Loop in which experimental outcomes inform subsequent ideation. Evaluated on recommendation models, Auto-RecSys significantly reduces the human time required per experiment cycle and improves execution reliability as its playbooks mature.

AI.tldr: Auto-RecSys是一个面向工业级推荐模型的自主研究系统，通过分布式异步执行、集中化跨服务器记忆、认知-过程分离三层harness设计，以及双循环自演化架构（执行演化循环+创意演化循环），将传统需要数天人工参与的实验周期压缩到分钟级，并通过自然语言playbook持续积累操作知识，使执行可靠性随迭代不断提升。
AI.motivation: 小规模自主研究系统（实验分钟到小时级别、单session、可快速串行迭代）在工业级推荐模型场景下面临两个根本性挑战：（1）长反馈循环——单次训练需数天GPU时间，串行迭代严重限制研究吞吐量；（2）系统复杂性——数千行配置、分布式基础设施、跨天GPU作业、agent session中断等，要求执行必须健壮、可恢复、可跨会话持续。论文旨在将自主研究范式从快速小规模实验扩展到长周期、基础设施密集的工业级模型开发。
AI.method: Auto-RecSys围绕三层harness设计构建：（1）分布式异步执行——有限状态机（ideating→implementing→validating→training→analyzing，失败进入debugging）追踪每个idea独立状态，支持多idea跨服务器并行；（2）集中化跨服务器记忆——共享存储布局（含state/registry/playbooks/experiment_history/sessions等），支持跨服务器session恢复和handoff；（3）认知-过程分离——自然语言skill文件指导LLM推理，确定性脚本执行精确状态转换、API调用和原子写入。在此基础上采用双循环自演化架构：Execution Evolution Loop从session轨迹中蒸馏出模型专属playbook（死端+成功管道+提交配置），通过markdown自然语言指令实现死端规避和自愈；Idea Evolution Loop基于模型架构知识库、文献挖掘和自头脑风暴生成idea，并依据历史结果排序去重。两个循环通过中央记忆store耦合。Playbook支持一次性跨模型结构迁移——首个模型的成熟模板可作为后续模型的脚手架。
AI.result: 在31次唯一迭代评估中：（1）人工带宽——人机协同模式下单个idea人工投入从小时-天级降至分钟级，全自主模式下进一步降低，研究者可在相同注意力预算下同时管理十余个idea；（2）执行可靠性——playbook稳定阶段主要修复步骤从每轮4.0降至1.3，baseline切换时短暂反弹至连续5轮需操作恢复，后切换阶段恢复至0.5次/轮且6轮中5轮零修复；（3）错误按类别消失——GPU硬件不稳定、资源标签缺失、构建日期参数等类别被playbook吸收即不再出现；（4）自演化机制实证——死端规避、管道配置结晶、验证跳过模式、自诊断基础设施改进（自主用cron替换会上下文溢出的轮询agent）、涌现元模式识别等五种机制均被观察到；（5）韧性案例——一次session崩溃后另一台服务器上的agent通过轨迹日志重建上下文并完成剩余流程；最长autonomoussession连续执行970条日志条目（110次工具调用）零人工干预。
AI.conclusion: Auto-RecSys证明自主研究可通过稳健、持久、持续演化的执行harness从短周期自包含任务扩展到复杂工业级系统。其核心贡献在于：分布式并行实验组合、跨服务器持久状态管理、自然语言playbook形式的程序化记忆、双循环自演化架构以及playbook的一次性跨模型结构迁移。论文同时指出未来方向：小规模代理模型快速idea筛选、跨模型知识迁移、playbook更新的形式化验证门控、自适应人机协同置信度阈值以及团队级扩展。

title: Using Semantic Uncertainty to Estimate Transition Relevance in Turn-taking
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026. 21 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables
summary: Turn-taking is a fundamental mechanism that governs when interlocutors speak and listen. Although Spoken Dialogue Systems (SDS) exploit a range of linguistic, acoustic, and non-verbal cues, they produce ill-timed responses in unscripted interaction. A central challenge is anticipating Transition Relevance Places (TRPs), or opportunities, not obligations, for a listener to take the floor. Human listeners do not wait for turn endings; as an utterance unfolds, they use expectations about its developing meaning to anticipate TRPs and decide whether to take the floor. We examine whether these evolving expectations can be modeled through semantic uncertainty -- an LLM-derived measure of how strongly a turn so far constrains what may plausibly come next. To do so, we sample possible continuations of an ongoing turn and use changes in semantic dispersion to identify TRPs within turns. We evaluate this account on a dataset with TRP labels derived from real-time listener responses, rather than retrospective annotation. Our approach substantially outperforms prompt-based and fine-tuned text-only baselines, providing empirical support for the view that evolving semantic constraints inform perceived turn-taking opportunities in unscripted interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用LLM衍生的"语义不确定性"信号（通过采样可能续写并度量其语义离散度SNNE）来预测自然对话中"轮次转换相关位置"(TRP)，特别是turn内部的TRP。实验基于实时听者响应标注的数据集，结果显著优于提示工程和监督微调的纯文本基线。
AI.motivation: 当前口语对话系统(SDS)在非脚本化交互中难以适时响应，根本原因之一是它们通常基于"可观察结果"（如说话人转换、反馈语）训练，忽略了听者可能感知到但未实际发话的turn内部TRP。人类听者会随着话语展开不断更新对后续内容的预期，本研究旨在检验"演化的语义约束"能否为turn内部TRP预测提供有用信号。
AI.method: 1) 任务定义：对单说话人话语S，按词序构建前缀序列P_i，对每个前缀预测其末尾位置是否为TRP。2) 语义不确定性估计（Algorithm 1）：对每个前缀用LLM采样K个续写，用句子嵌入模型计算两两余弦相似度，用Semantic Nearest Neighbor Entropy (SNNE) 聚合为标量U_i。3) 因果决策规则（Algorithm 2）：计算U_i的离散差分，经低通滤波平滑后在滑动窗口内以median/MAD做自适应阈值判断。4) 数据：使用Umair et al.(2024)的55条刺激、118名参与者实时响应数据，重建词级时间戳和响应起始点，按刺激特定阈值(μ+0.05σ)二值化得到842/5195个TRP正例（16.2%）。5) 基线：六种指令调优LLM的四种提示条件、LoRA监督微调、next-token entropy (NTE)与normalized predictive entropy (NPE)两个不确定性控制信号。
AI.result: 语义不确定性方法在72×32=2304种配置扫描下平均F_0.5=0.545±0.032（最高0.603），显著超越最佳提示基线(F_0.5=0.22)、最佳SFT基线(F_0.5=0.27)、NTE(F_0.5=0.319±0.070)和NPE(F_0.5=0.328±0.027)。方差分解显示75.4%性能差异来自决策规则，平滑占52.6%，而解码设置、嵌入模型、τ贡献较小。K=2即可达到约0.54，说明信号在极小样本下即可恢复。嵌入空间的语义诊断显示原续写与同义改写相似度0.861，与无关续写0.654，差值0.207 (CI 0.190–0.223)，98.7%三元组排序正确。
AI.conclusion: 语义不确定性（通过SNNE度量续写语义离散度）是预测turn内部TRP的有效信号，且其优势不能用token级概率不确定性解释。结论支持"演化的语义约束为turn-taking时机感知提供信息"这一理论观点，并暗示对话系统应超越基于可观察结果的训练，转向跟踪话语展开过程中语义约束的动态变化。局限包括：小规模英语数据集、纯文本设置、未结合多模态线索、决策规则为确定性启发式、计算成本较高，以及语义不确定性仍是模型中介代理而非听者内部期望的直接测量。

title: Distribution-aware Language Neuron Identification in Multilingual Large Language Models
summary: Multilingual large language models (mLLMs) contain a small fraction of feed-forward neurons that are sensitive to particular languages, commonly termed language-specific neurons. Existing work measures language specificity using the entropy of each neuron's language-wise probabilities of being active, where a neuron is considered active when its activation value is positive. However, this approach may not fully capture the multilingual nature of mLLMs, where language representations are distributional and mutually related. We propose Distribution-aware Language Neuron selection, which leverages pairwise relationships between per-language activation distributions over the full activation range, including negative values. Specifically, we quantify each neuron's language specificity by clustering languages using pairwise overlap coefficients between their activation distributions. Across two mLLMs and two held-out corpora, our identifier more effectively isolates language-specific causal effects, yielding up to 4.9$\times$ higher on-target language damage per neuron while preserving off-target language performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"分布感知语言神经元选择"（DLN）方法，通过建模神经元激活值的完整分布（包含负值）以及语言间激活分布的两两关系，替代现有基于激活概率熵的方法，实现更有效的多语言大语言模型语言特异性神经元识别。
AI.motivation: 现有基于激活概率熵的语言神经元识别方法将激活值二值化（仅正值视为活跃），丢失了负值激活中的信息，且忽略了语言间激活分布的形状差异和关联结构，无法充分反映多语言LLM中语言表征的分布性和相互关联性。
AI.method: DLN方法包括三个步骤：1）计算每种语言下神经元激活值的连续概率密度函数（直方图近似）；2）构建语言间两两重叠系数矩阵；3）通过最小化最大簇间重叠系数进行二分聚类（等价于单链接聚类，K=2），将语言划分为目标语言集和参考集，并按阈值τ筛选。识别出的神经元分为单语言神经元（SLN）和多语言神经元（MLN）。
AI.result: 在Llama-3.1-8B和SmolLM3-3B-Base两个模型上，DLN方法的选择性（Sel）在每个百分位P上都优于LAPE和LSN基线。SLN的每神经元目标语言伤害比LAPE高4.9×（WIKI）和5.4×（FLORES）。MLN能识别如中日语言联盟等共享表征，使用更少神经元（465 vs 1329）却产生7.12×更高的簇内伤害。DLN还能发现负值激活区的功能性神经元（如63-72%的英语SLN具有负目标均值），并可扩展到gate-up乘积（z-site）。
AI.conclusion: 全面建模激活分布的连续形态和语言间关联结构，能更忠实地识别多语言LLM中的语言神经元，揭示现有指示器方法结构性盲视的分布编码语言特异性，包括负激活区神经元的功能性角色和多语言神经元构成的语言联盟。

title: Rethinking Verbalized Confidence for LLM-as-a-Judge: A Compatibility Shift on Post-2025 Proprietary Models
summary: Verbalized confidence, long dismissed as overconfident, coarse, and prone to round-number clustering, is now the more robust soft-scoring mechanism for LLM-as-a-Judge on top-tier proprietary models. Across SummEval, AggreFact, and HelpSteer2, spanning up to 18 LLMs, we show that the standard advice to prefer log-probabilities no longer holds on post-2025 models, where verbalized confidence is the better signal. We call this a compatibility shift. On top of a standard verbalized-confidence baseline, we introduce two new ingredients: an overconfidence advisory and self-debate. Together they improve calibration, score-distribution spread, and robustness to task subjectivity. We further observe a generation effect: post-2025 models accommodate these two additions with little balanced-accuracy cost, whereas pre-2025 models pay a measurable penalty. Compared with logprob-based G-Eval, verbalized confidence is the more subjectivity-robust soft signal on GPT-family top-tier releases. The shift is invisible under accuracy-only reporting. Rather than defaulting to hard predictions, we recommend broader use of soft scoring in LLM-as-a-Judge. More broadly, verbalized confidence has moved from a weaker substitute for logprobs to a practical soft-scoring mechanism for contemporary LLM judges.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在LLM-as-a-Judge场景中，post-2025旗舰模型上口头化置信度（verbalized confidence）已取代logprob成为更优的软评分机制。通过新增"过度自信提示"和"自我辩论"两个组件，在18个模型、3个基准测试上证明该方法在AECE校准、分数分布广度和任务主观性鲁棒性上均显著优于基线。关键发现是存在"兼容性转移"：post-2025模型能容纳更丰富提示而不损失平衡准确率，而pre-2025模型则付出明显代价。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为logprob-based soft scoring（如G-Eval）优于verbalized confidence，因后者存在过度自信、粗粒度和聚类等问题。但该建议基于pre-2025模型证据，随着post-2025旗舰模型发布且logprob访问受限（Claude从未支持，Gemini 3.0+停止支持），需要重新评估这一实践建议。
AI.method: 提出Ours协议：在标准Rubric（置信度评分模板）基础上叠加两个组件：（1）过度自信提示（advisory），警告模型"过去评估中一直过度自信"并要求主动寻找错误理由；（2）自我辩论（self-debate），要求模型分三步——论证True、论证False、综合解释后再下结论。评估指标包括Prediction BA、Oracle BA、Oracle-Prediction Gap、Debate Stress、AECE（自适应等质量分箱校准误差）和Spread（与均匀分布的Bhattacharyya重叠系数）。
AI.result: 在AggreFact（10模型，9任务×300示例）、SummEval（16模型）和HelpSteer2（9模型，800示例）上：（1）Ours在10/10模型上显著降低AECE并扩大Spread；（2）post-2025模型BA变化为+0.7pp，而pre-2025为-1.8pp（兼容性转移）；（3）在GPT系列上，verbalized confidence在GPT-5时代超越了logprob-based G-Eval；（4）Ours使概率信号对任务主观性更鲁棒，SummEval上τ(prob)斜率Δslope=-0.143（p<10⁻⁴），HelpSteer2独立复现相同结论；（5）组件消融显示advisory是校准主驱动，自辩论优于自由形式推理。
AI.conclusion: logprob-based soft scoring的pre-2025优势不再普遍适用；logprob-free的verbalized confidence recipe在post-2025 flagships上是更便携、更具前向兼容性的软评分接口。实践建议：报告软分数指标（而非仅硬预测准确率），并视prompt-model兼容性为动态目标——在当代LLM评判中应优先采用口头化置信度而非token logprobs。

title: K/V-Cache Interventions Dissociate Representation Alignment from Persona Expression in Decoder-Only Language Models
summary: We study K/V-cache interventions -- transplanting a target-conditioned K/V trajectory into a source-persona generation -- as a structured surface for persona control in decoder-only language models. Across 13 intervention configurations applied to Llama-3.1-8B for a fixed source-to-target persona pair, we report two consistent dissociations between representation-level alignment and behavioral expression, plus a common failure under position perturbations. First, all layer-band K/V replacements (early, mid, late) achieve strong local V-space alignment (V-gap 0.91, 0.89, 0.84), but only mid-layer replacement (layers 9-20) combines substantial target-marker expression with preserved lexical diversity. Second, full and mid-layer replacement induce comparable alignment (V-gap 0.94 vs. 0.89) yet produce different lexical-diversity profiles (TTR 0.65 vs. 0.77). Third, position perturbations (lag and shuffle) apply distinct operations yet uniformly suppress target-persona expression -- a common behavioral failure rather than a strict dissociation. Representation-level similarity metrics alone are thus not sufficient predictors of downstream persona expression in the regimes we study; the K/V cache emerges as a controllable but structurally constrained intervention surface. Because the transplanted trajectory carries the target's own generated token history, we characterize the intervention as trajectory-level transplantation rather than isolated persona-representation injection; a same-token-sequence control, decoding an identical token sequence under source vs. target conditioning, reproduces the sign and layer localization of the L28 representational shift, indicating the shift is not explained solely by imported token history. These findings characterize representation-behavior dissociation in a high-signal setting rather than establishing universality across models or persona pairs.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究在仅解码器语言模型（如Llama-3.1-8B）中，通过干预K/V缓存（将目标角色条件下的K/V轨迹移植到源角色生成中）来实现角色控制的机制。作者在13种干预配置下发现，表示层面的对齐（如V空间余弦相似度）与行为层面的角色表达（如目标标记密度、词汇多样性）之间存在系统性解耦：仅中层（第9-20层）K/V替换同时实现目标表征对齐与保持词汇多样性，而全层替换虽对齐更强但导致重复崩溃，位置扰动（打乱/滞后）则一致性地失败。
AI.motivation: 现有角色控制方法主要干预输入令牌、模型权重或中间激活，而K/V缓存作为跨步骤持久化的架构通道，其作为角色控制干预面的潜力与结构性约束未被系统研究。同时，作者观察到单层激活注入存在"重置动力学"（每步控制器注入被模型动力学以约等量反向抵消），促使他们转向K/V层面的干预。
AI.method: 在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上，针对单一源→目标角色对（"Nurse Reyes"→"Priya"）和固定种子话题，设计13种K/V干预配置：v1全层替换、v2层带替换（粗粒度三层带+细粒度四层子带）、v3位置扰动（shuffle和lag）、v4源-目标插值（α∈{0.25, 0.5}）、v5同令牌序列对照。三类测量信号：文本层角色标记密度（每100词）、L28隐藏状态V⋆投影（到角色子空间的距离差）、K/V余弦对齐。
AI.result: 核心发现：(1) 空间-带解耦：早/中/晚层带替换均实现强局部V对齐（0.91/0.89/0.84），但仅中层替换（V-gap 0.89，标记密度15.5，TTR 0.77）兼具目标标记转移与词汇多样性保持；(2) 干预-范围解耦：全层替换（V-gap 0.94）与中层替换（V-gap 0.89）实现相当对齐却产生不同词汇多样性（TTR 0.65 vs 0.77）；(3) 位置扰动共同失败：shuffle与lag应用不同操作但均无法注入目标表征且行为表现一致（标记密度≤0.5）。同令牌序列对照表明表征偏移不能完全归因于导入的目标令牌历史。V-gap显著大于K-gap（0.89 vs 0.38 at L9-20），中层替换在150 token范围内持续生效（标记密度16.7→11.9，与无干预目标基线17.5→11.7接近）。
AI.conclusion: 表示层面对齐指标（V空间余弦、隐藏状态子空间投影）单独不足以预测下游角色行为表达；K/V缓存是可控制但结构受限的干预面，不能干净地从令牌/权重通道分离（移植轨迹携带目标自身生成的令牌历史），但同令牌序列对照显示这种纠缠是部分的。方法论上，建议角色控制评估同时报告表征与行为指标。局限包括：单一模型、单一角色对、单一种子话题、单样本K/V转储、TTR作为词汇多样性的代理、标记密度非身份判断等。

title: ProMediConv: Benchmarking Proactive Conversational Agents in Legal Dispute Mediation
summary: Dispute mediation is essential for maintaining social harmony and resilience, yet developing skilled mediators is costly and time-consuming. Existing LLM-based mediation research remains limited by unrealistic task formulations, low-fidelity datasets, and coarse evaluation metrics that obscure turn-by-turn dynamics. To address these gaps, we introduce ProMediConv, a novel benchmarking framework that models mediation as a proactive, multi-stage, and party-aware dialogue process incorporating 11 mediation strategies and four party behavior pattern (BP) states. Using 972 complete real-world cases, we construct a high-fidelity mediation dataset with utterance-level annotations of strategies and BP states. Furthermore, to better assess agent impact, we propose MAD (Mean Attribute Difference), a fine-grained metric that captures BP shifts throughout the dialogue. Leveraging this framework, we establish a comprehensive benchmark by evaluating diverse models alongside our tailored baseline ProMediAgent. Extensive empirical analyses reveal critical behavioral phenomena and underscore the persistent challenges current models face in dynamic, multi-party mediation. Ultimately, ProMediConv provides a rigorous foundation and a vital quantitative standard for advancing AI-assisted conflict resolution. Our dataset and codebase are accessible at this https URL .
